summary: The mean squared displacement (MSD) is a cornerstone in the analysis of diffusion processes in complex media. When the system is heterogeneous and, in particular, when single-particle trajectories are short, it is essential to extract maximal information from each measured trajectory. This is typically done by time-averaging squared increments and examining the scaling of the time-averaged MSD in log-log space. However, classical regression methods perform poorly in this setting because time-averaging introduces correlations aggravated by those inherent to anomalous diffusion. We tackle these limitations by applying a generalized least squares framework, which substantially reduces variance and bias in diffusion parameter estimates, especially for short (around 100 points) and ultra-short (around 10 points) trajectories. The method is fully automated and requires no supervision. Furthermore, it enables prediction of estimation error probability density, which is asymptotically Gaussian, for both classical and enhanced approaches. Leveraging this prediction, we introduce a specialized deconvolution algorithm that reconstructs the underlying particle ensemble structure from experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于广义最小二乘（GLS）框架来改进短轨迹和超短轨迹（约10-100个点）中扩散参数的估计，通过减少时间平均MSD回归中相关性和异常扩散带来的偏差与方差，并引入解卷积算法重建粒子系综结构。
AI.motivation: 在异质系统中分析扩散过程时，经典回归方法因时间平均引入的轨迹内相关性以及异常扩散固有的相关性而表现不佳。特别是对于短轨迹（~100点）和超短轨迹（~10点），从每条测量轨迹中提取最大信息至关重要，但现有方法性能受限。
AI.method: 采用广义最小二乘（GLS）框架替代经典回归方法进行时间平均MSD的log-log空间缩放分析。该方法完全自动化、无需人工监督，能够预测估计误差的概率密度（渐近高斯分布），并据此设计专门的解卷积算法来从实验数据中重建粒子系综的底层结构。
AI.result: GLS方法显著降低了扩散参数估计中的方差和偏差，尤其针对短轨迹（~100点）和超短轨迹（~10点）效果突出。该方法还支持误差概率密度的预测，可为经典和增强方法提供渐近高斯形式的误差分布，并实现粒子系综结构的解卷积重建。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为短轨迹条件下扩散参数估计提供了一种自动化、无监督且统计上更优的解决方案，并通过误差预测驱动的解卷积算法增强了从异质实验数据中提取系综级信息的能力。

title: Momentum-Resolved Electronic Structure for Quasicrystals: Full-Band Spectra and Chern Number
summary: Quasicrystals lack the translational symmetry that underlies Bloch decomposition and Brillouin-zone integration, making full-band momentum-resolved electronic structure difficult to formulate and compute. We develop a systematically convergent reciprocal-space tight-binding framework for a broad class of quasicrystals. The method combines two systematically refinable components: a Fourier-module scattering-channel Hamiltonian that yields local spectral and current-current correlation quantities at each physical momentum, and an expanding hierarchy of pseudo-Brillouin zones that converts the resulting local quantities into bulk thermodynamic observables through an exact local-to-global relation. Applied to the Penrose and Ammann-Beenker models, the framework uncovers full-band momentum-resolved quasibands and a multichannel mechanism for pseudogap formation, both beyond the scope of low-energy effective models. It further resolves Zeeman-driven gap closings and reopenings, quantized Chern plateaus, and the phason invariance of bulk spectral and topological observables. This framework provides a unified reciprocal-space route to full-band spectral and topological properties of quasicrystals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统收敛的倒空间紧束缚框架，用于研究准晶体的全能带动量分辨电子结构。该方法结合了傅里叶模散射通道哈密顿量和伪布里渊区层级，通过精确的局域到全局关系计算体相热力学可观测量。在Penrose和Ammann-Beenker模型中，该方法揭示了全能带准带、赝能隙形成的多通道机制、Zeeman驱动的能隙闭合与重开、量子化Chern平台以及phason不变性。
AI.motivation: 准晶体缺乏平移对称性，这导致布洛赫分解和布里渊区积分等标准方法不再适用，使得全能带动量分辨电子结构的表述和计算变得困难。现有的低能有效模型无法捕捉全能带尺度的物理现象，因此需要开发新的统一方法。
AI.method: 提出一个系统收敛的倒空间紧束缚框架，包含两个可系统细化的组成部分：(1) 傅里叶模散射通道哈密顿量，在每个物理动量处给出局域谱和流-流关联量；(2) 不断扩展的伪布里渊区层级，通过精确的局域到全局关系将局域量转化为体相热力学观测量。
AI.result: 在Penrose和Ammann-Beenker模型中，该方法揭示出全能带动量分辨的准带结构以及赝能隙形成的多通道机制，这些超出了低能有效模型的范围。此外还解析了Zeeman驱动的能隙闭合与重开现象、量子化的Chern平台，以及体相谱和拓扑可观测量对phason的保持不变性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为准晶体的全能带谱与拓扑性质提供了一条统一的倒空间研究路径，克服了传统方法在准晶体中因缺乏平移对称性而面临的根本困难。

title: Static and Ensemble-Dependent Thermodynamics of the Strain-Induced Parity Anomaly in Gapped Graphene
summary: A static deformation of graphene can act on its Dirac electrons as a valley-odd magnetic field. In sublattice-gapped graphene this field makes the two valleys add in the parity-odd response rather than cancel. We derive the equilibrium thermodynamics of this effect and separate it from the finite-frequency transport response. At fixed electrochemical potential, reversing the pseudomagnetic field removes every nonzero pseudo-Landau level in the continuum theory. The remaining grand-potential difference is fixed by the spectrally asymmetric zeroth level. The static charge response is a thermally broadened plateau confined to the gap and has no metallic $m/|μ|$ tail. Near a band edge, pseudofield reversal transfers $\mathrm{B}\ln2$ of entropy per unsplit zero-mode state in the low-temperature window. The fixed-$μ$ heat capacity has two side lobes per edge and a universal peak $0.439229\,D_B k_{\mathrm B}$. We then formulate a definite constant-gate-voltage circuit and show that the measured sheet heat capacity depends on the electrical boundary condition. The full massive-Dirac density of states and an exact finite-field pseudo-Landau-level calculation give the same gate crossover in their common limit. At fixed carrier number, the low-temperature edge value is $-2(\ln2)^2 D_B k_{\mathrm B}$, rather than a node. A finite geometric capacitance gives a continuous and experimentally tunable interpolation. Finally, we give a trace-free triaxial strain geometry, a disorder--interaction window, and realistic calorimetric and quantum-capacitance scales. The field-reversal protocol isolates an equilibrium electromechanical anomaly without a real magnetic field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了石墨烯中赝磁场（valley-odd磁场）在子晶格间隙存在时的热力学效应，特别是静态赝磁场反转对电子热力学量的影响。
AI.motivation: 探究静态石墨烯形变产生的赝磁场如何影响Dirac电子，尤其是在子晶格间隙使其valley奇响应相加而非抵消的平衡热力学效应，并区分其与有限频率输运响应。
AI.method: 推导该效应的平衡热力学；利用赝磁场的反转去除连续理论中所有非零赝朗道能级，保留谱不对称的零级能级差异；通过巨势差分析静态电荷响应；并构造恒栅压电路以及完整的大质量Dirac态密度与精确有限场赝朗道能级计算来验证门控交叉行为。
AI.result: 静态电荷响应为局限于能隙内的热展宽平台，无金属m/|μ|尾部；在带边附近，赝场反转在低温窗口中传递每未分裂零模态Bln2的熵；固定μ热容每边有两个旁瓣，具有普适峰0.439229 D_B k_B；在固定载流子数时低温边缘值为-2(ln2)² D_B k_B而非节点；有限几何电容给出连续可调插值。
AI.conclusion: 赝场反转协议可以在无真实磁场的情况下隔离平衡电机械异常，并给出可实验实现的量热与量子电容尺度。

title: First-order Degenerate Symmetry-Adapted Perturbation Theory
summary: Degenerate electronic states govern the photophysics of excimers and the molecular dynamics near conical intersections. In regions where potential energy surfaces are degenerate or nearly degenerate, intermolecular interactions mix the corresponding electronic configurations. We introduce a first-order degenerate formulation of symmetry-adapted perturbation theory (dSAPT) with weak symmetry forcing that quantifies the mixing in terms of electrostatic and exchange (Pauli repulsion) contributions. We compare two alternative ways of resolving the degeneracy, in which antisymmetry is enforced either after or before diagonalization of the first-order eigenproblem. Using CASSCF monomer wave functions, we apply dSAPT to two model spatially degenerate systems, H$_2$--F(${}^2P$) and H$_2$--NO(${}^2Π$), and show that exchange effects contribute significantly to configuration mixing already at intermediate intermolecular separations. For the H$_2$--NO(${}^2Π$) complex, we further demonstrate that second-order dispersion energy is essential for qualitatively reproducing the angular dependence of the diabatic mixing angle. Finally, using water and benzene excimers with monomers described either by CASSCF or CIS wave functions, we show that Pauli repulsion controls delocalization of the excitation at short intermolecular separations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种一阶简并对称性适应微扰理论(dSAPT)，采用弱对称性强制来量化简并或近简并势能面区域中电子构型混合的静电和交换(Pauli排斥)贡献。该方法应用于H₂–F(²P)和H₂–NO(²Π)等模型系统，并进一步用于水和苯激基复合物，揭示交换效应在构型混合中的重要作用。
AI.motivation: 简并电子态在激基复合物的光物理和圆锥交叉附近的分子动力学中起核心作用。在势能面简并或近简并区域，分子间相互作用会混合相应的电子构型，但缺乏能够量化这种混合的物理贡献（静电与交换）的理论方法。
AI.method: 提出一阶简并SAPT(dSAPT)形式，采用弱对称性强制。比较了两种解决简并的途径：在反称化(antisymmetrization)分别在一阶本征问题对角化之后或之前施加。使用CASSCF单体波函数，对H₂–F(²P)和H₂–NO(²Π)两个空间简并模型体系进行应用，并以CASSCF或CIS波函数描述水和苯激基复合物单体。
AI.result: 在中等分子间分离距离下，交换效应对构型混合已有显著贡献。对于H₂–NO(²Π)复合物，二阶色散能对于定性再现绝热混合角的角依赖性是必需的。对于水和苯激基复合物，Pauli排斥在短距离下控制激发离域化。
AI.conclusion: dSAPT能够将简并态的构型混合分解为静电和交换贡献，揭示Pauli排斥和色散能分别在短距离和中等距离下对激基复合物中激发离域化及构型混合起关键作用，为理解简并电子态的光物理提供了定量分析工具。

title: NMR evidence of pressure-induced structural transition and enhanced spin fluctuations up to 14~GPa in SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$
summary: The Shastry-Sutherland compound SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ has attracted considerable interest as a platform for exploring quantum phases and quantum phase transitions driven by magnetic frustration. The pressure-induced structural and magnetic phase transitions in SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$, however, remain controversial. To address this issue, we performed high-pressure $^{11}$B nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) measurements on SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ up to 14~GPa. The NMR spectra reveal two pressure-induced monoclinic phases. With pressure above 4~GPa and with temperature below 10~K, the rapid broadening of the NMR spectrum and the power-law behavior in the spin-lattice relaxation rate $1/T_1$ provide clear evidence for a gapless 3D antiferromagnetic (AFM) phase in the monoclinic phase. At an intermediate temperature range around 20~K, the emergence of the field-dependent NMR line splits resolves a two-dimensional, short-range ordered AFM phase; at temperature above 30~K, the sublinear power-law behavior of $1/T_1$ identifies an extended correlated paramagnetic regime.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高压11B核磁共振(NMR)测量，在高达14 GPa的压力下研究了SrCu2(BO3)2的相变行为，发现了两种压力诱导的单斜相，并识别出无隙3D反铁磁相、二维短程有序反铁磁相以及扩展相关顺磁态等丰富的量子磁相。
AI.motivation: SrCu2(BO3)2作为研究磁阻挫驱动量子相和量子相变的重要平台备受关注，但其压力诱导的结构和磁性相变仍存在争议，需要通过实验手段进行澄清。
AI.method: 在高达14 GPa的压力下对SrCu2(BO3)2进行高压11B核磁共振(NMR)测量，通过分析NMR谱形、谱线展宽以及自旋-晶格弛豫率1/T1的温度和压力依赖行为来表征不同相。
AI.result: NMR谱显示存在两种压力诱导的单斜相。压力超过4 GPa且温度低于10 K时，NMR谱的快速展宽和1/T1的幂律行为表明单斜相中存在无隙3D反铁磁(AFM)相；在约20 K的中间温度区间，场依赖的NMR谱线分裂揭示了二维短程有序AFM相；温度高于30 K时，1/T1的亚线性幂律行为表明存在扩展的相关顺磁区。
AI.conclusion: 该研究澄清了SrCu2(BO3)2压力诱导相变的争议，揭示了从无隙3D反铁磁相到二维短程有序相再到相关顺磁态的丰富量子磁相图。

title: Reusable Operators for Irreducible Cartesian Tensor Decomposition and Coupling
summary: Molecular and material properties, from the polarizability to the elastic constants, are described by tensors. Their behavior under rotations is made explicit when a tensor is decomposed into irreducible parts that transform independently. In Cartesian form these parts are the symmetric and traceless irreducible Cartesian tensors (ICTs), whose decomposition and coupling underlie selection rules, orientational averages, and the use of symmetry. The decomposition is a textbook result at rank two, but higher rank and the intrinsic symmetry of physical tensors make it nontrivial. What has been lacking, unlike in the well-established spherical formalism, is a general construction for a given intrinsic symmetry, together with reusable operators that extract the ICTs and rebuild the original tensor exactly. Here, we develop such a construction and obtain these operators explicitly. These operators depend on rank and symmetry alone, and therefore each need only be built once and then applied to any tensor of that class. Building on them, we further obtain the Cartesian harmonics of a vector and the operators that couple two ICTs into a third, both central to equivariant machine learning. The construction is demonstrated on the elastic tensor, in both its second-order form of rank four and its third-order form of rank six. The ICTs of the rank-4 tensor also define a rotation- and scale-invariant measure of anisotropy, which we evaluate across the first-principles elastic tensors of crystalline materials from the Materials Project. The construction is implemented in the open-source package natto, which produces the operators in both exact symbolic and numerical form.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对任意本征对称性张量的不可约笛卡尔张量（ICTs）的一般性分解与重构构造方法，并显式给出了可复用的提取与重构算子。这些算子仅依赖于阶数和对称性，可广泛用于张量的旋转行为分析、选择定则、方向平均以及等变机器学习中的笛卡尔球谐与ICT耦合。作者将该方法应用于弹性张量（四阶和六阶），并基于Materials Project的第一性原理数据评估了各向异性度量，最终在开源包natto中实现。
AI.motivation: 二阶张量的不可约笛卡尔分解是教科书级结果，但更高阶张量以及具有本征对称性的物理张量的分解并非平凡。与成熟的球谐形式体系不同，笛卡尔形式缺乏针对给定本征对称性的一般构造方法，也缺少可复用的提取与重构算子。
AI.method: 作者针对给定本征对称性开发了一般性构造方案，显式推导出提取ICTs和精确重构原始张量的算子。这些算子只依赖于张量的阶数和对称性，因此可一次构造、重复使用。基于这些算子，进一步得到了矢量的笛卡尔球谐以及将两个ICTs耦合为第三个ICTs的算子。实现包含在开源包natto中，支持精确符号和数值两种形式的算子输出。
AI.result: 该方法在弹性张量的二阶形式（四阶张量）和三阶形式（六阶张量）上得到演示。四阶张量的ICTs还定义了一个旋转和尺度不变的各向异性度量，作者使用Materials Project中晶体的第一性原理弹性张量对其进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: 该构造填补了笛卡尔张量不可约分解在高阶和本征对称性情形下的空白，为物理张量分析、对称性应用以及等变机器学习提供了统一而可复用的工具。

title: $^{139}$La nuclear quadrupole resonance studies of pressurized La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$
summary: Density-wave (DW) orders are considered as competing orders to unconventional superconductivity and are commonly seen in a variety of superconductors including but not limited to the recently discovered Ruddlesden-Popper-phase nickelates. By utilizing $^{139}$La nuclear quadrupole resonance, we systematically investigate into the nature of DW orders and their evolution under pressure in La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. Spin and charge DW orders are found to be intertwined in this material, which is in stark contrast to those in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. Short-range DW orders are observed near 150 K, well above the development of long-range DW orders at around 139 K. Upon applying a hydrostatic pressure of 2.3 GPa, the transition temperatures of the short-range and long-range orders decrease at rates of 1 K/GPa and 10 K/GPa, respectively. Our results thus affirm that both spin density wave and charge density wave as competing orders with the superconducting state in La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$, and provide new insights into the interplay between DW orders and unconventional superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过$^{139}$La核四极共振（NQR）系统研究了La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$中密度波（DW）序的性质及其在压力下的演化。研究发现该材料中自旋密度波和电荷密度波相互交织，短程DW序在150 K附近出现，远高于139 K左右的长程DW序形成温度。施加2.3 GPa静水压后，短程和长程相变温度分别以1 K/GPa和10 K/GPa的速率下降。结果表明自旋密度波和电荷密度波都是La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$中超导态的竞争序。
AI.motivation: 密度波序被认为是超导的竞争序，常见于多种超导体中，包括新发现的Ruddlesden-Popper相镍氧化物。理解密度波序的性质及其与超导的相互作用，对于揭示非常规超导机理至关重要。
AI.method: 利用$^{139}$La核四极共振（NQR）技术，系统研究La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$中密度波序的本质及其随压力演化的行为，并施加2.3 GPa的静水压观测相变温度变化。
AI.result: 发现自旋和电荷密度波序在该材料中相互交织（与La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$形成鲜明对比）；短程DW序在约150 K出现，高于长程DW序形成温度（约139 K）；施加2.3 GPa压力后，短程和长程序的转变温度分别以1 K/GPa和10 K/GPa的速率降低。
AI.conclusion: 实验证实自旋密度波和电荷密度波均为La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$中超导态的竞争序，为理解密度波序与非常规超导之间的相互作用提供了新见解。

title: Relaxation of Sliding Friction from a Statistical Model of Aging Contacts
summary: Frictional relaxation after a sudden velocity change underlies the phenomenological laws that describe the stability of steady sliding and of seismic faults. To connect this relaxation with measurable statistics of microscopic contacts, we introduce a minimal model incorporating logarithmic aging of contact forces and a power-law contact-size distribution reflecting fractal interface roughness, and derive the relaxation function analytically. Depending on the power-law exponent $α$, the intermediate-time response exhibits a plateau, logarithmic decay, or power-law decay, in contrast to the exponential decay assumed in the phenomenological laws. The theory provides experimentally testable links between microscopic contact statistics and macroscopic frictional relaxation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个最小模型，将摩擦松弛与微观接触统计联系起来，推导出松弛函数的解析表达式，发现中间时间响应根据接触尺寸幂律指数 α 呈现平台、对数衰减或幂律衰减，而非现象学定律假定的指数衰减。
AI.motivation: 摩擦松弛是理解稳态滑动和地震断层稳定性的基础，但现有的现象学定律只假设了指数衰减，缺乏与微观接触统计的直接联系。作者希望通过可测量的接触统计来连接微观机理与宏观摩擦松弛行为。
AI.method: 构建了一个最小模型，融合两个关键要素：(1) 接触力的对数老化；(2) 反映分形界面粗糙度的幂律接触尺寸分布。基于此推导出摩擦松弛函数的解析表达式，依据幂律指数 α 对中间时间响应进行分类。
AI.result: 解析结果揭示了三种不同的中间时间响应行为：随 α 的取值不同，松弛可表现为平台、对数衰减或幂律衰减。这与传统现象学摩擦定律中假设的指数衰减存在本质差异。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为微观接触统计与宏观摩擦松弛之间提供了实验上可验证的联系，加深了对摩擦松弛微观机制的理解，对地震断层稳定性等应用具有潜在意义。

title: Mixed quantum-classical evolution in open molecular systems
summary: We consider a mixed quantum-classical formulation for open nonequilibrium molecular systems. We employ the pseudoparticle nonequilibrium Green's function (PP-NEGF) method as a fully quantum description and a starting point for introducing classical nuclear dynamics for an open system. We use this formulation to derive a density-matrix equation of motion describing the quantum-classical evolution. We compare our results with previous formulations and highlight important differences related to the nonequilibrium and open character of the molecular system. We also analyze the approximations needed to reduce full quantum-classical dynamics to the fewest-switches surface hopping (FSSH) method and show that these approximations are unreasonable when adiabatic surfaces come close to each other.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了开放非平衡分子系统的混合量子-经典描述方法，以赝粒子非平衡格林函数（PP-NEGF）方法为完全量子起点，推导出描述量子-经典演化的密度矩阵运动方程，并与先前公式进行比较，分析了从完整量子-经典动力学简化为最少切换面跳跃（FSSH）方法所需近似的合理性。
AI.motivation: 开放非平衡分子系统的量子-经典混合描述是理解复杂化学与材料过程的关键，但现有方法在非平衡和开放条件下存在一致性缺陷，需要从严格量子理论出发建立可靠的理论框架。
AI.method: 以PP-NEGF方法作为完全量子描述基础，引入开放系统的经典核动力学，推导密度矩阵运动方程，系统地比较与先前公式的差异，并分析将完整量子-经典动力学约化为FSSH方法时所需的各种近似的有效性。
AI.result: 推导出描述量子-经典演化的密度矩阵运动方程，揭示了与已有公式在非平衡和开放特征相关的重要区别；证明FSSH约化所需的近似在绝热面相互靠近时不成立，因而不合理。
AI.conclusion: PP-NEGF提供了一个严格的量子框架来构建开放非平衡体系的量子-经典动力学；现有FSSH方法在处理近平滑交叉/接近的绝热面时缺乏严格的理论基础，需要发展更精确的方法。

title: Electronic correlations and fluctuating lattice distortions in vanadium dioxide
summary: Metal-insulator transitions in correlated materials are often accompanied by a change of crystal structure. They are commonly described within a coherent lattice approximation, which combines a correlated treatment of the electrons with a lattice represented by one or a few classical distortion coordinates fixed by minimizing an energy. The structural degrees of freedom then carry no entropy of their own, even though the partition of the transition entropy between electrons and lattice is often what decides the transition temperature. Here we develop a stochastic semiclassical extension of dynamical mean-field theory in which correlated electrons and fluctuating lattice distortions are evolved together, extending previous formulations from linear to nonlinear electron-phonon interactions and from a single to several coupled lattice modes. The resulting non-conservative Langevin equations have deterministic forces, damping, and correlated noise generated self-consistently by the interacting electronic subsystem. Applying the approach to a minimal two-orbital model containing the two symmetry-distinct distortions of the monoclinic phase of vanadium dioxide, we find that the two distortions melt at well separated temperatures, giving an insulating, an intermediate metallic, and a high-symmetry phase. The two transitions have different origins: the melting of the dimerization is driven by the coupling to the correlated electrons and is captured already within the coherent lattice approximation, whereas the restoration of the undistorted structure requires the entropy of the fluctuating lattice. Since the electronic subsystem is treated within nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory, the framework can be extended in future work to photoexcited systems with nonthermal electronic distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种随机半经典动力学平均场理论的扩展方法，使得关联电子与涨落晶格畸变能够共同演化。该方法将此前从线性扩展到非线性电子-声子相互作用，并从单一扩展到多个耦合晶格模式。将其应用于二氧化钒单斜相的两轨道最小模型，发现两种畸变在明显不同的温度下熔化，产生绝缘、中间金属和高对称三个相，且两个转变具有不同起源。
AI.motivation: 关联材料中的金属-绝缘体转变常伴随晶体结构变化。传统相干晶格近似中，结构自由度不携带自身熵，但转变熵在电子与晶格间的分配往往决定了转变温度。因此需要一种能自洽处理电子关联和涨落晶格、且能区分电子与晶格熵贡献的理论框架。
AI.method: 开发动力学平均场理论的随机半经典扩展：关联电子与涨落晶格畸变共同演化。将先前公式从线性推广到非线性电子-声子耦合，从单一模式推广到多个耦合晶格模式。推导出非保守的Langevin方程，其确定性力、阻尼和相关噪声由相互作用的电子子系统自洽产生。电子子系统采用非平衡动力学平均场理论处理。
AI.result: 应用于二氧化钒单斜相双轨道模型时，两种畸变（二聚化和结构复原）在不同温度熔化，产生三个相：绝缘相、中间金属相和高对称相。二聚化熔化由与关联电子的耦合驱动，相干晶格近似已可捕捉；而高对称结构复原需要涨落晶格的熵贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该框架说明了晶格涨落熵在驱动结构转变中的关键作用，指出不同结构畸变可有来源各异的熔化机制。由于电子子系统采用非平衡动力学平均场理论，该方法可扩展至未来光激发、电子非热分布体系的研究。

title: Oxidation of Tantalum Nano-Film by Microwave Exposure
summary: Oxidation and ablation of 200 nm tantalum films were carried out by three routes: (i) femtosecond (fs-)laser direct write, (ii) high-temperature annealing (HTA) in a tube furnace, and (iii) annealing in a 2.45 GHz microwave cavity. Complete conversion of the 200 nm Ta layer into 409 nm of Ta2O5 required one hour at 600 C in the furnace, but only minutes at ~ 50 W of microwave power. Fs-laser (515 nm/200 fs) oxidation of the Ta nano-film set in at an average single-pulse fluence of ~ 0.1 J/cm2 under strong pulse-to-pulse overlap (900 pulses per focal spot), i.e. within a narrow window bounded from above by the onset of ablation. Under microwave annealing, both the cavity resonance frequency and the quality factor Q changed markedly at the metal-to-oxide transition, reflecting the collapse of the real and imaginary parts of the permittivity at 2.45 GHz. This dielectric contrast turns the cavity into a sensor: the oxidation can be followed in real time from the shift of the cavity resonance, providing a non-invasive, in-situ diagnostic tool.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了200纳米钽薄膜氧化为Ta2O5的三种途径：飞秒激光直写、高温管式炉退火和2.45 GHz微波退火。发现微波退火效率远高于传统炉退火（数分钟vs1小时），且可通过腔体共振频率和质量因子的变化实时监测金属-氧化物转变过程，将微波腔转化为非侵入性的原位传感器。
AI.motivation: 探索不同氧化方法对钽薄膜氧化为Ta2O5的效率差异，并利用钽与Ta2O5在微波频率下介电常数的显著差异，开发一种实时、非侵入式的氧化过程原位监测手段。
AI.method: 采用三种氧化途径：(i) 515 nm/200 fs飞秒激光直写（在脉冲重叠900脉冲/焦斑条件下寻找氧化窗口）；(ii) 600°C管式炉高温退火；(iii) 2.45 GHz微波腔退火（约50 W功率）。通过监测腔体共振频率和Q因子变化追踪金属-氧化物转变。
AI.result: 管式炉600°C需1小时完成200nm Ta到409nm Ta2O5的完全转化；微波退火仅需数分钟。飞秒激光氧化起始于约0.1 J/cm²的平均单脉冲通量（上界受烧蚀阈值限制）。微波退火中，腔体共振频率和Q因子在金属-氧化物转变时发生显著变化，反映了在2.45 GHz下介电常数实部和虚部的塌缩。
AI.conclusion: 微波退火是一种高效的钽氧化方法，且由钽与Ta2O5的介电对比所驱动的腔体共振位移可作为实时监测氧化过程、提供非侵入原位诊断的工具。

title: Discovery of Superconductivity in a Bulk Moire Superlattice Material
summary: Moire materials provide a versatile platform realizing emergent electronic states arising from enhanced correlation due to flat bands. A variety of phenomena including superconductivity, low dimensional ferromagnetism, Mott insulating phase, topological phenomena have been reported in such systems. To date, moire phenomena have been predominantly explored in artificially assembled low-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures, where relative twist and lattice alignment are controlled during device fabrication. Recently, intrinsically grown bulk moire crystals have emerged as a complementary materials platform, in which lattice mismatch between constituent layers generates a coherent moire superlattice throughout the bulk crystal. Here we report the evidence of bulk superconductivity in single crystals of a recently reported bulk Moire materials (Sr6TaS8)1+x(TaS2)8 under ambient pressure conditions. The material exhibits a superconducting transition at Tc = 2.5 K, evidenced consistently by electrical transport, magnetic susceptibility, and heat-capacity measurements on single-crystal and polycrystalline samples. Transport measurements reveal a pronounced anomaly near 270 K, suggestive of a charge-density-wave transition in this moire system. The observation of bulk superconductivity establishes superconductivity as an emergent phase in this intrinsically synthesized moire material and highlights bulk moire crystals as a promising platform for investigating correlated quantum phenomena beyond artificially assembled two-dimensional heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在天然生长的块体莫尔材料(Sr6TaS8)1+x(TaS2)8单晶中发现了体超导电性，Tc = 2.5 K，通过电输运、磁化率和比热等多种测量手段得到验证。该材料还表现出约270 K处疑似电荷密度波转变的异常现象，证明天然块体莫尔晶体是研究关联量子现象的新兴平台。
AI.motivation: 莫尔材料因其平带导致的增强关联效应而能产生多种量子现象（超导、铁磁、莫特绝缘体等），但此前研究主要局限于人工组装的二维范德华异质结，制备工艺复杂、尺寸有限。因此有必要探索天然生长的块体莫尔晶体的潜力，以拓展莫尔物理的研究平台。
AI.method: 研究采用天然生长的块体莫尔晶体(Sr6TaS8)1+x(TaS2)8，其中层间晶格失配在整块晶体中产生相干莫尔超晶格。作者通过电输运、磁化率（SQUID）和比热测量，在单晶和多晶样品上系统表征了该材料在常压下的超导转变及可能的电荷密度波转变。
AI.result: 该块体莫尔材料在常压下表现出Tc = 2.5 K的体超导电性，由电输运、磁化率和比热三种测量手段一致证实。此外，输运测量在约270 K处发现显著异常，暗示该莫尔体系中可能存在电荷密度波转变。
AI.conclusion: 块体莫尔单晶中体超导电性的发现确立了超导是这类内在合成莫尔材料的一种涌现相，表明天然块体莫尔晶体是超越人工组装二维异质结、研究关联量子现象的有前景平台。

title: Irreversibility of many-body harmonic oscillators characterized by generalized Husimi's adiabaticity parameter
summary: In a classical paper [K. Husimi, Prog. Theor. Phys. 9, 381 (1953)], Husimi showed that, for a single harmonic oscillator with a time-dependent angular frequency and initial conditions sampled from an equilibrium distribution, the averaged energy cannot decrease after a cyclic operation. This irreversibility is quantified by Husimi's adiabaticity parameter constituted with adiabatic invariants. In this work, we generalize Husimi's framework to a many-body system of one-dimensional harmonic oscillators coupled on an arbitrary connected network, with all spring constants sharing a common time dependence. For a system attached to a fixed wall, the dynamics can be decomposed into independent normal modes by transforming to mass-weighted coordinates and diagonalizing the resulting positive definite matrix, with each mode characterized by its own Husimi's adiabaticity parameter. By defining the generalized Husimi's adiabaticity parameter as their arithmetic mean, we derive the exact time evolution of the averaged energy and establish its non-decrease under cyclic operations. Numerical simulations confirm these results for both a uniform nearest-neighbor chain and a heterogeneous network.

AI.tldr: 本文将Husimi关于单谐振子在循环操作下平均能量不可减少的经典框架推广到任意连通网络上的多体一维耦合谐振子系统。通过质量加权坐标变换和矩阵对角化将动力学分解为独立简正模式，定义广义Husimi绝热参数为各模式参数的算术平均，推导了平均能量的精确时间演化并证明其在循环操作下的非递减性，数值模拟验证了均匀最近邻链和异构网络两种情况。
AI.motivation: Husimi的开创性工作证明了单谐振子在循环操作下能量不可减少的非可逆性，但这一框架尚未推广到多体耦合系统。作者希望将这一不可逆性量化框架从单粒子系统扩展到更一般的多体网络上，以理解复杂耦合系统中类似的非平衡热力学行为。
AI.method: 将系统变换到质量加权坐标并对角化得到正定矩阵，将多体动力学分解为独立的简正模式；每个模式具有各自的Husimi绝热参数，定义广义Husimi绝热参数为所有模式参数的算术平均；基于此推导平均能量在循环操作下的精确时间演化，并证明其非递减性。
AI.result: 推导出广义Husimi框架下平均能量的精确时间演化公式，证明了在循环操作下平均能量不会减少；数值模拟对均匀最近邻链和异构网络均确认了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: Husimi的不可逆性框架可以自然地推广到任意连通网络上的多体耦合谐振子系统，系统在循环操作下的平均能量非递减性依然成立，为多体系统的绝热不可逆性研究提供了普适的理论框架。

title: Emergent Equilibrium Structure Along a Critical Cluster Recursion
summary: Critical universality does not determine the microscopic conditional structure of a probability measure. We study a bicolored cluster recursion constrained to remain critical at every generation, with no equilibrium spin measure or fixed coupling imposed. In both two and three dimensions, the resulting history-dependent sequence develops a common Ising/Fortuin--Kasteleyn (FK) compatibility structure: the second-shell dependence of a one-site conditional law is strongly suppressed, nearest-neighbor effective couplings move progressively toward one another near the critical Ising value, and cluster and interface observables organize around the corresponding FK geometry. An exact cluster-coloring factorization singles out $q=2$ as the point where the residual connectivity weight disappears from the two-color spin marginal. Thus equilibrium-compatible conditional structure can emerge along a trajectory that remains critical throughout.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了临界普适性并不决定概率测度的微观条件结构。作者研究了一种在每一代都保持临界的双色团簇递推，不施加平衡自旋测度或固定耦合。在二维和三维中，这种依赖于历史的序列发展出共同的Ising/Fortuin-Kasteleyn兼容结构：单位点条件律的第二壳层依赖被强烈抑制，近邻有效耦合逐渐向临界Ising值靠拢，团簇与界面可观测量围绕相应FK几何组织。精确的团簇着色因子分解表明q=2是残差连通权重从双色自旋边缘消失的特殊点。因此，平衡兼容的条件结构可以沿一条始终临界的轨迹涌现。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在探究临界普适性对微观概率结构约束的极限——即临界点本身不唯一决定条件结构，从而回答一个更深层的问题：在没有任何平衡约束的前提下，纯粹保持"临界"这一动力学要求是否足以自然涌现出平衡Ising/FK系统的微观结构。
AI.method: 采用双色团簇递推方法，要求系统在每一代生成中始终保持临界状态（不施加固定耦合或平衡测度），通过分析条件概率的第二壳层依赖、近邻有效耦合演化以及团簇/界面可观测量，考察其与Ising/FK几何结构的相容性，并利用团簇着色因子分解在q=2处的特殊性质进行精确分析。
AI.result: 在二维和三维中，该临界递推序列自发形成了与平衡Ising/FK系统共享的结构特征：第二壳层依赖被强烈抑制、近邻耦合向临界Ising值趋同、团簇和界面可观测量遵循FK几何。精确的团簇着色因子分解揭示了q=2处残差连通权重恰好从双色自旋边缘中消失。
AI.conclusion: 平衡兼容的条件微观结构可以在不预设平衡条件的情况下，仅通过要求每一代保持临界而自发涌现。这揭示了临界性的动力学约束本身具有塑造微观结构的强大能力，且q=2（Ising）在此框架中扮演了特殊角色。

title: Purely Electric-Field Control of Topological Magnetism in Two-Dimensional Magnets
summary: Electrical control of topological magnetism is central to realizing energy-efficient topological spintronics. Yet most electric-field approaches modify the competing magnetic interactions through a nonselective rearrangement of low-energy electronic states, yielding coarse magnetic phase control that often requires external magnetic fields to stabilize topological quasiparticles, while few schemes solely based on electric fields are restricted to specific conducting materials. Here, we establish a general approach for purely electric-field control of topological magnetism, in which an applied electric field electrostatically dopes a selected orbital-angular-momentum-polarized band edge of a two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnetic semiconductor via proximity to an adjacent nonmagnetic vdW metal. We show that the resulting electrostatic doping predominantly tunes magnetic anisotropy of the 2D magnet, while leaving exchange interaction and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction nearly unchanged, thereby reversibly driving the system through ferromagnetic, skyrmion, spiral, and bimeron phases. We demonstrate this mechanism for CrBr3/graphene and Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2 vdW heterostructures hosting electron and hole pockets of different orbital characters. These results establish a broadly applicable strategy for purely electric-field control in topological spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过纯电场控制二维范德华磁性半导体拓扑磁性的普适方法，利用邻近非磁性金属的静电掺杂来选择性地调控特定轨道角动量极化能带边缘，从而主要调节磁各向异性，实现铁磁、斯格明子、螺旋和双子（bimeron）相的可逆切换。
AI.motivation: 现有的电场调控拓扑磁性的方法大多通过非选择性地重整低能电子态来改变竞争性磁相互作用，导致磁相控制粗糙且常需外加磁场稳定拓扑准粒子；少数纯电场方案仅限于特定导电材料。因此需要一种普适的纯电场控制拓扑磁性的策略。
AI.method: 通过将二维范德华磁性半导体与相邻非磁性范德华金属接触，施加电场进行静电掺杂，选择性地掺杂具有特定轨道角动量极化的带边电子态。这种静电掺杂主要调控磁各向异性，而几乎不影响交换相互作用和Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，从而在铁磁、斯格明子、螺旋和双子相之间可逆驱动。
AI.result: 在CrBr3/石墨烯和Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2范德华异质结构中验证了该机制，这些体系分别拥有不同轨道特征的电子和空穴口袋。实验和理论表明纯电场能够可逆地切换多种拓扑磁相。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一种广泛适用的纯电场控制拓扑磁性的策略，为能效高的拓扑自旋电子学器件提供了新的设计范式。

title: Strong Evidence for Formation of Hydroxyl Anion via 2-Particle-1-Hole Feshbach Resonances
summary: This study investigates the formation of the hydroxyl anion (OH$^-$) via dissociative electron attachment in 2-propanol as a model system for studying both organic and inorganic molecules. Using high-level CAP-EOM-EA-CCSD calculations and advanced ToF mass spectrometry, we demonstrate that OH$^-$ formation at electron energies between 7 and 11 eV is dominated by two-particle-one-hole (2p-1h) Feshbach resonances. The potential-energy curves reveal a dense manifold of anionic states coupled through numerous avoided crossings, facilitating nonadiabatic population transfer during C-OH bond dissociation. Survival-probability analysis identifies a subset of six long-lived resonances that persist long enough to drive fragmentation, with states 25 and 28 acting as primary drivers by funneling the attached electron into the localized $σ^*(\mathrm{C{-}OH})$ antibonding orbital. These theoretical predictions are confirmed by experimental observations of a prominent OH$^-$ yield peaking at 8.6 eV, supporting a site-specific fragmentation mechanism that generalizes to the broader class of molecules.

AI.tldr: 本研究以2-丙醇为模型体系，结合高精度CAP-EEM-EA-CCSD计算和飞行时间质谱实验，揭示了OH⁻离子在7-11 eV电子能量范围内的形成主要由2p-1h Feshbach共振主导。通过势能曲线分析识别出大量阴离子态耦合与避免交叉，促进非绝热布居转移。存活概率分析锁定6个长寿命共振态，其中态25和28通过将电子注入局部σ*(C-OH)反键轨道驱动裂解，实验观测到8.6 eV处的显著OH⁻产率峰值证实了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 理解有机和无机分子中OH⁻离子的解离电子附着形成机制，为更广泛的分子类别建立位点特异性裂解模型。
AI.method: 结合CAP-EOM-EA-CCSD高精度从头算方法和飞行时间(ToF)质谱实验，利用势能曲线分析、避免交叉识别及存活概率计算来研究2-丙醇中OH⁻形成的动力学机制。
AI.result: 鉴定出2p-1h Feshbach共振主导OH⁻形成；识别出6个长寿命共振态，其中态25和28为主要驱动者；实验确认8.6 eV处存在显著OH⁻产率峰值，与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: OH⁻通过位点特异性裂解机制形成，理论预测与实验观测高度吻合，该机制可推广到更广泛的有机和无机分子类别。

title: Ginzburg-Landau Theory for Non-Invertible Symmetry-Breaking Transitions
summary: Recently, a generalized Landau paradigm has been proposed, in which a broad class of "unconventional" phase transitions lying beyond the original symmetry-breaking framework of Landau are understood as the symmetry-breaking transitions of generalized symmetries. In particular, in (1+1)D, such "topological" or "deconfined" transitions can be mapped to the symmetry-breaking transitions of non-invertible symmetries. How to extract the universal dynamical properties of the transitions from this understanding? In this paper, we follow the Ginzburg-Landau philosophy and develop a field-theoretic description of such critical points in terms of the fluctuations of local order parameters, now of non-invertible symmetries. The Symmetry Topological Field Theory formalism plays a central role in our analysis, allowing us to identify the algebra of local order parameters from the Lagrangian algebra of a (2+1)D topological order. We illustrate the key ideas and the full steps of this generalized Ginzburg-Landau procedure using the transitions between gapped phases with a simple non-invertible symmetry --- the Rep($S_3$) symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文遵循Ginzburg-Landau哲学，为广义Landau范式中的非传统相变（如拓扑相变、去禁闭相变）发展了一套场论描述方法。这些相变被理解为非可逆对称性的对称性破缺转变，作者利用对称拓扑场论（SymTFT）形式，通过(2+1)维拓扑序的Lagrangian代数来识别局域序参数的代数。他们以Rep(S₃)对称性为例，完整展示了这一广义Ginzburg-Landau方法的关键步骤。
AI.motivation: 广义Landau范式提出后，许多超出传统对称性破缺框架的"非传统"相变可以被理解为广义对称性的对称性破缺转变。在(1+1)维中，这些拓扑或去禁闭相变可映射为非可逆对称性的对称性破缺转变。但如何从中提取这些转变的普适动力学性质仍不清楚，需要建立相应的场论描述框架。
AI.method: 作者采用Ginzburg-Landau方法的精神，基于非可逆对称性的局域序参数涨落来构建临界点的场论描述。关键在于利用对称拓扑场论（SymTFT）形式主义——从(2+1)维拓扑序的Lagrangian代数中识别出局域序参数的代数结构，从而系统化地构造广义Ginzburg-Landau理论。
AI.result: 作者以具有简单非可逆对称性Rep(S₃)的间隙相之间的转变为具体范例，完整展示了广义Ginzburg-Landau方法的核心思想和全部步骤，验证了该方法的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作建立了从非可逆对称性理解出发提取相变普适动力学性质的场论框架，将Ginzburg-Landau哲学推广到广义Landau范式的范畴，为研究非传统相变的动力学性质提供了系统化的理论工具。

title: Elucidating Guest-Host Mechanisms in ZIF-L for Tuneable Highly Luminescent 2D Materials
summary: 3D metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are well known effective hosts for luminescent guests that improve tuneability, photostability and material fabricability. 2D guest@MOF systems, while less explored, offer competitive advantages over 3D guest@MOF systems due to their optical transparency, inter-layer spacing, and vertical thinness. This work examines luminescent organic dyes@ZIF-L to establish the underlying mechanisms of guest incorporation in ZIF-L and demonstrate the advantages of the 2D ZIF-L architecture for the material's functional luminescence. Analysing a case study system, fluorescein@ZIF-L (F@ZIF-L), using nanoscale FTIR, diffraction, and topology mapping, confirmed that fluorescein (F) resided in the ZIF-L framework cavities. Supported by surface energy simulations, the extent of guest incorporation was found to be indicated by a morphological continuum, from the characteristic leaf-shaped ZIF-L to rectangular F@ZIF-L. By modifying synthesis temperature and solvent ratios, the luminescent properties of F@ZIF-L could be rationally tuned in terms of guest loading (% mol) and arrangement (i.e. guest monomer to aggregate ratio). When optimised, F@ZIF-L exhibited tuneable emission chromaticity, 99.7% photoluminescent quantum yield, minimal guest leaching in solution over 12 months, and high photostability. Perylene@ZIF-L exhibited unique white light emitting properties, with CIE coordinates (0.33, 0.34) arising from a combination of yellow alpha-phase excimer and blue monomeric perylene emission. Finally, oriented luminescent thin films of guest@ZIF-L materials were grown on malleable Zn foils, demonstrating an in situ fabrication technique. Together, the work highlights the potential for luminescent dye@ZIF-L systems in developing tuneable and resilient luminescent components of next-generation optoelectronics, sensors, and lighting systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统探究了荧光有机染料掺入二维MOF材料ZIF-L中的机制，以荧光素@ZIF-L为案例，通过纳米FTIR、衍射和拓扑映射等手段证实染料位于框架空腔中。通过调控合成温度与溶剂比例，可理性调控客体的负载量与排列方式（单体/聚集体比），实现可调发射色度、99.7%的PLQY、12个月内几乎无泄漏及高光稳定性。芘@ZIF-L还展现出独特的白光发射特性（CIE 0.33, 0.34）。最后在可塑锌箔上原位生长取向发光薄膜，展示了2D guest@MOF体系在光电子、传感器和照明领域的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 3D MOF作为发光客体宿主已被广泛研究，但2D guest@MOF体系研究较少，尽管其具有光学透明性、层间距和垂直薄度等独特优势。作者旨在建立染料掺入2D ZIF-L的基础机制，并展示2D ZIF-L架构在功能性发光材料上的优势。
AI.method: 以荧光素@ZIF-L（F@ZIF-L）为案例系统，结合纳米尺度FTIR、衍射和拓扑映射确认荧光素位于ZIF-L框架空腔；通过表面能模拟阐明客体掺入程度与形态演变（从叶片状ZIF-L到矩形F@ZIF-L）的关系；通过调节合成温度和溶剂比例调控客体负载量及单体/聚集体比例；并发展在锌箔上原位生长取向发光薄膜的制备技术。
AI.result: 证实荧光素嵌入ZIF-L空腔；通过合成条件可理性调节发光性质；优化后的F@ZIF-L达到99.7%的PLQY、12个月内几乎无客体泄漏和高光稳定性；芘@ZIF-L通过黄相激基缔合物与蓝光单体发射组合实现CIE坐标(0.33,0.34)的白光发射；成功在可塑锌箔上生长取向发光薄膜。
AI.conclusion: 二维ZIF-L架构作为发光染料宿主具有显著优势，可实现可调、稳定且可加工的发光功能。该工作凸显了发光染料@ZIF-L体系在下一代光电子器件、传感器和照明系统中开发可调且坚韧发光组件的潜力。

title: Symmetry-selective field-induced triplet superconductivity in Ising-superconductor monolayer NbSe$_2$
summary: We investigate superconductivity in monolayer NbSe$_2$, an Ising superconductor, under an in-plane Zeeman field $h_x$, focusing on the emergence of symmetry selected equal-spin triplet pairing. Using a self-consistent Bogoliubov--de Gennes approach with realistic hopping parameters for monolayer NbSe$_2$ on a triangular lattice, we determine the energetically favored singlet pairing states in a range of chemical potentials $μ$ for onsite, nearest-neighbor, and next-nearest-neighbor pairing channels, and map the resulting phase diagram in $(h_x,μ)$ plane. A momentum-resolved analysis reveals distinct dominant contributions in order parameters arise from the surroundings of $Γ$, $K$, and $K'$ points of the Brillouin zone. We find that an in-plane magnetic field helps to induce a triplet pairing whose symmetry is determined by the parent singlet state, upon opening the triplet interaction channel. For the nonlocal pairing channels, chiral-$d$ pairing is energetically favored and it induces chiral-$p$ equal-spin triplet component with opposite chirality. We further find that Rashba spin-orbit coupling, relevant to substrate coupling and electrostatic gating, suppresses the superconducting orders and reduces the critical field. Our results establish a direct link between the symmetry of the parent singlet condensate and the emergent triplet superconductivity, highlighting monolayer NbSe$_2$ as a promising platform for field-tunable mixed-parity superconducting states.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自洽Bogoliubov–de Gennes方法，系统地研究了单层NbSe₂在面内塞曼场下的超导性质，揭示了对称性选择的自旋三重态配对机制，建立了母体单重态与涌现三重态之间的直接联系。
AI.motivation: 理解Ising超导体在面内磁场下如何从单重态配对转变为等自旋三重态配对，并探索混合宇称超导态的可能性，为场可调的奇偶混合超导态提供理论平台。
AI.method: 采用自洽Bogoliubov–de Gennes方法，在三角晶格上使用单层NbSe₂的现实跳迁参数，对on-site、最近邻、次近邻配对通道在不同化学势下求解能量最优的单重态配对态，并逐步开启三重态相互作用通道来研究磁场诱导的三重态配对。
AI.result: 研究发现面内磁场可诱导与母体单重态对称性相关联的三重态配对；非局域配对通道中手性-d配对能量上占优，并诱导出相反手性的手性-p等自旋三重态分量；Rashba自旋轨道耦合会抑制超导序并降低临界场；动量分辨分析显示Γ、K、K'点附近的序参量贡献各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了母体单重态凝聚体的对称性与其诱导的三重态超导之间的直接对应关系，表明单层NbSe₂是研究场可调混合宇称超导态的理想平台。

title: Probing magnetic correlations in space and time within predefined topological sectors of a macroscopic spin liquid
summary: The triangular Ising antiferromagnet, with its residual entropy density and critical correlations at absolute zero, is the archetype of a two-dimensional spin liquid. Its ground state is partitioned into topological sectors connected by global spin flip events that wrap the lattice boundaries, and become statistically irrelevant in the thermodynamic limit where magnetic fluctuations are restricted to the dominant sector. Thus far, these properties have been mainly investigated from a theoretical perspective, and one might wonder to what extent they can be transposed to real materials. Here, we present experimental observations obtained in an artificial, macroscopic realisation of the seminal triangular Ising antiferromagnet that consists of a lattice of millimeter-sized NdFeB cylinders put into motion by a mechanical shaker. Specifically, we demonstrate that the very-low-energy physics and the true ground state of this model can be reached experimentally. Besides, we are able to probe, in space and time, the magnetic properties within manually preselected pockets of the ground-state manifold that emulate, to a good approximation, the behaviour in distinct topological sectors. Our approach opens new avenues for naked-eye visualisation and hand manipulation of many-body phenomena associated to frustrated magnetism and models of statistical physics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过毫米级NdFeB圆柱构成的机械振动人工晶格，在宏观尺度上实验实现了三角Ising反铁磁体，成功触及其极低能物理和真正基态，并能通过手动预选基态流形中的口袋来模拟不同拓扑扇区中的磁性质，为裸眼可视化和手工操控受挫磁性的多体现象开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 三角Ising反铁磁体是二维自旋液体的原型，具有残余熵密度和零温临界关联，其基态被划分为由全局自旋翻转事件连接的拓扑扇区，但这些性质主要停留在理论层面，作者希望探究这些理论性质能否在真实材料中被实验证实和可视化。
AI.method: 构建人工宏观模型：由毫米级NdFeB圆柱组成三角晶格，通过机械振动使圆柱运动以实现磁矩翻转，在实验室尺度重现三角Ising反铁磁体的统计物理行为，并可手动选择基态流形中的特定区域以模拟不同拓扑扇区的行为。
AI.result: 实验成功达到了该模型的极低能物理条件和真实基态；能够在空间和时间上探测手动预选基态口袋内部的磁性质，这些口袋很好地近似模拟了不同拓扑扇区的行为表现。
AI.conclusion: 该人工宏观系统证明了理论上关于三角Ising反铁磁体中拓扑扇区等特性可以被转置到实际物理系统，提供了裸眼可视化和手工操控受挫磁性强关联多体现象的新途径，为统计物理和受挫磁性模型的实验研究打开了新方向。

title: Continuum Limit of Nonlocal Electrostatics in Random Media
summary: We derive a two-scale continuum limit for the electrostatic energy of random charge density fields that are stationary and ergodic under lattice translations. Each microscopic cell is charge neutral in every realization, while its dipole moment may fluctuate and have a nonzero mean. Under assumptions on the stationary microscopic potential and the finite-volume fields, the local and nonlocal energies converge almost surely to deterministic limits. The local limit consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic Coulomb energy and a cell-depolarization term, whereas the effective polarization determines the nonlocal limit. The cell-depolarization terms cancel in the total energy, which consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic cell energy and the macroscopic electrostatic field energy. The deterministic specialization recovers the periodic two-scale limit. For an independent-cell random-displacement model, we verify the assumptions of the continuum-limit theorem and show that centered microscopic fluctuations can change the local energy without changing the effective polarization or the nonlocal energy.

AI.tldr: 该论文推导了在晶格平移下平稳且遍历的随机电荷密度场的静电能量的双尺度连续极限。每个微观单元在每次实现中电荷中性，但偶极矩可波动且有非零均值。在平稳微观势和有限体积场的假设下，局部和非局部能量几乎必然收敛到确定性极限。
AI.motivation: 为随机电荷密度场（如具有随机位移或无序的周期性介质）建立严格的连续极限理论，将微观尺度的静电能量与宏观的连续描述联系起来，并处理单元偶极矩波动的效应。
AI.method: 采用双尺度渐近分析框架，将能量分解为局域项和非局域项。局域极限由系综平均的微观库仑能量和单元去极化项组成，而有效极化决定非局域极限。总能量中去极化项相互抵消，最终由系综平均微观单元能量和宏观静电场能量构成。还针对独立单元随机位移模型验证了定理假设。
AI.result: 证明了局域和非局域能量几乎必然收敛到确定性极限；确定性特例恢复了周期双尺度极限；对独立单元随机位移模型验证了假设成立，并表明中心化微观涨落可改变局域能量但不改变有效极化或非局域能量。
AI.conclusion: 建立了随机电荷密度场静电能量的双尺度连续极限理论，揭示了微观偶极涨落仅影响局域能量而不影响宏观（非局域）响应的关键性质，为随机介质的静电均质化提供了严格数学基础。

title: Low-rank approximation of Moment Tensor Potential enables reducing training set size without loss of accuracy
summary: In this study, we implement a low-rank approximation of Moment Tensor Potential (MTP) based on the tensor train (TT) decomposition. The implemented tensor-factorized MTP (TFMTP) and the original MTP model are actively trained via a MaxVol-based algorithm during molecular dynamics simulations of a four-component molten salt mixture, LiF-NaF-KF (FLiNaK), and geometry optimizations of a five-component equiatomic MoNbTaWV random alloy. We demonstrate that under a 1.5-fold compression, TFMTP requires two times fewer configurations for fitting than the original MTP model, while maintaining an indistinguishable level of accuracy. These actively trained MTP and TFMTP models are further used to evaluate the density and viscosity of FLiNaK at temperatures ranging from 600 to 1200 K, as well as the elastic constants and bulk modulus of the MoNbTaWV alloy at zero temperature. For both atomic systems, the differences in physical properties predicted by MTP and TFMTP are negligible.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于张量列车(TT)分解实现了矩张量势(MTP)的低秩近似，即张量因子化MTP(TFMTP)。在FLiNaK熔盐和MoNbTaWV合金上通过MaxVol算法进行主动训练，结果表明在1.5倍压缩下TFMTP所需拟合构型数比原始MTP少两倍，且精度相当，两种模型预测的物理性质差异可忽略。
AI.motivation: 传统MTP模型在复杂多组分体系中训练时需要大量配置数据，计算成本高。通过低秩近似（张量列车分解）压缩MTP，有望减少训练数据需求，同时保持预测精度，提高机器学习势函数的训练效率。
AI.method: 采用张量列车(TT)分解对矩张量势(MTP)进行低秩压缩，得到TFMTP模型；在分子动力学模拟FLiNaK四组分熔盐和几何优化MoNbTaWV五组分随机合金过程中，通过MaxVol算法对MTP和TFMTP进行主动训练；随后评估两种模型在物理性质预测上的表现。
AI.result: 在1.5倍压缩条件下，TFMTP拟合所需的构型数仅为原始MTP的一半，而精度与MTP无显著差异。两种模型预测的FLiNaK密度和黏度（600-1200 K）以及MoNbTaWV弹性常数和体模量（零温）差异均可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 基于张量列车分解的TFMTP能够有效降低MTP的训练数据需求而不损失精度，为机器学习原子间势的高效训练提供了可行方案，且适用于多元熔盐和合金体系。

title: Spin--orbit-enhanced correlation sensitivity and anomalous magnetic response in non-dimerized $4d^4$ ilmenite CdRuO$_3$
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, accepted in Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter
summary: We report the synthesis and physical properties of CdRuO$_3$, a nominal Ru$^{4+}$ $4d^4$ ilmenite with edge-sharing RuO$_6$ honeycomb layers. Powder X-ray diffraction establishes a crystallographically non-dimerized $R\bar{3}$ structure with equivalent Ru-Ru bonds and a strongly distorted RuO$_6$ environment. The compacted-pellet resistivity is nonmetallic but non-Arrhenius, while the heat capacity contains a finite residual linear term. Matched nonmagnetic calculations show that PBE+$U$ without spin-orbit coupling remains metallic or semimetallic up to $U_{\mathrm{eff}} = 3$ eV, whereas PBE+SOC+$U$ exhibits a strong $U_{\mathrm{eff}}$ dependence and opens a direct gap of approximately 55 meV at $Γ$ for $U_{\mathrm{eff}} = 2.5$ eV. Spin-orbit coupling therefore markedly enhances the correlation sensitivity of the non-cubic Ru $t_{2g}$ manifold. After subtraction of a dilute Curie-Weiss defect contribution, the susceptibility remains weakly nonmonotonic and is inconsistent with both an ordinary Pauli response and independent spin-only $S = 1$ moments. CdRuO$_3$ thus realizes the non-dimerized structural branch predicted for ruthenium ilmenites, but not a simple robust multiorbital metal.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了CdRuO₃（名义Ru⁴⁺ 4d⁴伊利锰矿结构）的合成与物理性质研究。该材料具有边共享RuO₆蜂窝层、非二聚化R\bar{3}结构。实验上呈非金属但非Arrhenius型导电，热容有有限残余线性项。DFT计算表明SOC显著增强关联敏感性，在U_eff=2.5 eV时打开约55 meV直接带隙。磁化率扣除缺陷贡献后呈弱非单调行为，不符合普通Pauli响应或独立自旋S=1的图像。
AI.motivation: 探索钌伊利锰矿（ruthenium ilmenites）中非二聚化结构分支的电子基态，理解4d⁴体系中自旋轨道耦合（SOC）与电子关联相互作用如何影响非立方Ru t₂g能带的电子结构。
AI.method: 通过粉末X射线衍射确定晶体结构；测量致密压片电阻率、热容和磁化率等宏观物性；结合PBE+U及PBE+SOC+U的第一性原理计算，系统考察U_eff对电子结构的影响。
AI.result: CdRuO₃呈非二聚化R\bar{3}结构，Ru-Ru键等价但RuO₆八面体强烈畸变。实验呈非金属非Arrhenius导电，热容存在有限残余线性项。无SOC的计算在U_eff达3 eV时仍保持金属或半金属，而含SOC的计算展现强烈U_eff依赖，在U_eff=2.5 eV于Γ点打开约55 meV直接带隙。磁化率呈弱非单调，排除普通Pauli磁化与独立S=1局域矩两种简单图像。
AI.conclusion: CdRuO₃实现了钌伊利锰矿中理论预测的非二聚化结构分支，其电子行为既不简单也不稳健——既非单纯多轨道金属，也未呈现简单局域磁矩行为。SOC与非立方晶体场协同作用使体系处于关联敏感的多轨道过渡态。

title: Nearly Isotropic Vortex Solid in $\mathbf{(La,Pr)_{3}Ni_{2}O_{7}}$ Thin Films
summary: The discovery of superconductivity in bulk bilayer nickelates has established a new platform for exploring high-$T_c$ superconductivity beyond the cuprates. The role of the Ni $3d_{z^2}$-derived $γ$ band in the superconductivity of bilayer nickelates remains unresolved. By performing simultaneous resistance and diamagnetism measurements on (La,Pr)$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ thin films, we map the vortex melting phase diagram for both in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields. For $H\parallel c$, the geometric confinement effect gives rise to pancake vortices. Remarkably, the anisotropy parameter of the vortex melting field $γ_{H_m} \equiv H_m^{ab}/H_m^c$ decreases monotonically with decreasing temperature and approaches unity at low temperatures. Within the anisotropic Ginzburg--Landau scaling, $H_m^{ab}/H_m^c = \sqrt{ρ_s^{ab}/ρ_s^c}$ tracks the superfluid-density anisotropy. Such a vortex solid implies a nearly isotropic superfluid density, which is irreconcilable with the strictly two-dimensional $3d_{x^2-y^2}$-derived bands, but naturally explained by a substantial interlayer superfluid contribution from the $3d_{z^2}$-derived $γ$ band. Our results provide thermodynamic evidence for a substantial contribution of the $γ$ band to superconductivity in bilayer nickelate thin films.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过研究双层镍氧化物（La,Pr）₃Ni₂O₇薄膜的超导涡旋熔化相图，证明了γ能带（由Ni 3d_z²轨道衍生）对超导有实质性的层间超流贡献，为理解这类高温超导体的机制提供了热电动力学证据。
AI.motivation: 双层镍氧化物被发现具有高温超导电性，为超越铜氧化物超导体的研究提供了新平台。然而，Ni 3d_z²衍生γ能带在超导中的作用一直悬而未决，需要澄清其角色以理解这类材料的超导机制。
AI.method: 在（La,Pr）₃Ni₂O₇薄膜上同时进行电阻和抗磁性测量，对平行于平面（H∥c）和垂直于平面两个方向的磁场绘制涡旋熔化相图；利用各向异性Ginzburg-Landau标度关系，通过涡旋熔化场的各向异性参数γ_Hm提取超流密度的各向异性。
AI.result: 对于H∥c方向，几何限域效应产生pancake涡旋。涡旋熔化场的各向异性参数γ_Hm随温度降低而单调减小，在低温下趋近于1，表明超流密度近乎各向同性。这与严格二维的3d_x²-y²衍生能带无法调和，说明存在来自3d_z²衍生γ能带的实质性层间超流贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了热电动力学证据，表明γ能带对双层镍氧化物薄膜的超导电性具有实质性贡献，深化了对这类新型高温超导体中超导机制的理解。

title: Reverse engineering of mechano-kinetic parameters from stochastic force profiles in heterogeneous ensembles of molecular motors and tracks
summary: Heterogeneity in contractile systems of molecular motors interacting with their tracks plays a key role in numerous cellular physiological and pathological processes. However, its effects cannot be captured by theoretical models assuming identical mechano-kinetic properties for all motors. We developed a stochastic framework to describe heterogeneous ensembles of myosin motors comprising two populations with distinct mechano-kinetic properties. Assuming that motors interact with the actin filament (their track) as independent force generators, we derived the probability distribution of the isometric force and characterised the statistics of finite-size force fluctuations. The proposed framework includes an estimation procedure that simultaneously infers the mechano-kinetic parameters and the size of the motor ensemble, eliminating the need to prescribe it a priori. Validation against synthetic and experimental data shows the model accurately captures force fluctuations and provides realistic estimates of the ensemble size. Furthermore, the framework enables a quantitative assessment of ensemble heterogeneity and the inference of an unknown motor species properties. This approach provides a quantitative tool for characterising heterogeneous actin-myosin systems, such as those arising from the co-presence of different protein isoforms in cardiac and skeletal muscle, or from the partial replacement of native proteins with mutation-derived or engineered variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个随机框架来描述肌球蛋白分子马达的异质性集合系统，该集合包含两种具有不同机械动力学性质的马达群体。该框架能够推导等距力的概率分布、刻画有限尺寸力波动特征，并包含一个同时推断马达机械动力学参数和集合大小的估计程序。通过合成数据和实验数据的验证，模型能准确捕捉力波动并提供真实的集合大小估计，还能定量评估集合异质性并推断未知马达物种的性质。
AI.motivation: 分子马达与其轨道相互作用的收缩系统异质性在众多细胞生理和病理过程中起关键作用。然而，现有理论模型假设所有马达具有相同的机械动力学特性，无法捕捉这种异质性效应。因此需要开发能够描述异质性马达集合的理论框架。
AI.method: 开发了一个随机框架来描述包含两种不同机械动力学马达群体的肌球蛋白异质性集合。假设马达作为独立力发生器与肌动蛋白丝（轨道）相互作用，推导了等距力的概率分布并刻画了有限尺寸力波动的统计特征。框架包含一种估计程序，可同时推断机械动力学参数和马达集合大小，无需预先规定集合大小。
AI.result: 针对合成数据和实验数据的验证表明，该模型能准确捕捉力波动，提供对集合大小的真实估计。此外，框架实现了对集合异质性的定量评估和对未知马达物种特性的推断。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为表征异质性肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白系统提供了定量工具，适用于如心肌和骨骼肌中不同蛋白质亚型共存，或原生蛋白被突变衍生或工程化变体部分替代等情形。

title: Near-Field Spin Seebeck Effect
summary: The conventional spin Seebeck effect generates spin currents through interfacial thermal conduction. In this Letter, we establish a photon-mediated spin Seebeck effect driven by near-field thermal radiation. Using a monolayer transition metal dichalcogenide separated from a thermal emitter by a vacuum gap, we demonstrate Rashba spin-orbit coupling can convert optical orbital excitations into an electron spin polarization. This occurs via two complementary mechanisms: the direct transfer of angular momentum from chiral thermal photons, and the rectification of unpolarized thermal fluctuations by a magnetized two-dimensional electron gas. These findings unveil a radiative pathway for nanoscale electron spin manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并论证了一种由近场热辐射驱动的光子介导自旋塞贝克效应。通过在热发射体与单层过渡金属二硫化物之间设置真空间隙，利用Rashba自旋轨道耦合将光学轨道激发转化为电子自旋极化，开辟了纳米尺度电子自旋操控的辐射路径。
AI.motivation: 传统自旋塞贝克效应依赖界面热传导产生自旋电流，本研究探索通过近场热辐射这一非接触途径实现自旋极化，以拓展自旋操纵的物理机制和实验手段。
AI.method: 采用分离有真空间隙的热发射体与单层TMD材料结构，利用Rashba自旋轨道耦合实现光轨道激发到电子自旋极化的转换。该过程包含两种互补机制：手性热光子的角动量直接转移，以及磁化二维电子气对非偏振热涨落的整流效应。
AI.result: 成功建立了由近场热辐射驱动的光子介导自旋塞贝克效应，证明两种互补的物理机制均可实现有效的自旋极化转换。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果揭示了纳米尺度电子自旋操控的全新辐射路径，为自旋电子学与热光子学的交叉领域提供了新的理论基础和潜在应用方向。

title: Simulation-Supervised Foundation Models for Retention Time Prediction in High-Performance Liquid Chromatography beyond Experimental Data Coverage
summary: Accurate prediction of high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) retention times (RTs) across diverse molecules and chromatographic methods remains challenging because experimental training data cover only a limited region of chemical and method spaces. Here, we develop FUSE-RT (Foundation model Unifying Simulation and Experimental supervision for Retention Time), a multitask foundation model that integrates RT data from 179 chromatographic methods and adapts to unseen molecules and methods using limited target-domain data. To extend transferability beyond experimental coverage, we introduce simulation-to-real (Sim2Real) transfer learning, in which molecular representations learned from large-scale computational data are transferred to experimental RT prediction. Specifically, we use PolyOmics, comprising 39 properties for approximately 21,400 molecules generated by molecular dynamics and density-functional theory calculations, as auxiliary supervision. We evaluate generalization under molecular, method, and joint molecular--method distribution shifts. Simulation-derived supervision substantially improves transfer beyond the experimental molecular domain, particularly under pronounced coverage gaps and few-shot adaptation. Moreover, RT-prediction error decreases systematically with increasing simulation-data size, following a significant power-law relationship. These results establish Sim2Real transfer as a scalable strategy for extending RT prediction beyond the finite coverage of experimental chromatographic data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FUSE-RT，一个多任务基础模型，通过将大规模计算模拟数据（PolyOmics，涵盖约21,400个分子的39种性质）与179种色谱方法的实验保留时间数据相结合进行Sim2Real迁移学习，实现了对未见分子和色谱方法保留时间的准确预测，并验证了模拟数据规模与预测误差之间存在显著的幂律关系。
AI.motivation: 高效液相色谱保留时间的准确预测面临根本性挑战：实验训练数据仅覆盖有限的化学空间和方法空间，导致模型难以泛化到未见分子和色谱方法。现有方法受限于实验数据的覆盖范围，需要引入计算模拟数据来扩展模型的迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出FUSE-RT多任务基础模型，整合179种色谱方法的RT数据；引入Sim2Real迁移学习策略，将来自PolyOmics大规模计算数据（分子动力学和密度泛函理论生成的39种分子性质）学习到的分子表征迁移到实验RT预测任务中。
AI.result: 模拟数据监督显著提升了超出实验分子域的迁移能力，尤其在覆盖缺口明显和少样本适应场景下效果突出；RT预测误差随模拟数据规模增大而系统性减小，遵循显著的幂律关系。
AI.conclusion: Sim2Real迁移学习被确立为一种可扩展的策略，能够将RT预测能力扩展到实验色谱数据有限覆盖范围之外，为计算模拟数据辅助实验预测提供了新范式。

title: Raman signatures of a non-reciprocal magnetic phase transition in Ca$_2$RuO$_4$
summary: The magnetic behavior of Ca$_2$RuO$_4$ represents a unique puzzle due to the interplay of strong electronic correlations, magneto-elastic interactions, and large spin-orbit coupling. At low temperatures, an anomalous Mott insulating state emerges, characterized by a complex antiferromagnetic order with a collective amplitude excitation of the magnetic moment which has been discussed in analogy with the Higgs mode. We report here evidence of a magnetic first-order phase transition driven by an out-of-plane magnetic field along the crystallographic $c$-axis of Ca$_2$RuO$_4$. Raman measurements in magnetic field reveal the emergence of mode of magnetic origin and a concomitant modification of the coupling between a phonon and the Higgs amplitude mode. Both the Raman features are characterized by a non-reciprocal hysteresis in magnetic field. Surprisingly, the observed phase transition does not affect the Raman scattering from the in-plane magnons, indicating that the dipolar antiferromagnetic order is preserved. This is consistent with the onset of a new quadrupolar field-controlled state, whose fluctuations structure can trigger an hybridization between the lattice and the magnetic Higgs mode resulting in the observed Raman features.

AI.tldr: 本文通过拉曼光谱测量，报道了Ca₂RuO₄在沿c轴外磁场驱动下出现的一级磁相变，发现磁起源模式的涌现以及声子与Higgs幅度模式耦合的改变，二者均表现出非互易磁滞回线，且面内磁振子不受影响，提示出现了新的四极子场控态。
AI.motivation: Ca₂RuO₄因其强电子关联、磁弹相互作用与大自旋轨道耦合的复杂交织而展现出独特的磁性行为，其低温异常Mott绝缘态中的反铁磁序和类Higgs模式的集体振幅激发尚待深入理解，特别是在外磁场作用下的相变行为与物理机制。
AI.method: 采用拉曼散射光谱技术，在沿晶体c轴方向施加外磁场条件下，对Ca₂RuO₄进行磁场依赖的拉曼测量，分析磁致相变中声子模式与磁激发（Higgs幅度模式）的耦合变化及磁滞现象。
AI.result: 观测到磁场驱动的磁一级相变，表现为磁起源新模式的涌现及声子与Higgs模式耦合的伴随性改变；两种拉曼特征均呈现非互惠的磁场滞回。面内磁振子的拉曼散射不受相变影响，表明偶极反铁磁序得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 研究提示磁场诱导了新的四极子场控态的出现，其涨落结构可触发晶格与磁Higgs模式之间的杂化，从而产生观测到的拉曼特征，为理解Ca₂RuO₄中磁序与轨道/四极子自由度之间的耦合提供了新视角。

title: Altermagnetism from the viewpoint of chemistry
summary: Magnetism has been a central theme of research in chemistry, physics, and materials science, with chemical composition and bonding playing key roles in determining magnetic behavior. Altermagnets are a newly identified class of magnetic materials that combine features of conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets, arising from specific symmetry and electronic structure motifs. In this review, we present a chemistry-driven viewpoint on altermagnetism, highlighting how crystal chemistry, bonding, and electronic structure enable this unconventional magnetic order. We begin by introducing the fundamental concepts required to understand altermagnets, with an emphasis on symmetry considerations, orbital character, and electronic structure signatures. We then survey the diverse material families in which altermagnetism has been identified, drawing attention to coordination environments and structure-property relationships that favor altermagnetic order. We subsequently present experimental approaches which are useful for the characterization of altermagnetic materials. We examine ab initio materials discovery as a promising strategy for identifying new altermagnets, emphasizing how chemical constraints, such as symmetry and bonding, can guide computational searches. Other than their intrinsic importance, altermagnets provide interesting possibilities for technology. For this reason, we highlight possible applications that may be enabled through altermagnetic materials, along with their coupling with existing orders such as ferroelectricity and superconductivity. In conclusion, we point out some challenges and prospects, where chemically-based design guidelines can play an important role towards advancing altermagnetism research. In summary, this review offers an account of recent developments in altermagnetism, from basic concepts to the current state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于"交变磁体"(altermagnets)的综述，从化学视角系统地介绍了这种新型磁性材料的物理基础、材料家族、表征方法、计算发现策略及潜在技术应用。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体是一类新发现的磁性材料，兼具传统铁磁体和反铁磁体的特性，由特定对称性和电子结构产生。作者认为从化学驱动的视角（晶体化学、成键、电子结构）来理解这一新兴领域至关重要，但目前缺乏系统性的化学视角综述。
AI.method: 本综述采用多层次的论述框架：(1) 首先引入理解交变磁体所需的基础概念（对称性、轨道特征、电子结构特征）；(2) 系统梳理已发现交变磁性的各类材料家族，重点关注配位环境和结构-性质关系；(3) 介绍表征交变磁性材料的实验手段；(4) 讨论基于化学约束（对称性和成键）指导的从头算材料发现策略；(5) 探讨交变磁体与铁电性、超导性等现有序参量的耦合及其技术应用前景。
AI.result: 该综述提供了一个从基础概念到最新进展的完整学术梳理，阐明了晶体化学和成键如何支撑交变磁性这一非常规磁有序，展示了多样化的材料家族，并提出了以化学设计规则推动计算搜索和实验表征的可行路线。
AI.conclusion: 作者在总结中指出了该领域面临的挑战与前景，强调基于化学的设计指南将在推进交变磁性研究中发挥重要作用，同时展望了交变磁体在技术应用（如与铁电性和超导性的耦合）方面的潜力。

title: Doping-controlled topological superconducting transition in misfit layer compounds
summary: Achieving topological superconductivity is a key goal in quantum physics, offering a path to fault-tolerant quantum computers. A central challenge in this field is to continuously drive a material through a topological quantum phase transition to directly observe the evolution from trivial to topological superconductivity. However, finding a robust platform that allows such extreme and precise tuning remains a challenge. Here, we demonstrate a doping-controlled phase transition from a conventional to a topological superconducting state in the bulk misfit layer compound (LaxPb1-xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2. We reveal a non-monotonic phase diagram characterized by two distinct superconducting regimes separated by a non-superconducting phase at a precise doping. In the highly doped regime, the superconducting phase becomes remarkably sensitive to non-magnetic disorder, and orientation-selective in-gap modes emerge at atomic step edges. Supported by Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations, these emergent spatial signatures are consistent with a time-reversal-symmetric crystalline-topological order parameter. Our results establish misfit compounds as a platform to engineering topological superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过掺杂调控，在层状失配化合物(LaxPb1-xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2中实现了从常规超导到拓扑超导的量子相变，揭示了非单调相图及拓扑超导的实空间特征，为该领域提供了可调平台。
AI.motivation: 实现拓扑超导是量子物理的关键目标，可通往容错量子计算。然而持续驱动材料穿越拓扑量子相变、直接观察从平庸到拓扑超导的演化仍然是一个核心挑战，缺乏能够实现极端且精确调控的稳健平台。
AI.method: 采用掺杂（La替代Pb）控制的方法调控层状失配化合物(LaxPb1-xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2的超导态；利用扫描隧道显微镜等实验手段揭示非单调相图；结合非磁性无序敏感性分析和原子台阶边缘取向选择性隙内模态观察；辅以Bogoliubov-de Gennes计算进行验证。
AI.result: 发现非单调相图，具有两个不同的超导区域，并被精确掺杂下的非超导相分隔；在高掺杂区域，超导相对非磁性无序高度敏感，且在原子台阶边缘出现取向选择性隙内模态；计算结果支持时间反演对称的晶体拓扑有序参量。
AI.conclusion: 层状失配化合物可作为工程化拓扑超导的平台，为实现从平庸到拓扑超导的连续调控提供了可行途径。

title: Emergent Chiral Metal Phase in Compressible Quantum Hall Fluids
summary: We report transmitted conductance measurements between a source and reflection-less contacts connected to a compressible quantum Hall fluid with filling fraction $ν$. We observe that total sum of transmitted conductances universally approaches Hall conductance $ν(e^2/h)$. The universality of this sum rule is established experimentally across integer and fractional quantum Hall regimes, remaining invariant under variation in temperatures, sample geometries, material qualities and quasi-particle interactions. Chiral transport in compressible quantum Hall fluids, characterized by suppressed dissipative transport with a distinct handedness, is confirmed by floating contact measurements. Consequently, this sum rule emerges as a conduction law of the chiral metal phase. Theoretically, we argue that time-reversal-symmetry breaking under a strong magnetic field within this chiral metal gives rise unidirectional trajectories of carriers in a nearly flat potential landscape with point-like disorder potentials, a regime realized when the screening length is smaller than the magnetic length. Within this chiral framework, longitudinal resistance does not originate from bulk dissipation but primarily from the equilibration of electrochemical potentials at the contacts. Our study introduces a new paradigm of chiral transport across a broad class of gapless two-dimensional systems characterized by short-range screening and broken time-reversal symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在源极与无反射接触之间对可压缩量子霍尔流体的透射电导测量，观察到透射电导总和普遍趋于霍尔电导ν(e²/h)的求和规则，并在整数与分数量子霍尔态下均成立，提出了一种手性金属相的传导定律。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过实验建立可压缩量子霍尔流体中透射电导存在的一个普适求和规则，并探究该规则背后的物理机制，从而对手性输运（chiral transport）提出新的理解范式。
AI.method: 作者进行了源极与无反射接触间的透射电导测量，观察总透射电导；通过改变温度、样品几何、材料质量和准粒子相互作用进行系统性实验；并利用浮置接触（floating contact）测量来确认手性输运特征。理论上论证了强磁场下时间反演对称性破缺、平坦势与点状杂质共同导致单向载流子轨迹。
AI.result: 实验证实在整数与分数量子霍尔区，总透射电导和普遍趋近霍尔电导ν(e²/h)，与温度、样品几何、材料质量和相互作用无关；浮置接触测量证实了手性输运中存在抑制的耗散输运与明确的手性取向。
AI.conclusion: 该求和规则可被视为手性金属相的传导定律；纵向电阻并非源于体耗散，而是主要来自接触处电化学势的均衡。此工作为具有短程屏蔽和时间反演对称性破缺的无带隙二维系统引入了手性输运的新范式。

title: Hemoglycin as a Candidate for Permanent Memory
summary: The Hemoglycin polymer of glycine derived from space is terminated by iron and silicon to form a three-dimensional regular lattice with a high density of silicon tetrahedral vertices. Divalent cation bridges bypass vertices to facilitate electron conduction axially from layer to layer of the lattice. In principle, the exact distribution of Mg or Ca ions around each vertex can encode a very large amount of information. In space where the polymer forms in a molecular cloud the current derived from photon input will fade but in-fall hemoglycin in life forms on habitable planets like Earth, could be contained behind lipid electronic barriers of the nervous system in neurons or glia. Energy minimization of the permutations for magnesium or calcium occupancy showed deeper binding for calcium-dominated configurations. A low energy state with two independent magnesium to calcium substitutions appears to be key to the maintenance of long-term chemical modification. This state could be read via a pulse train that induced the matching spatial distribution of calcium to render adjacent insulating lattice regions conductive and provide a completed conduction path, signaling recognition. Writing of information may involve spatial modulation of the Na/Ca exchanger within the lipid membrane.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了源自太空的甘氨酸衍生物"血色甘氨酸聚合物"（Hemoglycin），该聚合物由铁和硅终止并形成三维规则晶格。文章提出该晶格可通过二价阳离子（Mg/Ca）的分布编码大量信息，并可能在人脑神经元或神经胶质细胞的脂质屏障后作为信息存储与识别的基础结构。
AI.motivation: 探索一种源自太空的糖甘氨酸聚合物（Hemoglycin）的结构特性，揭示其可能作为信息存储介质的能力，并探讨其在生物神经系统（尤其人类大脑）中的潜在功能角色。
AI.method: 通过结构分析描述Hemoglycin的铁/硅终止与三维晶格构型；采用能量最小化计算评估镁/钙占据各顶点排列的稳定性差异；提出基于阳离子分布模式的信息读写机制（脉冲串触发识别、Na/Ca交换器实现写入）。
AI.result: 发现钙占据为主的构型结合更稳定（更深结合能）；能量最小化表明两个独立的Mg→Ca替代构成低能状态，与长期化学修饰的维持相关。该状态可通过脉冲串读取，使绝缘区域转为导电以完成识别。
AI.conclusion: Hemoglycin晶格中的阳离子分布可构成一种生物信息编码系统：钙的特定空间分布作为可读/可写的信息载体，可能参与神经系统中的识别与长期记忆机制，并在太空聚合物坠落地球生物体后发挥神经计算功能。

title: Exact fermionic dual of the Bose-Hubbard model
summary: Recent developments have established exact bosonization and fermionization with a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry as dualities through gauging. In this work, we apply fermionic gauging, which realizes generalized Jordan-Wigner transformations, to the Bose-Hubbard (BH) model with a global $U(1)$ symmetry and derive an exact dual description in terms of fermionic composites, built from bosons and fermions. In 1D, this duality generalizes the exact mapping between the extended hard-core BH model and the spinless Fermi-Hubbard model to now cover soft-core interactions. At low energies, the mapping reduces to the well-known equivalence between the sine-Gordon model and the Thirring model. The oscillation wave vector of the fermionic composite correlation function in the gapless phase is fixed by their density, providing a novel manifestation of Luttinger's theorem. We verify the exact duality using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations and demonstrate that the gapless phase and the phase transition are governed by the compact boson conformal field theory. Our construction naturally extends to generic bosonic systems and higher dimensions, opening new avenues for studying Bose-Fermi mixtures in optical lattices and other strongly correlated quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用费米子规范变换（推广的Jordan-Wigner变换）对具有全局U(1)对称性的Bose-Hubbard模型进行精确玻色化/费米化对偶描述，推导出由玻色子和费米子构成的费米复合算符的精确对偶形式，并在一维中推广了硬核BH模型与自旋less Fermi-Hubbard模型之间的精确映射至软核情形。
AI.motivation: 已有的精确玻色化/费米化对偶通常仅限于具有Z2对称性的体系。作者希望将费米化规范变换推广到具有连续U(1)对称性的Bose-Hubbard模型，从而为软核相互作用体系建立精确的对偶描述，并探索其在凝聚态与光晶格体系中的新应用。
AI.method: 采用费米子规范（gauging）方法实现广义Jordan-Wigner变换，作用于Bose-Hubbard模型；通过构造由玻色子与费米子组成的费米复合算符，在一维建立BH模型与费米模型间的精确对偶；利用DMRG数值验证对偶关系与相图。
AI.result: 证明该对偶在低能下约化为sine-Gordon模型与Thirring模型的等价性；费米复合关联函数在无隙相中的振荡波矢由其密度固定，为Luttinger定理提供了新的体现形式；DMRG验证了精确对偶，并表明无隙相和相变由紧致玻色子共形场论控制。
AI.conclusion: 该构造可自然推广到一般玻色系统及更高维度，为研究光晶格中的玻色-费米混合体系以及其他强关联量子系统开辟了新途径。

title: A Transport Framework for Evaluating Nanoscale Interconnect Materials
summary: As CMOS technology continues to scale, metallic interconnects increasingly limit circuit performance through rising resistivity, self-heating, and reliability degradation. Although several alternative metals have been proposed, a quantitative framework for evaluating their transport performance under nanoscale confinement remains unavailable. Here, we establish a transport framework by combining independently measured thermal and electrical conductivities with normalized and unnormalized transport figures of merit. We apply this framework to Cu, Ru, W, Co, Ir, and Mo thin films using new steady-state thermoreflectance measurements of Mo, Co, and Ir together with previously reported Cu, Ru, and W data. While Cu exhibits the highest intrinsic transport performance, its effective performance is substantially reduced by thickness scaling and Ta liner resistance. In contrast, Ru and Mo maintain favorable transport properties while enabling barrierless integration, identifying them as promising candidates for next-generation CMOS interconnects

AI.tldr: 本文建立了纳米尺度约束下金属互连传输性能的定量评估框架，结合热导率和电导率测量及传输品质因数，应用于Cu、Ru、W、Co、Ir、Mo薄膜，发现Ru和Mo是下一代CMOS互连的有前景候选材料。
AI.motivation: 随着CMOS技术持续缩小，金属互连因电阻率上升、自热效应和可靠性退化日益限制电路性能。虽然已有多种替代金属被提出，但缺乏在纳米尺度约束下定量评估其传输性能的框架。
AI.method: 建立一个传输框架，结合独立测量的热导率和电导率，使用归一化和非归一化传输品质因数。通过新的稳态热反射测量获得Mo、Co、Ir数据，并结合此前报告的Cu、Ru、W数据，对六种金属薄膜进行评估。
AI.result: Cu具有最高的固有传输性能，但其有效性能因厚度缩放和Ta衬垫电阻而大幅降低。相比之下，Ru和Mo在保持有利传输性能的同时可实现无阻挡层集成，被认定为下一代CMOS互连的有前景候选材料。
AI.conclusion: Ru和Mo凭借有利的传输性能与无阻挡层集成的可行性，成为下一代CMOS互连中最具潜力的替代金属方案。

title: Interference-controlled magnetic bound states and subgap transport in a Square--octagon superconductor
summary: The square--octagon lattice provides a useful setting for studying magnetic adatoms because its multisublattice structure allows different adsorption geometries to probe distinct combinations of the host electronic states. We study magnetic adatoms in an $s$-wave superconducting square--octagon lattice, focusing on the interplay between adsorption geometry, narrow and flat-band states, and subgap transport. We find that the large spectral weight associated with a flat band does not necessarily imply strong impurity--host coupling. For symmetric square-hollow adsorption, destructive interference strongly suppresses the overlap with the flat-band manifold, whereas top and octagon-hollow adsorption retain substantial overlap. This selectivity is reflected in the magnetic bound states, with the square-hollow channel supporting a predominantly atomic state, while the top and octagon-hollow states are strongly hybridized with the superconducting host. The effect develops continuously as the relevant band becomes flatter and remains pronounced in a material-motivated parameter regime. In a normal--superconductor--normal geometry, these differences are also reflected in the nonlocal subgap conductance. At a representative exchange splitting, square-hollow adsorption suppresses the low-bias conductance relative to the clean device, whereas octagon-hollow adsorption enhances it, with the square-hollow response showing a much sharper dependence on exchange splitting. Our results show that the magnetic-adatom response in narrow and flat-band superconductors is governed by the available spectral weight and by the symmetry and wave-function structure of the impurity--host hybridization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究s波超导方八边形晶格中磁性吸附原子的行为，发现平带的大谱权重并不必然意味着强杂质-宿主耦合。对称方孔吸附会因相消干涉强烈抑制与平带的交叠，而顶位和八边形孔吸附则保留显著交叠，这种选择性反映在磁性束缚态和非局域亚隙电导上。
AI.motivation: 方八边形晶格的多子格结构允许不同吸附几何探测宿主电子态的不同组合，为研究磁性吸附原子提供了独特平台。作者旨在理解吸附几何、窄带/平带态与亚隙输运之间的相互作用关系。
AI.method: 在s波超导方八边形晶格中研究磁性吸附原子，考察不同吸附位置（方孔对称位、顶位、八边形孔位）的杂质-宿主杂化、磁性束缚态特征，并在正常-超导-正常结几何中计算非局域亚隙电导。
AI.result: 发现方孔吸附显著抑制与平带流形的交叠（由破坏性干涉主导），导致束缚态主要为原子态；顶位和八边形孔吸附则与超导宿主强烈杂化。非局域电导方面，方孔吸附抑制低偏压电导，八边形孔吸附则增强之，且方孔响应对交换劈裂的依赖性更尖锐。
AI.conclusion: 窄带和平带超导体中磁性吸附原子的响应由可用谱权重以及杂质-宿主杂化的对称性和波函数结构共同决定，而非仅仅由平带的谱权重大小决定。

title: Fragility from Enthalpy Fluctuations and Fictive-Temperature Dynamics
summary: Fragility and fictive temperature are two central measures of glass formation, but their connection is usually expressed indirectly through structural relaxation times or cooling-rate dependence. Here we formulate this connection in terms of configurational enthalpy fluctuations. The time evolution of the fictive temperature during cooling or aging is controlled by the enthalpy--enthalpy correlation function that also determines the frequency-dependent configurational heat capacity. Fragility enters through the strong temperature dependence of the structural relaxation time and therefore controls how rapidly the corresponding enthalpy-relaxation spectrum shifts to long times near the glass transition. This leads to a direct time-domain description of the onset and growth of the fictive-temperature lag, including the Debye limit, and connects calorimetric relaxation, fragility, and nonequilibrium structural arrest within a common framework.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构型焓涨落将玻璃形成的两个核心度量——脆度（fragility）和假想温度（fictive temperature）统一在一个共同框架中，建立了直接的时间域描述。
AI.motivation: 脆度与假想温度是玻璃形成过程中的两个核心度量，但以往二者的联系通常只能通过结构弛豫时间或冷却速率依赖等间接方式表达，缺乏直接的物理连接。
AI.method: 作者以构型焓涨落为桥梁，利用焓-焓相关函数（决定频率依赖的构型热容）来控制降温或老化过程中假想温度的时间演化。脆度通过结构弛豫时间的强温度依赖性，控制焓弛豫谱在玻璃转变附近向长时间方向移动的速率。
AI.result: 建立了假想温度滞后起始与增长的直接时域描述（包含德拜极限），将量热弛豫、脆度与非平衡结构停滞统一在同一个理论框架中。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解玻璃形成中的量热弛豫与结构非平衡行为提供了一个统一的理论视角，可能对玻璃材料的加工和稳定性预测有重要意义。

title: Three-Dimensional Fermiology and Thickness-Tuned Magnetotransport in Single-Crystalline Antimony Flakes
summary: The extreme magnetoresistance of compensated semimetals is governed by both the Fermi-surface geometry and carrier relaxation, but these contributions are difficult to disentangle in finite-size structures. Here, we combine longitudinal and Hall magnetotransport measurements with temperature- and angle-dependent Shubnikov--de Haas oscillations in single-crystalline Sb flakes grown by chemical vapor deposition (CVD), with thicknesses ranging from 110 to 783 nm. As thickness increases, the non-saturating MR at 2 K and 14 T rises nearly 30-fold, reaching $7.13\times10^{5}\%$, while the primary frequency $F_α$ remains approximately 99 T without any systematic shift. A joint three-channel analysis of $ρ_{xx}(B)$ and $ρ_{xy}(B)$ reveals that this evolution is driven by an increase in the mobility of a nearly compensated electron--hole pair, rather than by a reconstruction of the primary pockets. Angle-dependent measurements confirm the existence of a closed three-dimensional $α$ pocket, and a reproducible high-frequency sector (335-377 T) is consistent with the electron $β$ orbit of the $L$-point pockets in bulk Sb. Together, the transport and quantum-oscillation results show that thickness tunes extreme MR through dimension-dependent scattering while preserving bulk-like fermiology.

AI.tldr: 本文通过化学气相沉积(CVD)生长的单晶锑(Sb)薄片（厚度110-783 nm），结合纵向和霍尔磁输运测量及温度、角度依赖的Shubnikov-de Haas振荡，揭示了厚度通过维度依赖的散射调控极端磁电阻，同时保持类体相费米面拓扑。
AI.motivation: 补偿半金属中的极端磁电阻受费米面几何和载流子弛豫共同调控，但这两者在有限尺寸结构中难以区分，需要系统性研究厚度如何影响这两个因素的贡献。
AI.method: 生长不同厚度(110-783 nm)的单晶Sb薄片，结合纵向磁输运(rho_xx)和霍尔磁输运(rho_xy)测量，进行温度与角度依赖的Shubnikov-de Haas振荡分析，并进行三通道联合分析以解析载流子迁移率和费米面口袋的变化。
AI.result: 随厚度增加，2 K和14 T下的非饱和磁电阻从110 nm升高至783 nm时增长近30倍，达到7.13×10^5%；主频率F_α保持在约99 T无系统偏移。三通道分析显示该演化源于近补偿电子-空穴对迁移率增加，而非主口袋重构。角度测量证实存在闭合三维α口袋，且可重复的高频区(335-377 T)与体相Sb中L点口袋的电子β轨道一致。
AI.conclusion: 厚度通过维度依赖的散射机制调控极端磁电阻，同时保持类体相费米面结构，将极端MR效应与散射率变化解耦，为理解有限尺寸补偿半金属中的磁输运提供了清晰图像。

title: Construction of downfolded Hamiltonians from projective transcorrelation
summary: Projective transcorrelation recovers the short-range electron correlation by a similarity transformation with a geminal function $f(r_{12})$, at the cost of an effective Hamiltonian containing a 3-body term. We replace the term by an effective operator of rank at most two, obtained from the two-body cumulant (2C) approximation to the three-particle reduced density matrix. The 2C 3-body energy is written without cumulants, and the effective one- and two-body interactions are derived as its partial derivatives with respect to the reduced density matrices. The truncation is assessed on the atomization and reaction energies of the HEAT set with CCSD(T), and on the CAS-pTC model, whose downfolded Hamiltonian is held on a qubit register with the number of Pauli strings reduced from the sixth power of the orbital count to the fourth.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过两体累积量（2C）近似将投影transcorrelation方法中的有效三体哈密顿量替换为最多二阶的有效算符，从而显著降低计算复杂度，并在CCSD(T)和CAS-pTC模型上验证了该截断的准确性。
AI.motivation: 投影transcorrelation方法通过含双电子（geminal）函数的相似变换恢复短程电子关联，但其代价是有效哈密顿量中包含三体项，这大大增加了计算成本，尤其在量子计算场景下，三体项导致泡利字符串数量随轨道数的六次方增长，难以处理。
AI.method: 采用两体累积量（2C）近似来近似三粒子约化密度矩阵，将三体能量写成不含累积量的形式，并通过其对约化密度矩阵的偏导数推导出有效的单体和双体相互作用，从而将三体算符替换为秩最多为二的等效算符。
AI.result: 该截断在HEAT基准集上使用CCSD(T)方法评估了原子化能和反应能，并在CAS-pTC模型上验证；通过截断，作用在量子比特寄存器上的泡利字符串数量从轨道数的六次方降至四次方。
AI.conclusion: 两体累积量近似能够有效地将三体项降阶为单体和双体算符，大幅降低计算规模，同时保持投影transcorrelation方法的精度，尤其对量子计算中的哈密顿量制备具有实际意义。

title: Hysteretic Coherence Collapse Across the First Order CDW Transition in 1T-TaS2
summary: The first order phase transition between the nearly commensurate (NC-CDW) and commensurate (C-CDW) charge density wave phases in 1T-TaS2 underpins its exotic electronic behavior, yet the spectroscopic evolution of the low energy electronic structure across this transition remains crucial to understand. Using angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we investigate the low temperature C-CDW phase, characterized by a flat band commonly associated with the lower Hubbard band and a distinct in-gap state located closer to the Fermi level. Photon energy dependent measurements distinguish these two low energy features through their different spectral weight evolution. Temperature dependent ARPES across heating and cooling cycles reveals that the in-gap state undergoes an abrupt collapse upon heating into the NC-CDW phase and re-emerges sharply upon cooling back into the C-CDW phase. This pronounced thermal hysteresis provides direct spectroscopic evidence of the first order nature of the transition. Furthermore, the disappearance and recovery of the in-gap state closely track the corresponding changes in resistivity, highlighting its intimate connection to the electronic reconstruction across the C-CDW/NC-CDW phase transition.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)系统研究了1T-TaS2中C-CDW与NC-CDW相之间的一级相变，发现带隙内的in-gap态在相变时经历剧烈的热滞回行为，为一级相变提供了直接的光谱学证据，并揭示其与电阻率变化密切相关。
AI.motivation: 1T-TaS2中近公度(NC-CDW)与公度(C-CDW)电荷密度波相之间的一级相变对其奇异的电子行为至关重要，但低能电子结构跨越这一相变的光谱学演化仍缺乏深入理解，这是理解其奇异电子性质的关键。
AI.method: 采用角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)对低温C-CDW相进行测量；通过变光子能量测量区分平带（与下Hubbard带相关）和更靠近费米能级的in-gap态；在升温和降温循环中进行变温ARPES实验，观测电子结构的演化。
AI.result: 光子能量依赖测量揭示平带与in-gap态具有不同的谱权重演化；变温ARPES显示in-gap态在加热进入NC-CDW相时突然消失，降温回到C-CDW相时又迅速重现，呈现显著的热滞回现象，且in-gap态的消失与恢复与电阻率的相应变化紧密关联。
AI.conclusion: in-gap态在相变中表现出的显著热滞回为C-CDW/NC-CDW相变的一级本质提供了直接的光谱学证据，并表明该in-gap态与跨越相变时的电子重构及电阻率变化密切相关。

title: Zonal dislocations in Laves phases: A coupled synchro-shear slip mechanism
summary: Synchro-shear is the primary plastic deformation mechanism in Laves phases at elevated temperatures, mediated by synchro-Shockley partial dislocations-zonal dislocations that proceed via localized events such as kink-pair nucleation and propagation. Using atomistic simulations, we identified a novel slip mechanism in Laves phases, namely coupled synchro-shear slip, involving the synchronized glide of two synchro-Shockley partial dislocations on adjacent slip planes, leading to the formation of extrinsic stacking faults. High-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy revealed the extended core structures consistent with coupled synchro-Shockley partial dislocations bounded by extrinsic stacking faults in C15 NbCr2 and their involvement in twinning. These results highlight the critical role of coupled synchro-shear slip in enabling phase transformations between Laves polytypes and in governing twinning behavior, providing new atomistic insight into the kinetic nature of plasticity in topologically close-packed intermetallic phases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过原子模拟和实验表征，在Laves相中发现了全新的"耦合同步剪切滑移"机制——两个同步Shockley不全位错在相邻滑移面上同步滑移，形成外延层错。结合高分辨扫描透射电镜在C15 NbCr2中验证了该位错芯结构，揭示了该机制在Laves多型体相变和孪生行为中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: Laves相在高温下的主要塑性变形机制是同步剪切（synchro-shear），由同步Shockley不全位错介导，但该位错的运动细节及其在相变和孪生中的角色尚未被充分理解，需要更深入的原子尺度认识。
AI.method: 采用原子模拟（原子级计算）识别新型滑移机制；利用高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（HR-STEM）观察C15 NbCr2中扩展位错芯结构，验证模拟预测的位错构型及其与孪生的关联。
AI.result: 识别出"耦合同步剪切滑移"新机制：两个同步Shockley不全位错在相邻滑移面上同步滑移，形成外延层错。HR-STEM在C15 NbCr2中观察到由外延层错边界连接、与耦合同步Shockley不全位错一致的扩展位错芯结构，并确认其参与孪生过程。
AI.conclusion: 耦合同步剪切滑移在Laves多型体之间的相变以及孪生行为的调控中起关键作用，为密堆积拓扑金属间相塑性的动力学本质提供了新的原子尺度见解。

title: Signatures of nodal superconductivity in stoichiometric FeTe
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, with Supplementary Information. Comments are welcome
summary: Superconductivity in stoichiometric FeTe opens access to the FeTe endpoint of the Fe(Se,Te) phase diagram, yet the nature of its superconducting pairing state remains unresolved. In this work, we combine scanning superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscopy, electrical transport, scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/S), and mean-field calculations to investigate the local superfluid response and pairing state of FeTe thin films with tunable stoichiometry. Even in stoichiometric FeTe, we observe micrometer-scale spatial variations in both superfluid stiffness and superconducting transition temperature $T_c$, while the London penetration depth remains non-saturating down to 0.02$T_c$ and follows a power-law temperature dependence with an exponent of approximately 1-1.5. Together with a V-shaped low-energy density of states and two-gap modeling, these results indicate a superconducting state with gap nodes or deep minima, consistent with either a $d$-wave or nodal $s$-wave superconducting state. Our findings establish stoichiometric FeTe as a distinct superconducting regime that departs from the trend toward more isotropic gaps at intermediate Se/Te compositions, providing a new benchmark for modern microscopic theories of iron-chalcogenide superconductivity.
