Our work also reveals a crossover from weak to rapid suppression of $T_c$ as superfluid stiffness decreases, connecting FeTe to the broader phenomenology observed in unconventional superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过SQUID显微镜、输运测量、STM/S和平均场计算等手段，系统研究了近化学计量比FeTe薄膜的超导配对态，发现其具有节点或深极小的超导能隙（d波或节点s波），超流刚度与Tc存在微米尺度空间不均匀性，且London穿透深度呈现幂律温度依赖，确立了FeTe作为区别于Fe(Se,Te)中间组分的独特超导区域。
AI.motivation: 化学计量比FeTe是铁硒碲超导相图的端点，但其超导配对态的本质尚未阐明。研究该端点对于理解铁基硫族化物超导机理及连接更广泛的非常规超导现象至关重要。
AI.method: 结合扫描SQUID显微镜、电输运测量、扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/S）以及平均场计算，对具有可调化学计量比的FeTe薄膜进行局域超流响应和配对态研究。通过穿透深度的幂律温度依赖、V形低能态密度及两能隙模型进行分析。
AI.result: 即使在化学计量比FeTe中也观察到超流刚度和Tc的微米尺度空间变化；London穿透深度在低至0.02Tc的温度下仍不饱和，遵循指数约为1-1.5的幂律温度依赖；呈现V形低能态密度。结果表明超导态具有能隙节点或深极小值，与d波或节点s波配对态一致。同时发现Tc随超流刚度降低存在从弱抑制到快速抑制的交叉行为。
AI.conclusion: 化学计量比FeTe代表一种独特的超导区域，偏离了中间Se/Te组分向更各向同性能隙演化的趋势，为现代铁基硫族化物超导微观理论提供了新的基准，并将FeTe与更广泛的非常规超导体现象学联系起来。

title: Exact Hamiltonian Dynamics of Rare Events in Active Matter
summary: Active systems navigate complex environments through non-equilibrium fluctuations, rendering standard equilibrium transition-rate theories inadequate. Moreover, transition rates provide only partial information on how non-equilibrium dynamics explore metastable states, whereas knowledge of the optimal paths offers deeper physical insight. Using an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle as a paradigmatic model, i.e., a stochastic dynamics driven by exponentially correlated noise, we establish an exact mapping of the non-Markovian optimal path onto a higher-dimensional Hamiltonian dynamical system so that, for arbitrary force fields, optimal paths can be computed systematically by solving the corresponding Hamilton equations. Tuning the conserved energy allows us to explore diverse dynamical regimes: ranging from classical instanton trajectories strictly confined to the zero-energy surface, to closed periodic orbits that emerge only at non-zero energies, representing a distinct signature of the non-Markovian active dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对主动奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克粒子（由指数相关噪声驱动的随机动力学）这一典型主动系统，建立了非马尔可夫最优路径到高维哈密顿动力系统的精确映射。通过求解相应的哈密顿方程，可在任意力场下系统性地计算最优路径。调节守恒能量可探索不同动力学区域：从严格限制在零能量面上的经典瞬子轨迹，到仅出现在非零能量下的闭合周期轨道——后者是主动非马尔可夫动力学的独特标志。
AI.motivation: 主动系统通过非平衡涨落导航复杂环境，使标准的平衡态转变率理论不再适用。此外，转变率仅提供非平衡动力学探索亚稳态的部分信息，而最优路径的知识能提供更深刻的物理洞察。因此需要一种能系统计算主动非马尔可夫系统最优路径的理论框架。
AI.method: 以主动奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克粒子为模型（由指数相关噪声驱动的随机动力学），作者建立了非马尔可夫最优路径到高维哈密顿动力系统的精确映射。这使得在任意力场下，最优路径可通过求解相应的哈密顿方程系统性地计算。
AI.result: 通过调节守恒能量，作者揭示了多样化的动力学区域：从严格局限于零能量表面的经典瞬子轨迹，到仅出现在非零能量下的闭合周期轨道。后者代表了非马尔可夫主动动力学的独特特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为主动非平衡系统中最优路径的系统计算提供了新的理论工具，并揭示了非马尔可夫主动动力学中超越经典瞬子图像的新的动力学行为（非零能量闭合周期轨道）。

title: Evidence of Haldane-Chain Physics in an Fe-Dehydroindigo Coordination Polymer
summary: We investigate whether an Fe--dehydroindigo spin-crossover coordination polymer can support Haldane-chain physics in its intrinsic, substrate-free limit. Spin-orbit-coupled density-functional-theory calculations and magnetic energy mapping yield a nearly isotropic antiferromagnetic coupling, $J_{\mathrm H}=32.206$~meV, together with much weaker single-ion anisotropy. Using these parameters, exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group calculations give a nondegenerate ground state separated from the lowest triplet-derived excitations by a gap of about $13$--$14$~meV, on the scale expected for the spin-1 Haldane gap. The anisotropy produces only a small splitting of the low-energy modes. The dynamical spin structure factor places the lowest spectral weight near the antiferromagnetic wave vector $q=π$. These results identify the isolated cis-dehydroindigo chain as a material-specific coordination-polymer platform whose microscopic interactions place it in a gapped regime consistent with Haldane-chain physics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自旋-轨道耦合DFT计算和磁能映射，研究了Fe-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物的本征态（无衬底）是否支持Haldane链物理。研究发现近各向同性反铁磁耦合J=32.206 meV及较弱的单离子各向异性，精确对角化和DMRG计算给出非简并基态，与最低三重态激发之间存在约13-14 meV的能隙，符合自旋1 Haldane能隙尺度，表明该体系处于与Haldane链物理一致的带隙区间。
AI.motivation: 探索材料特异性配位聚合物平台能否在本征（无衬底）极限下实现Haldane链物理，为自旋1量子磁性研究提供新的候选材料体系。
AI.method: 采用自旋-轨道耦合DFT计算和磁能映射提取磁参数，随后利用精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法计算基态性质和低能激发谱，并分析动力学自旋结构因子。
AI.result: 反铁磁耦合J_H=32.206 meV近乎各向同性，单离子各向异性较弱；非简并基态与最低激发之间存在约13-14 meV能隙，各向异性仅导致低能模的微小分裂；动力学自旋结构因子在反铁磁波矢q=π处谱权重最大。
AI.conclusion: 孤立的顺式脱氢靛蓝链是一种材料特异性的配位聚合物平台，其微观相互作用使其处于与Haldane链物理一致的带隙区间。

title: Fixed-Dimensional Latent Flow for Generating Variable-Size 3D Molecules
summary: In molecular discovery, molecule size is coupled to composition, structure, and other target properties. Yet most 3D generators require molecule size to be specified before generation. Here, we introduce Equivariant-Free Transformer-Autoencoded Latent Flow Matching, a two-stage generative framework that relies entirely on a single fixed-dimensional molecule-level latent representation to generate variable-size molecules. The second-stage flow matching model samples this latent vector, and an autoregressive Transformer decoder then determines molecule size while generating atom types, coordinates, and chemically informative states. Canonical atom ordering and rigid-pose alignment enable standard Transformers without equivariant layers, while joint decoding of molecular geometry and an enriched chemical state enables reliable, deterministic, chemistry-guided graph recovery without requiring a learned dense pairwise bond decoder. The same fixed-dimensional latent supports unconditional and property-conditioned flow matching, while optional property supervision adds an internal ranking readout, with no separate predictor or reference calculations. On PCQM4Mv2, EF-TALFM achieves the highest fraction of molecules that are unique, training-set novel, pass sanitization and PoseBusters sanity checks, 89.4\%, compared with 75.6\% for UAE-3D and 69.8\% for FlowMol. EF-TALFM also achieves higher measured computational throughput for training and sampling. Across ten target HOMO--LUMO gaps, internal ranking doubles the density functional theory (DFT)-verified hit rate within $0.1\,\mathrm{eV}$, while preserving 97\% novelty among unique verified hits. These results demonstrate that fixed-dimensional molecule-level generation followed by symmetry-resolved autoregressive realization provides a practical architecture for open-ended and property-directed 3D molecular design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EF-TALFM，一种两阶段生成框架，完全基于单一固定维度的分子级潜在表示来生成变尺寸分子，在PCQM4Mv2数据集上达到89.4%的有效唯一新颖分子比例，超越现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D分子生成器通常要求分子大小在生成前预先指定，但分子大小与组成、结构及其他目标性质是耦合的。这种需要预先指定尺寸的方法限制了开放式的分子发现。
AI.method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段通过等变自由Transformer自编码器学习固定维度分子级潜在表示；第二阶段使用流匹配模型对潜在向量进行采样，并通过自回归Transformer解码器在生成原子类型、坐标和化学信息状态的同时确定分子大小。利用规范原子排序和刚性位姿对齐避免等变层，联合解码分子几何与富化学状态实现无密集成对键解码器的化学引导图恢复。该框架支持无条件及性质条件流匹配，可选的属性监督提供内部排序读取器。
AI.result: 在PCQM4Mv2上，EF-TALFM达到89.4%的有效、唯一、训练集新颖且通过消毒与PoseBusters检验的分子比例，优于UAE-3D的75.6%和FlowMol的69.8%。训练和采样吞吐量也更高。在十个目标HOMO-LUMO能隙上，内部排序使DFT验证命中率翻倍（0.1eV内），同时保持97%的新颖率。
AI.conclusion: 固定维度的分子级生成结合对称解析的自回归实现，为开放式和性质导向的3D分子设计提供了实用架构，无需在生成前指定分子尺寸，也无需外部预测器或参考计算。

title: Vertical quantum confinement in bulk MoS$_2$
summary: We experimentally observe quantum confinement states in bulk MoS$_2$ using Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES). The band structure at the $\overlineΓ$ point reveals quantum well states (QWSs) linked to vertical quantum confinement of the electrons, confirmed by the absence of dispersion in k$_z$ and a strong intensity modulation with photon energy. Notably, the binding energy dependence of the QWSs vs $n$ does not follow the quadratic dependence of a two-dimensional electron gas. Instead, a linear behaviour is observed that is consistent with a parabolic-like quantum well. This confinement arises from the mechanical exfoliation preparation method, which leads to the detachment of a multilayer stack from the underlying bulk. This is confirmed by Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations. The quantum confinement in bulk-like MoS$_2$ not only offers the opportunity to explore intersubband transitions to exploit optical properties but also provides a means to study fundamental quantum phenomena in multilayer stacks of different thicknesses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）在块体MoS₂中实验观测到量子限域态。在Γ̄点处发现与垂直量子限域相关的量子阱态（QWSs），通过无k_z色散和强光子能量强度调制得以确认。值得注意的是，QWSs的结合能对n的依赖呈线性而非二维电子气的二次方关系，这与类抛物线量子阱一致。该限域源于机械剥离制备方法导致的多层堆叠从块体分离，并通过DFT计算验证。这种块体MoS₂中的量子限域为探索子带间跃迁及研究不同厚度多层堆叠的量子现象提供了途径。
AI.motivation: 探索在块体MoS₂中实现量子限域的可能性，打破以往量子限域只能在二维或少层材料中观测的局限，寻求利用其优异的子带间跃迁光学特性以及研究多层体系中的基础量子现象。
AI.method: 使用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）实验观测块体MoS₂的电子能带结构；通过分析k_z方向色散的缺失和光子能量依赖的强度调制来确认量子阱态；利用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算验证量子限域的来源与机制。
AI.result: 在块体MoS₂的Γ̄点成功观测到量子阱态，确认了垂直量子限域的存在；发现QWSs结合能随n呈线性依赖，不同于二维电子气的二次方行为，暗示类抛物线量子阱结构；DFT计算证实限域源于机械剥离导致的多层堆叠与块体分离。
AI.conclusion: 块体MoS₂中可实现有效的量子限域，这不仅为探索子带间跃迁以利用其光学特性提供了新平台，也为研究不同厚度多层堆叠中的基础量子现象开辟了新途径。

title: Chemical and interface confinement effects in promoting plastic co-deformation in high-strength nano-scale eutectics
summary: Eutectics offer a route to overcome plastic incompatibility in disparate-phase heterostructures by coupling microstructural refinement with phase-specific chemical and crystallographic hierarchy. Here, we investigate laser-rapid-solidified Al-(Si,Ge) eutectic composites designed along the univariant ternary eutectic path, solidifying with an Al-rich face-centered cubic (fcc) matrix and (Si,Ge)-rich diamond-cubic (dc) fibers as constituent eutectic phases with faceted interfaces. The microstructure was hierarchical in nature with finer structures within eutectic phases: nanoscale (Si,Ge) clusters in the Al phase and growth twins within the (Si,Ge) fibers with some Al retention. Although increasing Ge content coarsens the eutectic spacing, the yield strength is slightly enhanced compared to the relatively finer Al-Si, and tensile ductility of Al-(Si,Ge) is higher than that of Al-Si. In situ SEM micromechanical testing combined with post-mortem STEM and TEM showed that in the Al-rich phase, Ge segregated to the deformation-induced sub-grain boundaries that confined glide dislocations. Simultaneously, the (Si,Ge)-rich fibers remain crack-resistant at large plastic strain and exhibit deformation-induced planar faults, consistent with localized partial-dislocation activity at highly stressed interfaces and twin boundaries. These coupled mechanisms due to interface confinement and hard phase chemistry enable co-deformation of the metallic and covalent phases, providing a pathway for designing high-tensile-strength and ductile hierarchical eutectics beyond conventional length-scale-controlled strengthening.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了激光快速凝固的Al-(Si,Ge)共晶复合材料，通过沿单变量三元共晶路径凝固，获得了具有分级微观结构（Al基体中的纳米级(Si,Ge)团簇和(Si,Ge)纤维中的生长孪晶）的金属-共价异相复合材料。研究发现Ge的添加虽粗化了共晶间距，但提升了屈服强度和拉伸延展性。通过原位SEM微力学测试与STEM/TEM分析，揭示了Ge在Al相亚晶界的偏聚限制位错滑移，以及(Si,Ge)纤维在界面和孪晶边界处通过部分位错活动形成平面缺陷而保持抗裂性。这些耦合机制使金属相和共价相能够协同变形，为设计高强高韧分级共晶材料提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 传统异相异质结构材料面临塑性不兼容性问题，制约了金属与共价相的组合。作者旨在通过共晶路线耦合微观结构细化与相特异性化学和晶体学分级，解决这一难题，探索超越传统长度尺度强化策略的高强高韧材料设计路径。
AI.method: 采用激光快速凝固制备沿单变量三元共晶路径凝固的Al-(Si,Ge)共晶复合材料，获得fcc Al基体与dc (Si,Ge)纤维的异相结构。通过改变Ge含量调控共晶间距与分级微结构，结合原位SEM微力学测试与离位STEM/TEM表征，揭示变形机制。
AI.result: 1) 微观结构呈分级特征：Al相内含纳米(Si,Ge)团簇，(Si,Ge)纤维内存在生长孪晶且含少量Al残留；2) 增加Ge含量虽粗化共晶间距，但屈服强度略高于更细的Al-Si，延展性也更优；3) Ge在变形诱导的Al亚晶界偏聚，限制位错滑移；4) (Si,Ge)纤维在大塑性应变下仍抗裂，呈现变形诱导的平面缺陷，源于高度应力界面和孪晶边界处的局部部分位错活动。
AI.conclusion: 界面约束与硬相化学的耦合机制使金属相（fcc）和共价相（dc）能够协同变形，为设计高抗拉强度且兼具延展性的分级共晶材料提供了超越传统长度尺度控制强化策略的新途径。

title: Magnetochiral anisotropy of thermally activated phase slips in noncentrosymmetric superconductors
summary: Resistive tails of narrow superconducting wires below the critical temperature are governed by phase slips, thermally activated near the transition and quantum at lower temperatures. We develop the theory of thermally activated phase slips in wires lacking inversion symmetry, modeled microscopically as a diffusive wire formed from a two-dimensional electron gas with Rashba spin-orbit coupling in an in-plane magnetic field. The phase-slip resistance acquires magnetochiral anisotropy: at fixed current it changes upon reversal of the field, and at fixed field upon reversal of the current, while the linear-response resistance remains field symmetric as required by Onsager reciprocity. The nonreciprocity originates from an asymmetry of the phase-slip activation barrier that is odd in both current and field. It is generated by the Lifshitz invariants of the free energy, the cubic gradient term and the momentum-odd quartic vertex, together with even gradient terms promoted to odd ones by the helical ground state, precisely the combination that determines the superconducting diode effect. The barrier asymmetry is therefore fixed by the diode efficiency of the same wire through a universal numerical ratio, with no adjustable parameters. The kinetic Lifshitz invariant, which makes relaxation and noise of the order parameter nonreciprocal, affects only the fluctuation prefactor at a parametrically subleading level. Because the asymmetry resides in the activation exponent, the magnetochiral signal is amplified relative to the diode asymmetry by the ratio of barrier height to temperature, and appears as a field-antisymmetric splitting of the exponential slopes of differential-resistance traces routinely used to identify thermally activated phase slips.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了缺少反演对称性的窄超导线中热激活相滑移理论。该线被微观建模为具有Rashba自旋轨道耦合的二维电子气在有面内磁场中形成的扩散线。研究发现相滑移电阻获得磁手性各向异性：固定电流时场反转改变电阻，固定场时电流反转改变电阻，而线性响应电阻保持场对称（符合Onsager互易）。这种非互易性源于激活势垒对电流和场都奇对称的不对称性，由自由能的Lifshitz不变量（立方梯度项和动量奇数四次顶点）及螺旋基态使偶数梯度项变为奇数项所产生——正是决定超导二极管效应的组合。因此势垒不对称由同一根线的二极管效率通过普适数值比固定，无需可调参数。动力学Lifshitz不变量仅影响参数次主导水平的涨落前因子。由于不对称性存在于激活指数中，磁手性信号相对二极管不对称性被势垒高度与温度之比放大，表现为微分电阻迹线的场反对称指数斜率劈裂。
AI.motivation: 窄超导线的电阻性尾巴由相滑移控制，靠近转变温度时是热激活的，低温下是量子的。现有理论尚未涉及缺乏反演对称性的线缆中热激活相滑移行为，而这类系统中的磁手性非互易现象（如超导二极管效应）已备受关注。作者希望建立能统一描述相滑移非互易性与二极管效率的微观理论。
AI.method: 从微观出发将系统建模为二维电子气（具Rashba自旋轨道耦合）在面内磁场中形成的扩散超导线。通过分析自由能中的Lifshitz不变量（立方梯度项、动量奇数四次顶点）与螺旋基态对偶数梯度项的奇化作用，推导相滑移激活势垒对电流和场的不对称性，并计算相滑移电阻。
AI.result: 相滑移电阻呈现磁手性各向异性（场反转或电流反转时改变），而线性响应保持场对称。非互易源自激活势垒的奇不对称性，该不对称性与超导二极管效率通过普适数值比绑定（无可调参数）。磁手性信号相对二极管不对称性被势垒高度/温度之比放大，表现为微分电阻迹线的场反对称指数斜率劈裂。
AI.conclusion: 缺乏反演对称性的超导线中，热激活相滑移天然携带磁手性非互易信号，其强度由二极管效率通过普适常数确定。势垒不对称居于激活指数中使之被放大，可被微分电阻测量直接观测，为验证非中心对称超导中相滑移物理提供可检验的实验预言。

title: Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and the Helmholtz Theorem
summary: The recently proposed Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm has not yet been studied in detail from a thermodynamic point of view; this work aims to fill that gap. We demonstrate how thermodynamical state variables and potentials can be derived and thereby demonstrate that the construction of the algorithm formally represents a microcanonical thermodynamic ensemble. In particular, we demonstrate (analytically and numerically) that the algorithm fulfils the Helmholtz theorem, an alternative formulation of the first law of thermodynamics. Furthermore, we construct a new sampling algorithm that extends the original to lower-dimensional inference problems. Finally, we argue that canonical Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithms are more natural than Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo from the thermodynamic and information-theoretic point of view.

AI.tldr: 本文从热力学角度系统研究了最近提出的微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛（MCHMC）算法，推导出其热力学状态变量和势函数，证明该算法形式上代表微正则热力学系综，并满足亥姆霍兹定理（热力学第一定律的另一种表述）。此外，作者构建了一个将原算法扩展到低维推断问题的新采样算法，并从热力学和信息论角度论证了正则马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法比微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛更自然。
AI.motivation: MCHMC算法虽然已被提出，但尚未有人从热力学角度对其进行详细研究。作者希望填补这一空白，深入理解该算法的热力学本质。
AI.method: 1. 从热力学角度推导MCHMC的状态变量和热力学势；2. 通过解析和数值方法验证算法满足亥姆霍兹定理；3. 构建扩展算法以适用于低维推断问题；4. 从热力学和信息论视角对比正则MCMC与MCHMC算法。
AI.result: 1. 证明了MCHMC算法在形式上确实代表了一个微正则热力学系综；2. 解析和数值上验证了该算法满足亥姆霍兹定理；3. 提出了一个扩展版本以处理低维推断问题；4. 论证了正则MCMC算法在热力学和信息论意义上更为自然。
AI.conclusion: 虽然MCHMC算法在形式上构成微正则系综并满足热力学第一定律，但从热力学和信息论角度来看，正则MCMC算法是更自然的选择。

title: Self-Trapping Enabled Highly Bright Momentum-Indirect Interlayer Excitons
summary: Interlayer excitons in two dimensional material heterostructures exhibit large exciton binding energies and long lifetimes, making them ideal platforms for studying excitonic devices and many body quantum phenomena. However, the spatially separated electron and hole nature of IXs reduces their oscillator strength by two orders of magnitude compared to intralayer excitons. Achieving high efficiency IX emission remains challenging and requires optimal material selection with appropriate momentum matching and meticulous device fabrication. Here we demonstrate a highly bright momentum indirect IX emission within heterostructures formed between 2D perovskites and monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. The quantum yield of IX emission reaches 35.2% on average, over 50 times higher than that of the corresponding constituent TMD monolayer, with the highest value exceeding 60%. Notably, the radiative recombination efficiency of this momentum indirect IX exceeds that of momentum direct IXs in monolayer TMD-based heterostructures by two orders of magnitude. We suggest that the remarkably bright IX emission in our heterostructure originates from IX self trapping, induced by strong exciton phonon coupling arising from the soft lattice nature of the 2D perovskite. Our findings provide new insights into achieving high IX emission efficiency and open new avenues for exploring long lifetime excitonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文在二维钙钛矿与单层过渡金属硫族化物（TMD）构成的异质结构中实现了高亮度的动量间接层间激子（IX）发射，量子产率平均达35.2%，最高超过60%，比对应TMD单层的发射亮度高50倍以上，且其辐射复合效率比TMD异质结构中的动量直接IX高两个数量级。作者认为这种异常明亮的IX发射源于二维钙钛矿软晶格导致的强激子-声子耦合所引发的IX自陷效应。
AI.motivation: 层间激子（IX）具有大束缚能和长寿命，是研究激子器件和多体量子现象的理想平台。然而，由于电子和空穴空间分离，IX的振子强度比层内激子低两个数量级，导致高效IX发射极难实现，需要寻找合适的材料组合和器件制备方案。
AI.method: 构建2D钙钛矿/Monolayer TMD异质结构，通过动量间接的能带结构设计实现IX发射；利用二维钙钛矿的软晶格特性增强激子-声子耦合，诱导IX自陷效应以提高辐射复合效率。
AI.result: IX发射量子产率平均达35.2%，最高超过60%，比对应TMD单层高50倍以上；动量间接IX的辐射复合效率比TMD异质结构中的动量直接IX高两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了通过IX自陷效应实现高亮度和长寿命激子发射的新机制，为高效激子器件和长寿命激子器件的探索开辟了新途径。

title: TSBench: A physics-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLM understanding of chemical reaction mechanisms
comment: 35 pages, including 13 pages of supplementary information
summary: Understanding a chemical reaction requires mapping a symbolic reactant-product description onto the three-dimensional pathway through which atoms rearrange, yet chemistry benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) largely probe factual knowledge and text-based reasoning. Here we introduce TSBench, a benchmark in which an LLM agent uses structure-editing tools to construct three-dimensional transition-state (TS) guesses verified by an automated quantum-chemical pipeline, yielding a physics-grounded pass/fail verdict. Across 546 evaluations of seven frontier LLMs on 78 elementary reactions, the aggregate success rate rose from 50.4% to 66.8% under diagnosis-driven revision; the best models approached 90% on the simplest reactions, yet performance dropped sharply with mechanistic complexity. Most failed attempts produced locally plausible saddle points whose reaction paths led to the wrong reactant-product pair, revealing local geometric intuition without a robust grasp of the global reaction coordinate. TSBench establishes a mechanism-level yardstick for LLM agents in mechanism-sensitive tasks such as synthesis planning and autonomous experimentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TSBench基准测试，让LLM智能体使用结构编辑工具构建三维过渡态猜测，通过自动化量子化学流水线验证，给出基于物理学的通过/失败判定。在7个前沿LLM、78个基元反应、546次评估中，诊断驱动修订使成功率从50.4%提升至66.8%，最强模型在简单反应上接近90%成功率，但性能随机理复杂性急剧下降。
AI.motivation: 现有化学领域的LLM基准大多只测试事实知识和基于文本的推理，但真正理解化学反应需要将符号化的反应物-产物描述映射到原子重排的三维路径上，缺乏对三维化学机理层面能力的评估基准。
AI.method: 引入TSBench基准：LLM智能体利用结构编辑工具构建三维过渡态(TS)猜测，再由自动化量子化学流水线进行验证，产生基于物理学的通过/失败最终判定。实验覆盖7个前沿LLM、78个基元反应、共546次评估。
AI.result: 在诊断驱动修订策略下，总体成功率从50.4%提升至66.8%；最强模型在最简单反应上可达约90%成功率，但性能随机理复杂度增加而急剧下降。大多数失败尝试产生了局部看似合理的鞍点，但其反应路径导向错误的反应物-产物配对，说明模型具备局部几何直觉但缺乏对全局反应坐标的稳健把握。
AI.conclusion: TSBench为LLM智能体在机理敏感型任务（如合成规划、自主实验）中建立了机理层面的评估标尺，揭示出现有LLM在化学反应机制理解上的关键局限。

title: Selective coupling of high-order phonons in La2-xSrxCuO4
summary: In crystals and molecules with strong coupling between the charge carriers and atomic vibrations, high order harmonics of the vibrational excitations can be observed with intensity following the Franck-Condon envelope. Here, we uncover a new regime of electron-phonon coupling in La2-xSrxCuO4 using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering. In the undoped compound, we find sharp peaks at approximately 85$\pm$5 meV, 180$\pm$7 meV, and 330$\pm$5 meV with no observable dispersion, and an absence of appreciable intensity from other modes observed in Raman spectroscopy in this energy range. The 180 meV and 330 meV excitations have energies approximately consistent with two-phonon and four-phonon in-plane Cu-O bond stretching mode, suggesting that the resonantly excited valence electrons strongly couple to this mode. These excitations exhibit significant doping dependence, eventually becoming unresolvable at 10% hole doping, where the low energy charge excitations are dominated by dispersive plasmons. The observation of selective coupling to even-ordered phonons and stark contrast with the Raman spectra indicate anomalous electron-phonon coupling beyond the Franck-Condon picture. One intriguing possibility is the existence of locally paired quasiparticles in insulating cuprates.

AI.tldr: 本文利用共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）在La2-xSrxCuO4中发现了新的电子-声子耦合机制。在未掺杂化合物中观察到约85、180和330 meV的尖锐且无色散的激发峰，对应面内Cu-O键伸缩模式的两声子和四声子激发，表现出反常的偶阶选择性耦合，与Franck-Condon图像和拉曼光谱形成鲜明对比，提示可能存在局域配对准粒子。
AI.motivation: 深入研究铜氧化物中超导相关的电子-声子耦合机制，尤其是在强耦合体系中观察到的多声子高阶谐波现象的起源，以及是否存在超越Franck-Condon图像的反常耦合行为。
AI.method: 使用共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）技术对La2-xSrxCuO4体系进行测量，系统分析未掺杂及不同掺杂浓度下的激发谱，并与拉曼光谱结果进行比较。
AI.result: 观察到约85、180和330 meV的尖锐无色散峰，分别对应面内Cu-O键伸缩模式的一、二和四声子激发；掺杂至10%空穴时高阶激发消失；这类偶阶选择耦合与拉曼谱结果显著不同。
AI.conclusion: 发现的偶阶选择性多声子耦合不能用传统的Franck-Condon图像解释，暗示铜氧化物绝缘体中可能存在局域配对准粒子，为理解高温超导配对机制提供了新的视角。

title: First Principles Thermodynamics of Zr B Segregation at Grain Boundaries in Recycled Nd2Fe14B
summary: Grain-boundary chemistry is central to the coercivity and thermal stability of Nd2Fe14B permanent magnets, particularly in recycled magnets where recovery of the hard-magnetic phase does not by itself restore the intergranular microstructure. Our recent experimental study showed that nanoscale ZrB2 precipitates can emerge at grain boundaries and triple junctions during recycling despite an overall Zr concentration of only about 0.1 at.%, where they are associated with boundary stabilization and suppression of grain coarsening. Here we use spin-polarized density-functional theory with a Hubbard correction (DFT+U) to determine the atomistic thermodynamics underlying this preferential localization. A systematic set of composition-matched bulk/grain-boundary DFT+U supercells provides a common correlated-electron description across boundary chemistries. We compare B, Zr, Dy, and ZrB2-like local configurations in bulk and grain-boundary environments of Nd2Fe14B. Excess B is strongly stabilized at the boundary, while Zr also shows an independent thermodynamic preference for the interfacial region. When Zr and B are combined in a ZrB2-like configuration, the boundary preference is retained, indicating that the interface remains favorable as Zr-B coordination develops. These results establish a thermodynamic pathway for the co-localization of Zr and B prior to ZrB2 formation. Magnetic-state analysis further shows that all compared structures remain within the same high-moment Fe-sublattice regime, and boundary-localized defects generally perturb the normalized magnetization less than their matrix counterparts. The calculations therefore provide a first-principles explanation for why Zr-B chemistry concentrates at intergranular regions and how such boundary-localized states can support the microstructural stability required for high-coercivity recycled Nd-Fe-B magnets.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过自旋极化DFT+U计算，揭示了回收Nd-Fe-B磁体中纳米ZrB2析出物优先在晶界局部化的热力学机制，并表明晶界局部化的缺陷对磁化强度的扰动小于基体中的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 晶界化学对Nd2Fe14B永磁体的矫顽力和热稳定性至关重要，尤其在回收磁体中，恢复硬磁相本身并不能修复晶间微观结构。先前实验发现痕量Zr（约0.1 at.%）可在晶界和三叉晶界形成纳米ZrB2析出物，但缺乏对其优先局部化的原子级热力学解释。
AI.method: 采用自旋极化密度泛函理论加Hubbard修正（DFT+U），构建系统性composition-matched的体相/晶界超胞，在统一的关联电子描述框架下，比较B、Zr、Dy及ZrB2-like局域构型在Nd2Fe14B体相和晶界环境中的热力学稳定性，并进行磁性态分析。
AI.result: 过量B在晶界处被强烈稳定化；Zr对界面区域也具有独立的热力学偏好；Zr与B组合成ZrB2-like构型时，晶界偏好仍然保持。所有比较结构均处于相同的高矩Fe亚晶格磁态，且晶界局部化缺陷对归一化磁化强度的扰动通常小于其在基体中的对应构型。
AI.conclusion: 计算结果从第一性原理层面解释了Zr-B化学为何集中在晶间区域，建立了Zr与B在ZrB2形成前共定位的热力学路径，并表明这种晶界局部化状态能够支撑高矫顽力回收Nd-Fe-B磁体所需的微观结构稳定性。

title: Néel-Vector Control of the Josephson Diode Effect in $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric Antiferromagnets
summary: The interplay of superconductivity and magnetism gives rise to rich phenomena in Josephson junctions. In this Letter, we study Josephson junctions formed by conventional $s$-wave superconductors and a $\PT$-symmetric collinear antiferromagnet modeled on CuMnAs. Using microscopic modeling and symmetry analysis, we show that these junctions exhibit both the Josephson diode effect and $\varphi_{0}$-junction states. Remarkably, both effects are controlled by the Néel vector: rotating it by $90^{\circ}$ switches off both, while reversing it switches the diode polarity. To reveal the microscopic mechanism, we develop a channel-resolved scattering theory that accurately captures the anomalous phases and establishes the exact condition for the diode effect. The interplay of the channel current-phase relations yields a sizable diode efficiency, tunable by both the magnitude and direction of the exchange field. Furthermore, a Green-function reduction identifies a single renormalized $\PT$-degenerate band as the transport carrier and precisely reproduces the full current amplitudes. Our work establishes $\PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets as versatile platforms for field-free, highly tunable Josephson diodes and $\varphi_{0}$ junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由s波超导体和PT对称共线反铁磁体（以CuMnAs为模型）构成的约瑟夫森结，发现这类结同时表现出约瑟夫森二极管效应和φ₀结态，两者均可通过Néel矢量方向控制（旋转90°关闭，反转则切换二极管极性），并建立了通道分辨散射理论揭示其微观机制。
AI.motivation: 超导与磁性相互作用在约瑟夫森结中可产生丰富物理现象，但对于PT对称反铁磁体作为Josephson结材料的研究尚不充分，作者希望探索其作为可调谐约瑟夫森二极管和φ₀结平台的潜力。
AI.method: 采用微观建模与对称性分析研究s波超导/PT对称共线反铁磁体（CuMnAs）/s波超导约瑟夫森结；开发通道分辨散射理论揭示反常相位的微观起源；利用Green函数约化方法识别输运载流子为单一重整化PT简并带。
AI.result: 证明该结同时存在约瑟夫森二极管效应和φ₀结态；Néel矢量旋转90°可关闭两者，反转可切换二极管极性；通道分辨散射理论准确捕获反常相位并给出二极管效应的精确条件；通道电流-相位关系的相互作用产生可观的二极管效率，可通过交换场的幅值和方向调谐；Green函数约化精确重现完整电流幅值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了PT对称反铁磁体作为无外场、高度可调谐的约瑟夫森二极管和φ₀结的多功能平台。

title: Topographic Disorder, Wind Coupling, and Directional Fire Spread: Critical Behavior in a Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model
summary: We introduce the Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model (TFFM), a lattice model in which fire spreads on a spatially correlated Gaussian height field with the asymmetric bond probability $p_{i\to j}=\mathrm{clip}[e^{-β+γ(h_j-h_i)},0,1]$, plus an additive wind bias. Simulations up to $L=8192$ reveal a sharp active-to-inactive transition whose critical suppression threshold $β_c$ is even in $γ$, decreases with $|γ|$, and decreases as the terrain correlation length $σ_h$ is reduced: slope asymmetry acts as a suppressant because downhill bonds are penalized and fire stalls at local elevation maxima. For rough terrain and low tree density, the fire fails to percolate even at zero suppression. Finite-size scaling gives a front-velocity exponent $δ=0.34\pm0.02$, identical for smooth and rough terrain and matching neither directed percolation ($ν_\parallel-ν_\perp\approx0.56$) nor isotropic percolation ($\approx0.18$). The single-seed survival probability at $β_c$ is independent of $L$ and decays extremely slowly, with a running exponent falling from $\approx0.09$ to $\approx0.04$, excluding directed percolation and suggesting a survival probability that remains finite at criticality, consistent with the $L$-independent value $P^*\approx0.5$ at which $P_{\rm surv}$ drops to zero. The correlation-length exponent cannot be resolved at these sizes, consistent with slow crossover corrections from quenched correlated disorder. Wind raises $β_c$ by a factor of 2--4, produces a sharp onset of downwind fire-scar drift at weak coupling, and, at high terrain coupling, decreases the burned fraction at boundary crossing---a terrain-wind competition effect absent from isotropic bond-disorder models. The model yields fire-risk thresholds and fire-scar signatures comparable to satellite burn-scar data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出地形加权林火模型(TFFM)，研究火灾在空间相关高斯地形场上的传播。模拟揭示活跃-非活跃相变，发现地形坡度不对称性抑制火灾传播，风偏置则增强传播，两者存在竞争效应。火前速度指数δ=0.34±0.02，既不符合有向渗流也不符合各向同性渗流。
AI.motivation: 理解地形与风对森林火灾传播的联合影响，特别是空间相关无序地形如何改变火灾渗流行为及其临界性质，并建立与卫星燃烧痕迹数据可比的火灾风险评估模型。
AI.method: 在空间相关高斯高度场上构建晶格火灾模型，采用不对称键概率p=clip[e^(-β+γ(h_j-h_i)),0,1]描述坡度效应，叠加风偏置。模拟系统尺寸达L=8192，通过有限尺寸标度分析临界指数。
AI.result: 发现尖锐的活跃-非活跃转变，临界抑制阈值β_c对γ为偶函数且随|γ|增大而减小。粗糙地形与低树密度下火灾即使零抑制也不渗流。火前速度指数δ=0.34±0.02，与地形光滑度无关，既不符合有向渗流也不符合各向同性渗流。存活概率衰减极慢，在临界点保持有限值P*≈0.5。风使β_c提升2-4倍并产生火灾疤痕漂移。
AI.conclusion: 坡度不对称性作为抑制因子导致火灾在局部高程极大值处停滞；粗粒无序地形带来慢交叉修正使关联长度指数无法在小尺寸解析。模型火灾风险阈值与疤痕特征与卫星数据可比，揭示了地形-风竞争效应。

title: Theory of staggered damping-like spin-orbit torque on synthetic antiferromagnetic domain walls
summary: The Néel, or staggered, spin-orbit torque (SOT) enables an efficient electrical manipulation of antiferromagnetic order. However, it has been tied to special crystal structures, and only its field-like component is established. We develop a theory of staggered damping-like SOT, which arises generically in synthetic antiferromagnets sandwiched by the same heavy metal on both sides. Deriving a Néel-vector Lagrangian, we obtain the domain-wall (DW) velocity in closed form: bilinear in current and in-plane field, opposite in sign for Néel and Bloch walls, and tunable through the interlayer exchange coupling. DW structure thus becomes a control knob for DW motion, while the DW motion, in turn, offers an electrical readout of its structure. Micromagnetic simulations confirm the theory. The predicted sign reversals and scaling laws of the DW velocity, together with the thresholds for the Néel-Bloch transition, give immediate experimental targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在合成反铁磁体中普遍存在的交错阻尼类自旋轨道矩（SOT）理论，推导出畴壁速度的闭式表达式，该速度与电流和面内磁场呈双线性关系、对Néel和Bloch畴壁符号相反，且可通过层间交换耦合调节，从而将畴壁结构作为畴壁运动的控制旋钮，并提供其电学读出手段。
AI.motivation: Néel（交错）自旋轨道矩虽然能高效电学操控反铁磁序，但此前局限于特定晶体结构且仅确立了类场分量；需要发展更普遍且包含阻尼类分量的理论框架，以拓展其应用范围。
AI.method: 在两侧同种重金属夹层的合成反铁磁体中推导Néel矢量拉格朗日量，进而得到域壁速度的闭式解；并通过微磁模拟验证理论结果。
AI.result: 得到畴壁速度闭式公式：与电流和面内场双线性，对Néel与Bloch畴壁符号相反，可通过层间交换耦合调节；同时预测了速度符号反转、标度律及Néel-Bloch转变阈值，为实验提供了直接可测目标，微磁模拟证实理论。
AI.conclusion: 交错阻尼类SOT在合成反铁磁中普遍存在，畴壁结构可作为控制畴壁运动的旋钮，而畴壁运动又提供其结构的电学读出，为相关实验提供了明确的可验证预测。

title: Competing Ring-Opening and Hofmann Elimination Pathways in Aqueous TEMPO Catholytes: A First-Principles Study
summary: Aqueous redox-flow batteries based on TEMPO derivatives are promising for large-scale energy storage, but their practical use is limited by the chemical instability of the oxidized N -oxoammonium state. In this work, we investigate the degradation of five TEMPO derivatives using ab initio molecular dynamics combined with enhanced sampling. Two proposed degradation mechanisms, ring opening and Hofmann elimination, are examined and their corresponding activation free energies are compared. For all derivatives considered, ring opening exhibits a lower activation free energy than Hofmann elimination, identifying it as the kinetically preferred degradation pathway. The magnitude of the ring-opening barrier, however, varies significantly between molecules, showing that different functionalizations strongly influence its stability toward degradation. The predicted preference for ring opening is consistent with available experimental studies, which have identified or inferred ring-opening degradation for several TEMPO-based catholytes. These results provide an atomistic picture of degradation pathways that are difficult to resolve experimentally and highlight the importance of molecular structure in controlling the kinetic stability of TEMPO derivatives in aqueous electrolytes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过从头算分子动力学结合增强采样方法，研究了五种TEMPO衍生物在水系氧化还原液流电池中的降解机制，发现开环反应是动力学优先的降解路径，其活化自由能低于Hofmann消除反应。
AI.motivation: TEMPO衍生物在水系氧化还原液流电池中具有大规模储能应用前景，但氧化态N-氧铵离子的化学不稳定性限制了其实际应用。理解降解机制对提高电池稳定性至关重要。
AI.method: 采用从头算分子动力学（ab initio molecular dynamics）结合增强采样方法，研究五种TEMPO衍生物的降解过程，比较开环和Hofmann消除两种降解机制的活化自由能。
AI.result: 所有衍生物中，开环反应的活化自由能均低于Hofmann消除反应，表明开环是动力学优先的降解路径。但开环势垒大小在不同分子间差异显著，说明不同官能化程度强烈影响其稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 预测的开环降解偏好与现有实验研究一致，该工作提供了实验难以分辨的降解路径的原子级图像，强调了分子结构在控制TEMPO衍生物水相动力学稳定性中的关键作用。

title: Textures as a phase-transition probe for quantum spin chains
summary: The idea of quantum texture has been recently proposed and used as a tool for quantifying coherences and for quantum gate identification. In this work we offer a study on its usage to quantum phase transitions, demonstrating the rugosity metric as a simple tool for effective phase-transition probing. We establish the link between rugosity in the computational basis and the hierarchy of spin correlators, and analyze rugosities defined in the global ground-state and in ground-states belonging to different magnetization sectors (to which we refer to as global vs symmetry-resolved rugosities) to study the phase diagram of the Heisenberg XXZ model. We find distinct rugosity signatures at both transition points. In particular, a sharp feature appears at $Δ=1$ already for small systems, revealing a pronounced sensitivity of the correlation hierarchy encoded by the texture to this point. Since the BKT transition coincides with the isotropic $SU(2)$ point of the XXZ model, this behavior may reflect a particular sensitivity of rugosity to the structure of the spin-correlation hierarchy at isotropy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子纹理（quantum texture）中的粗糙度（rugosity）度量作为量子相变探测工具的应用，分析了XXZ海森堡模型的全局与对称性分辨粗糙度，发现其在两个相变点均有显著特征，尤其在Δ=1处即使小系统也表现出尖锐特征。
AI.motivation: 量子纹理作为量化相干性和量子门识别的新工具已被提出，但其在量子相变探测中的应用尚未得到充分研究。作者旨在探索粗糙度度量能否成为有效的相变探测工具，并理解其物理根源。
AI.method: 建立粗糙度（计算基下）与自旋关联子层级之间的联系；定义全局基态粗糙度和不同磁化扇区基态的对称性分辨粗糙度；将其应用于海森堡XXZ模型的相图研究。
AI.result: 在两个相变点（各向同性点和BKT转变点）均观察到不同的粗糙度特征。特别地，Δ=1处即使在小系统中也出现尖锐特征，表明纹理编码的关联层级对该点有显著敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 粗糙度度量可作为简单有效的量子相变探测工具，其对XXZ模型各向同性SU(2)点的尖锐敏感性可能反映了纹理对自旋关联层级结构的特定敏感性，且这种敏感性可能源于各向同性点自旋关联层级的独特结构。

title: Barrierless Water Dissociation on Rare-Earth Sesquioxide Surfaces from First Principles
summary: Water dissociation on metal oxide surfaces is a key elementary step in heterogeneous catalysis, photocatalysis, and radiation chemistry, yet its mechanistic details on rare-earth (RE) sesquioxides remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate water dissociation on the (110) surfaces of three cubic bixbyite oxides, Sc$_2$O$_3$, Y$_2$O$_3$, and Lu$_2$O$_3$, using molecular dynamics combining ab initio calculations with on-the-fly machine-learning force field acceleration. By sampling 25 independent trajectories per material, we obtain an unbiased picture of the reaction landscape inaccessible to conventional static calculations. Two distinct dissociation pathways are identified: a conventional proximal mechanism with a small but finite barrier of $\sim$0.1 eV, and a previously unreported distal mechanism that is effectively barrierless and energetically preferred at both the adsorption and dissociation stages. The low barriers are consistent with the periodic array of inherently undercoordinated RE$^{3+}$ sites in the bixbyite lattice, suggesting that ordered intrinsic coordination defects play a role analogous to stochastic oxygen vacancies in conventional oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文利用结合从头算与在线机器学习力场加速的分子动力学方法，系统研究了三种立方方铁锰矿结构稀土倍半氧化物(Sc₂O₃、Y₂O₃、Lu₂O₃)的(110)表面上水的解离过程。通过每个材料25条独立轨迹的采样，发现了两种不同的解离路径：常规的近端机制(具有~0.1 eV的小但有限的能垒)和先前未报道的远端机制(基本上无势垒且在吸附和解离阶段均能量更优)。低势垒与方铁锰矿晶格中周期性排列的内在欠配位RE³⁺位点一致，表明有序的内在配位缺陷发挥着类似于传统氧化物中随机氧空位的作用。
AI.motivation: 水在金属氧化物表面的解离是多相催化、光催化和辐射化学中的关键基元步骤，但稀土倍半氧化物上的解离机理细节至今仍不明确。传统静态计算无法充分描述该反应全貌，因此需要一个无偏见的视角来理解反应势能面。
AI.method: 采用结合从头算计算与在线机器学习力场加速的分子动力学方法，对三种立方方铁锰矿氧化物(Sc₂O₃、Y₂O₃、Lu₂O₃)的(110)表面进行水解离模拟。每个材料采样25条独立轨迹以获得统计上无偏见的反应图景。
AI.result: 识别出两种不同的解离路径：1)常规的近端机制，具有~0.1 eV的小但有限能垒；2)先前未报道的远端机制，基本无势垒且在吸附和解离阶段均能量更优先。低势垒源于方铁锰矿晶格中周期性排列的内在欠配位RE³⁺位点。
AI.conclusion: 有序的内在配位缺陷在稀土倍半氧化物中的作用类似于传统氧化物中随机氧空位的角色，这为理解该类材料表面的水活化行为提供了新的机理性认识。

title: $1/3$-Flux Bound States in Multicomponent Superconductor Exhibiting Non-Abelian Statistics of $\mathbb {Z}_3$ Parafermions
summary: Multicomponent superconductors (MSCs) are predicted to host magnetic flux quanta carrying arbitrary fractions of the superconducting flux quantum. Recent advances have raised the expectation that $1/3$ flux quanta may emerge in MSCs with $C_3$ rotational symmetry. Electrons bound to such fractional flux are long regarded to form anyons, yet their explicit braiding statistics remain unexplored. We propose that these 1/3-flux bound states (1/3-FBSs) exhibit the intriguing non-Abelian statistics of $\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermions. Under no-double-occupancy constraint, two successive braiding operations of 1/3-FBSs are equivalent to a single $\mathbb Z_3$ parafermion braiding operation. The parafermion parity encoding the braiding outcome can be read out via the fermionic occupation number of the 1/3-FBSs. Combined with a crossed-Andreev-reflection-induced Hadamard gate, one can realize the complete set of $\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion braiding operations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多组分超导体（MSCs）中预测存在的1/3磁通量子束缚态（1/3-FBSs），提出这些束缚态展现出$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion的非阿贝尔统计性质。在无双重占据约束下，两次连续的braiding操作等价于单次$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion braiding，且可通过费米子占据数读出braiding结果；结合交叉Andreev反射诱导的Hadamard门，可实现完整的$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion braiding操作集。
AI.motivation: 多组分超导体被预测可承载携带任意分数超导磁通量子的磁通激发，特别是具有$C_3$旋转对称性的系统中可能出现1/3磁通量子。虽然长期以来人们认为束缚于这类分数磁通上的电子会形成任意子，但其显式的编织（braiding）统计从未被探索过，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析1/3磁通束缚态的编织统计性质，在无双重占据（no-double-occupancy）约束下推导其braiding操作，证明其等价于$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion的编织。利用费米子占据数作为parafermion奇偶性读出机制，并结合交叉Andreev反射产生的Hadamard门，构建完整的$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion编织操作集合。
AI.result: 研究发现1/3-FBSs展现出$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion的非阿贝尔编织统计；两次连续编织等价于单次$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion编织；通过费米子占据数可读取编码编织结果的parafermion奇偶性；与Hadamard门结合后可实现完整的$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion编织操作集。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次明确了多组分超导体中分数磁通束缚态的编织统计，揭示了1/3磁通束缚态可提供$\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion非阿贝尔编织的平台，为拓扑量子计算中的更高阶非阿贝尔任意子实现提供了可行的理论方案。

title: Directional memory of early spectral selection during spinodal decomposition in finite systems
summary: Cahn-Hilliard phase separation turns small composition fluctuations into coarsening domains. In Fourier space, the pattern forms a ring whose angular intensity favors an axis. We ask whether the axis favored early in an evolution remains related to the axis favored later in the same evolution. We analyze two-dimensional simulations with isotropic initial fluctuations and no imposed direction. We introduce $Q_2$, a normalized angular average over the Fourier spectrum, as a measure of the strength and direction of spectral anisotropy. Linear growth amplifies different wave numbers at different rates, selecting an early axis from the angular imbalances in the initial spectrum. This axis remains correlated with the late axis during coarsening. At a fixed time, shallow quenches show stronger early-late alignment. This advantage disappears when the quenches are compared at similar stages of domain growth. Adding the early $Q_2$ to a prediction based on quench depth, mean composition, and box size reduces the mean absolute error for late $Q_2$ by $3.53\%$. This reduction disappears when only the magnitude of the early $Q_2$ is retained, or when its direction is replaced by the direction from another evolution. The early Fourier intensity therefore carries information about the later state of the same evolving field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Cahn-Hilliard相分离过程中，早期傅里叶谱的各向异性轴向（通过Q2度量）是否与后期粗化过程中的轴向相关联。研究发现早期择优轴与后期轴相关，且早期Q2信息能提升对后期Q2的预测精度（误差降低3.53%），表明早期傅里叶强度携带着关于同一演化场后期状态的信息。
AI.motivation: 理解相分离动力学中模式选择与各向异性演化的关联性，探究早期微小的角向涨落是否对后期演化方向具有预测价值，从而深化对无序系统中自发对称性破缺过程的理解。
AI.method: 对二维各向同性初始涨落（无外加方向）的Cahn-Hilliard模拟进行傅里叶分析，引入归一化角向平均量Q2度量谱各向异性的强度与方向，比较早期与晚期Q2方向的相关性，并通过控制淬火深度、平均成分和盒子尺寸等参数进行预测误差分析。
AI.result: 线性增长阶段对不同波数的不等放大从初始谱的角向不平衡中选择了早期轴，该轴与粗化晚期轴保持相关。固定时间比较时浅淬火显现更强的早晚对齐，但按域生长相似阶段比较时该优势消失。在预测中加入早期Q2使晚期Q2的平均绝对误差降低3.53%，仅保留早期Q2幅度或替换方向后此改善消失。
AI.conclusion: 早期傅里叶强度谱携带了关于同一演化场后期各向异性状态的有效信息，早期各向异性的方向而非仅其幅度是预测后期状态的关键因素，这揭示了Cahn-Hilliard动力学中早期涨落对后期演化的记忆效应。

title: Lindbladian Phase Geometry and Hall Transport in Open Bloch Systems
summary: Quantum geometry underlies a wide range of transport phenomena in Bloch systems. How quantum-geometric transport is modified when Bloch electrons are coupled to an environment, however, remains largely unexplored, even though the environment can alter both the electronic state and the physical current operator. Here we formulate dc linear response within a trace-preserving Lindblad kinetic theory by defining the physical velocity as the Liouvillian time derivative of the position operator. This construction reveals an environment-induced contribution to the current vertex whose momentum-space curl generates new Hall responses governed by the gauge-invariant phase geometry encoded by Lindblad jump amplitudes, which characterize electron-environment coupling. To leading order in the dissipative coupling, this geometry gives rise to interband shift-vector and diagonal-vorticity Hall responses arising from off-diagonal and diagonal jump amplitudes, respectively. Remarkably, both mechanisms can produce a finite Hall conductivity even when the conventional Berry-curvature anomalous Hall effect vanishes identically. Our work establishes Lindbladian phase geometry as an independent geometric origin of transverse transport in open quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 本文在Lindblad开放量子系统框架下建立了dc线性响应理论，通过定义李雅普诺夫速度算子揭示了环境诱导的电流顶点修正，其动量空间旋度产生由Lindblad跳变振幅相位几何决定的新型霍尔响应，即使Berry曲率反常霍尔效应为零时仍可产生有限霍尔电导。
AI.motivation: 量子几何在Bloch系统中主导多种输运现象，但Bloch电子与环境耦合时量子几何输运如何被修正尚不清楚，因为环境会同时改变电子态和物理电流算符。
AI.method: 在保迹Lindblad动力学框架内构建dc线性响应理论，将物理速度定义为位置算符的李雅普诺夫时间导数，由此揭示出环境诱导的电流顶点贡献；其动量空间旋度生成由Lindblad跳变振幅（编码电子-环境耦合的规范不变相位几何）控制的新型霍尔响应。在耗散耦合主导阶下，非对角和对角跳变振幅分别产生带间shift-vector和diagonal-vorticity霍尔响应。
AI.result: 两种机制（off-diagonal和diagonal jump amplitudes对应的响应）即使在传统Berry曲率反常霍尔效应严格为零时，仍能产生有限的霍尔电导率。
AI.conclusion: 确立了Lindblad相位几何作为开放量子物质中横向输运的独立几何起源，为理解环境修饰的量子几何输运提供了新的理论框架。

title: Examination of Cluster Based Methods to Fermionic Systems
summary: We present the cluster mean field(cMF) and its extensions into perturbation theory(cPT) and coupled cluster(cCC) methods for fermionic systems. We discuss how the commutation rules for fermionic systems modifies the method as well as other computational details. We then perform calculations on the Hubbard model and a few select conjugated molecules to demonstrate the efficacy of the method. We will also use these examples to compare cluster methods to CAS-SCF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了费米子系统的簇平均场（cMF）方法，并将其扩展到微扰理论（cPT）和耦合簇（cCC）方法中，通过在Hubbard模型和共轭分子上的计算验证了方法的有效性，并与CAS-SCF进行了比较。
AI.motivation: 开发一种新的、有效的量子化学方法，能够处理强关联费米子系统，并希望在保持计算可行性的同时提供比CAS-SCF等传统方法更优或互补的性能。
AI.method: 提出簇平均场（cMF）方法作为基础，然后将其推广到微扰理论（cPT）和耦合簇（cCC）框架中，特别讨论了费米子对易规则对方法的修正以及相关的计算细节。
AI.result: 在Hubbard模型和若干共轭分子上进行了计算，展示了方法的有效性，并与CAS-SCF方法进行了对比分析。
AI.conclusion: 簇方法在费米子系统中展现出良好的性能，可作为处理强关联体系的有力工具，与CAS-SCF的比较有助于明确其适用范围和优势。

title: Observation of multipartite spin entanglement in a cuprate chain
summary: Quantum materials are believed to host highly entangled states of matter, but probing and quantifying such entanglement has long remained experimentally elusive. Here, we use resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) as a probe of multipartite spin entanglement. By projecting the RIXS cross section onto the appropriate spin excitation channel, we show that the Quantum Fisher Information can be extracted directly from the measured spin fluctuation spectrum. We detect at least 7-partite spin entanglement in the model one-dimensional cuprate Sr$_2$CuO$_3$, revealing one of the largest entanglement depths yet reported in a solid. The observed entanglement depth agrees with Hubbard-model expectations and persists to elevated temperatures. Our results establish RIXS as an experimental probe of many-body spin entanglement and provide a platform for extensions to charge and orbital sectors and nonequilibrium settings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）作为多体自旋纠缠的探针，通过将RIXS截面投影到合适的自旋激发通道，直接从测量的自旋涨落谱中提取量子Fisher信息。研究在一维铜氧化物Sr₂CuO₃中检测到至少7-partite自旋纠缠，这是固体中报道的最大纠缠深度之一，并建立了RIXS作为多体自旋纠缠实验探针的平台。
AI.motivation: 量子材料被认为蕴含着高度纠缠的物态，但长期以来在实验上探测和量化这种纠缠极具挑战性。现有方法难以直接观测固体中的多体自旋纠缠，亟需建立一种可行的实验探针来揭示量子材料中的纠缠特性。
AI.method: 使用共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）作为多体自旋纠缠的探针。通过将RIXS散射截面投影到合适的自旋激发通道，建立了从测量的自旋涨落谱中直接提取量子Fisher信息的理论框架，从而定量表征多体自旋纠缠。
AI.result: 在一维铜氧化物Sr₂CuO₃中检测到至少7-partite的自旋纠缠，这是固体材料中迄今报道的最大纠缠深度之一。观测到的纠缠深度与Hubbard模型的预期一致，并且能在较高温度下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究工作确立了RIXS作为多体自旋纠缠实验探针的有效性，并提供了一个可扩展至电荷、轨道扇区以及非平衡态环境的平台，为量子材料中量子纠缠的定量研究开辟了新途径。

title: First-Principles Study of Magnetism, Electronic Structure, and Bonding in Nb-Mn-Ge Kagome Compounds
summary: In this work, we systematically investigate the magnetic ground states, electronic structures, and bonding characteristics of the computationally predicted stable NbMn6Ge6, NbMn6Ge5, and NbMn6Ge4 using first-principles calculations. Our results show that structurally stable NbMn6Ge6 has a collinear antiferromagnetic configuration, while the metastable rhombohedral NbMn6Ge5 and NbMn6Ge4 favor ferromagnetic ground states. Magnetic moments on Mn atoms are nearly localized, suggesting the applicability of a generalized spin Hamiltonian. Magnetic anisotropy in AFM NbMn6Ge6 and FM NbMn6Ge5 has uniaxial behavior, while FM NbMn6Ge4 has in-plane anisotropy. Charge density difference and electron localization function analyses further show charge redistribution and bonding features within the Mn-Ge Kagome network and between adjacent structural layers. Electronic structures near the Fermi level show no features suitable for topological magnetism studies. Experimental synthesis, structural characterization, and magnetic measurements are required to verify our predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算系统研究了预测稳定的NbMn6Ge6、NbMn6Ge5和NbMn6Ge4化合物的磁性基态、电子结构和成键特征。结果显示NbMn6Ge6为共线反铁磁，而亚稳态的NbMn6Ge5和NbMn6Ge4更倾向于铁磁基态，Mn原子上的磁矩近乎局域化。各化合物的磁各向异性表现不同，费米能级附近电子结构不适合拓扑磁性研究，需实验验证。
AI.motivation: 探索含Mn-Ge Kagome网络的Nb-Mn-Ge体系中不同化学计量比化合物的磁性基态和电子结构，评估其潜在应用价值，为实验合成提供理论预测依据。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（密度泛函理论），系统研究三种预测稳定化合物的结构稳定性、磁性基态（反铁磁/铁磁）、电子结构、磁各向异性，并通过电荷密度差和电子局域函数分析成键特征。
AI.result: NbMn6Ge6为结构稳定的共线反铁磁体；NbMn6Ge5和NbMn6Ge4（亚稳态菱面体结构）倾向铁磁基态。Mn磁矩接近局域化，NbMn6Ge6和NbMn6Ge5呈现单轴磁各向异性，NbMn6Ge4具有面内各向异性。Mn-Ge Kagome网络和层间存在电荷重分布与成键特征，但费米能级附近缺乏适合拓扑磁性研究的电子结构特征。
AI.conclusion: 这三种Nb-Mn-Ge化合物展现了多样的磁性和各向异性行为，但电子结构不适合拓扑磁性研究。需要实验合成、结构表征和磁性测量来验证理论预测。

title: Geometry-induced current decrowding in superconducting 3D constrictions
summary: Current crowding is a ubiquitous limitation in nanoscale devices, where confinement and sharp features distort current flow, generating localized current-density hotspots and premature failure. In superconductors, this effect suppresses the order parameter and promotes vortex nucleation, reducing the critical current below the intrinsic depairing limit. Here, we demonstrate that 3D shaping of superconducting nanoarchitectures overcomes geometric current crowding through spatial current redistribution, establishing a geometry-induced decrowding effect. Using finite-element modeling based on the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equation, we reveal that 3D constrictions exhibit a pronounced and tunable response to moderate in-plane magnetic fields---a functionality absent in planar geometries. This field-controlled geometry enables critical-current modulation and unveils new vortex-dynamics regimes, including a non-reciprocal critical current. Furthermore, curvature and finite thickness fundamentally alter vortex nucleation by enabling apex-mediated entry of single vortex lines, followed by their 3D splitting into two vortex filaments---a mechanism that does not occur in 2D manifolds. Our findings demonstrate 3D geometric engineering as a design paradigm for superconducting nanoarchitectures, offering control over current distribution and vortex dynamics in devices approaching the depairing limit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基于时间依赖Ginzburg-Landau方程的有限元建模，证明三维超导纳米结构的三维塑形能够克服几何电流拥挤效应，实现电流空间再分布，并在中等面内磁场下展现可调响应、临界电流调制、非互易临界电流及独特的涡旋动力学机制（顶点介导单涡旋线进入后三维分裂为两条涡旋丝），提出三维几何工程作为超导纳米器件设计的新范式。
AI.motivation: 电流拥挤是纳米尺度器件中普遍存在的限制因素，在超导体中会抑制序参量并促进涡旋成核，从而降低临界电流使其低于内禀解对极限（depairing limit）。传统平面（2D）几何无法解决这一根本问题，需要探索新的机制来克服几何电流拥挤。
AI.method: 采用基于时间依赖Ginzburg-Landau（TDGL）方程的有限元建模方法，对三维超导纳米结构（三维收缩区，即3D constrictions）进行仿真分析，研究其在面内磁场下的电流分布、涡旋动力学和临界电流行为。
AI.result: 研究表明：1) 3D结构通过空间电流再分布实现了几何诱导的去拥挤效应（decrowding effect）；2) 3D收缩区对中等面内磁场展现出显著且可调的响应，这是平面几何所不具备的功能；3) 实现了临界电流调制和非互易临界电流；4) 曲率和有限厚度通过顶点介导方式使单涡旋线进入，随后3D分裂为两条涡旋丝，这种机制在2D流形中不存在。
AI.conclusion: 三维几何工程可作为超导纳米架构的设计范式，为在接近解对极限运行的器件中提供对电流分布和涡旋动力学的精确控制，开辟了超越平面器件的超导纳米器件设计新途径。

title: Tensor network investigation of the monomer-dimer model on the honeycomb lattice
summary: The monomer-dimer model is one of the most well-known unsolved lattice models. In this paper we study the monomer-dimer model on the honeycomb lattice using the tensor network method, in the case that the dimer and monomer activities are 1. The monomer-dimer configurations are exactly mapped into the ground states of the antiferromagnetic Ising model on the Kagomé lattice in the critical field $H_{\rm{ex}}=4J$, and the tensor network is constructed based on the local ground states of each Ising triangle. The VUMPS approach is employed to contract the tensor network, providing a high-precision result of the monomer-dimer problem. We also revisit the edge coloring problem on the honeycomb lattice and discuss its relationship to the monomer-dimer model. Finally we formulate the monomer-dimer problem in the language of the sixteen-vertex model, and discuss the non-integrability of the general monomer-dimer model and the integrability of the pure dimer model.

AI.tldr: 本文利用张量网络方法研究蜂窝晶格上的单体-二聚体模型（活动度均为1），通过将其精确映射为Kagomé晶格上临界场H=4J的反铁磁Ising模型基态，构建张量网络并用VUMPS方法收缩，获得高精度结果，同时探讨了与边染色问题及十六顶点模型的关系。
AI.motivation: 单体-二聚体模型是最著名的未解晶格模型之一，缺乏精确解，需要发展高精度数值方法来求解其配分函数及相关性质。
AI.method: 1) 将单体-二聚体构型精确映射为Kagomé晶格上临界场Hex=4J的反铁磁Ising模型基态；2) 基于每个Ising三角形的局域基态构建张量网络；3) 采用VUMPS（变分均匀矩阵乘积态）方法收缩张量网络；4) 回顾蜂窝晶格边染色问题并讨论与单体-二聚体模型的关系；5) 将问题表述为十六顶点模型语言，讨论可积性。
AI.result: VUMPS方法为单体-二聚体问题提供了高精度数值结果；厘清了边染色问题与单体-二聚体模型的联系；阐明了单体-二聚体模型（一般情形）的不可积性与纯二聚体模型的可积性。
AI.conclusion: 张量网络方法（结合Ising映射）是求解单体-二聚体模型的有效高精度手段，且通过顶点模型表述可深入理解该模型的可积性结构。

title: Unveiling the Scaling Potential of Drain Merge through Active (DMtA) in CFETs: Breaking the Super-Via Bottlenecks and Unlocking New PPA Boosters
summary: Drain merge (DM), a super via vertically connecting the common S/D terminals of stacked n/pFETs in Complementary FETs (CFETs), blocks further parasitic optimization and cell scaling. For the first time, this work systematically investigates the state-of-the-art Drain Merge through Active (DMtA), a revolutionary technology reported recently with the DM embedded in the active region, through a comprehensive DTCO framework spanning process integration, contact-configuration-dependent (CTCD) compact modeling, standardcell design, RO evaluation and block-level PPA benchmark on a 32-bit RISC-V Ibex core. By reducing DM parasitics and enabling DM-width optimization, DMtA improves RO frequency by 11.7% over its conventional Drain Merge through field (DMtF) counterpart. Active widening and Area Borrowing, the latter first reported in [8] and exploiting spatial slack in adjacent cells to further enlarge the nanosheet width (WNS), increase the maximum Ibex-core frequency by up to 34.8%. More importantly, DMtA also enables the once GAA-exclusive Hyper-cells on CFETs by merging the active regions across adjacent cell rows, providing a further 8.7% frequency gain. A post-routing floating-output-pin-aware optimization further removes redundant S/D contacts (CTs) and reduces power by 5.3%. Finally, DMtA facilitates more area-efficient 2.5T cell scaling by preserving single-row cell compatibility, reducing post-PR core area by 25.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了一种革命性的工艺技术——Active区漏极合并（DMtA），通过完整的DTCO框架（涵盖工艺集成、接触构型相关紧凑建模、标准单元设计、环形振荡器评估及32位RISC-V Ibex内核的模块级PPA基准测试），验证了DMtA相比传统Drain Merge through Field（DMtF）技术的显著优势。
AI.motivation: 在互补FET（CFETs）中，垂直连接堆叠n/pFET公共源漏端子的超通孔（Drain merge, DM）阻碍了进一步的寄生优化和单元缩放，亟需探索新的技术方案来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 通过全面的DTCO（设计-技术协同优化）框架系统研究DMtA技术，包括：1) 工艺集成方案；2) 接触构型相关（CTCD）紧凑建模；3) 标准单元设计；4) 环形振荡器评估；5) 采用Active加宽与Area Borrowing（区域借用，利用相邻单元的空间余量进一步扩大纳米片宽度WNS）；6) 路由后浮空输出引脚感知优化以去除冗余S/D接触。
AI.result: DMtA降低DM寄生并使DM宽度可优化，RO频率较DMtF提升11.7%；Active加宽与Area Borrowing使Ibex内核最大频率提升高达34.8%；DMtA还使GAA专属的Hyper-cells首次适用于CFET（跨相邻行合并active区域），带来额外8.7%频率增益；路由后浮空输出引脚感知优化移除冗余接触，功耗降低5.3%；DMtA通过保持单行单元兼容性实现更面积高效的2.5T单元缩放，布线后核心面积减少25.7%。
AI.conclusion: DMtA技术通过降低DM寄生、优化寄生宽度、支持Hyper-cell实现和高效单元缩放，在频率、功耗和面积（PPA）等多维度全面超越了传统DMtF方案，为CFET技术的进一步优化和规模化发展开辟了新路径。

title: Orbital choice in constructing model Hamiltonians
summary: Model Hamiltonians (e.g., the Hubbard or Heisenberg models) provide a simple yet physically meaningful description of complex electronic phenomena through a small number of parameters, such as electron hopping integrals or magnetic exchange couplings. Their construction typically exploits the local nature of electron correlation effects and therefore relies on localized orbitals. Although many localization schemes are available, the resulting localized orbitals depend not only on the chosen localization functional but also on the orbital space to which the localization procedure is applied. These choices are often treated as technical details and are rarely discussed explicitly. Here, we demonstrate that different, chemically reasonable choices of localized orbitals can lead to substantially different model Hamiltonian parameters, even when they produce nearly identical electronic energies. Using Density Matrix Downfolding, we systematically investigate how the localization functional and, more importantly, the choice of model orbital space affect effective Hamiltonians derived from ab initio calculations for representative $π$-conjugated systems and transition metal complexes.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了不同局域轨道选择（包括局域化泛函和模型轨道空间）对从头算推导出的模型哈密顿量参数的影响，发现即使电子能量几乎相同，不同化学上合理的局域轨道选择也会导致显著不同的模型参数。
AI.motivation: 模型哈密顿量（如Hubbard或Heisenberg模型）的构建依赖于局域轨道，但局域轨道的选择（局域化泛函和轨道空间）通常被视为技术细节而很少被明确讨论。作者希望揭示这些选择对模型参数的实际影响程度。
AI.method: 使用密度矩阵下折叠（Density Matrix Downfolding）方法，对代表性的π共轭体系和过渡金属配合物进行系统的从头算计算，考察不同局域化泛函和模型轨道空间选择对有效哈密顿量参数的影响。
AI.result: 不同的化学上合理的局域轨道选择会导致显著不同的模型哈密顿量参数，尽管这些选择产生的电子能量几乎相同。这一现象在π共轭体系和过渡金属配合物中均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 局域轨道的选择不是无关紧要的技术细节，而是会实质性地影响模型哈密顿量参数的推导结果。即使能量非常接近，参数也可能显著不同，这提醒研究者在构建和解读模型哈密顿量时需要谨慎对待局域轨道的选择。

title: Successive Phase Transitions from a Composite Fermion Liquid to a Fractional Quantum Hall State at ν=3/2 Driven by In-Plane Magnetic Field
summary: We report an even-denominator fractional quantum Hall state at ν = 3/2 induced entirely by in-plane magnetic field B_|| in an ultra-high-mobility GaAs quantum well. As B_|| increases, the system undergoes two successive transitions: from a composite fermion liquid to a soft-gap FQH state (B_||~12.2 T), then via a topological phase transition to a hard-gap robust FQH state (B_||~14.7 T), accompanied by a daughter state at ν = 19/13. We present systematic data, and discuss a possible scenario in interpreting these findings. Our work demonstrates that topological order may be engineered through k-space Fermi contour splitting under an in-plane magnetic field.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在超高迁移率GaAs量子阱中，仅由面内磁场B_||诱导出的ν=3/2偶分母分数量子霍尔态。随着B_||增加，系统经历两次连续转变：从复合费米子液体到软能隙FQH态（B_||~12.2 T），再通过拓扑相变到硬能隙稳健的FQH态（B_||~14.7 T），并伴随ν=19/13的子态出现。
AI.motivation: 探索在传统上被认为不会出现偶分母分数量子霍尔态的系统中，如何通过面内磁场这一外部控制手段来工程化拓扑序，从而扩展对新型量子物态的理解和调控能力。
AI.method: 在超高迁移率GaAs量子阱中施加面内磁场B_||，通过系统地改变磁场强度，观测系统从复合费米子液体到两个不同能隙特性的FQH态（软能隙和硬能隙）的相变过程，并表征伴随的子态。
AI.result: 观测到ν=3/2的偶分母FQH态完全由面内磁场诱导产生；系统在B_||~12.2 T经历第一次转变进入软能隙FQH态，在B_||~14.7 T经历拓扑相变进入硬能隙稳健FQH态；同时还观察到ν=19/13的伴随子态。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作证明了通过面内磁场引起的k空间费米面轮廓分裂，可以有效工程化拓扑序，为调控和设计新的分数量子霍尔物态提供了新的实验手段和物理机制。

title: $β-(Al_{0.19} Ga_{0.81})_2 O_3/Ga_2 O_3$ Modulation-Doped Field-Effect Transistors with $>$ 6 kV Breakdown
summary: $β-(Al_{0.19} Ga_{0.81})_2 O_3/Ga_2 O_3$ modulation-doped field-effect transistors (MODFETs) incorporating a high-quality Al2O3 gate dielectric and SiNx passivation are demonstrated for high-voltage operation. The devices exhibited a maximum drain current of 54 mA/mm, an on-resistance of 149 Ohm.mm, a minimum subthreshold slope of 94 mV/dec, and an ION/IOFF ratio exceeding $10^8$. Three-terminal breakdown measurements performed in Flourinert demonstrated a breakdown voltage that increased with gate-drain spacing, reaching 6.6 kV for a device with LGD = 28 microns. The corresponding average lateral electric field approached 2.4 MV/cm, while a power figure of merit of 222 MW/cm2 was achieved. To the best of the authors knowledge, the demonstrated breakdown voltage represents the highest reported value for a $β-(Al_x Ga_{1-x})_2 O_3/Ga_2 O_3$ MODFET and highlights the potential of modulation-doped $β$-Ga2O3 heterostructures for next-generation multi-kV power devices.

AI.tldr: 本文成功制备了采用Al2O3栅介质和SiNx钝化的β-(Al0.19Ga0.81)2O3/Ga2O3调制掺杂场效应晶体管(MODFET)，实现了6.6 kV的击穿电压（LGD=28μm），这是该材料体系MODFET的最高报告值，平均横向电场接近2.4 MV/cm，功率品质因数达222 MW/cm²，展示了其在下一代多kV功率器件中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: β-Ga2O3凭借超宽带隙和超高击穿场强被视为下一代功率半导体的有力候选材料，但此前β-(AlxGa1-x)2O3/Ga2O3 MODFET的击穿电压性能有限，需要探索更优的器件设计（如栅介质与钝化）来释放调制掺杂异质结构在高电压应用中的潜力。
AI.method: 在β-(Al0.19Ga0.81)2O3/Ga2O3调制掺杂异质结构上制备MODFET，并在器件中引入高介电常数Al2O3栅介质以改善栅控能力，同时采用SiNx钝化层抑制表面态和漏电；随后在Flourinert环境中进行三端击穿测试，并系统研究击穿电压与栅漏间距(LGD)的关系。
AI.result: 器件实现了54 mA/mm的最大漏极电流、149 Ω·mm的开态电阻、94 mV/dec的最小亚阈值摆幅以及超过10^8的开关比。三端击穿测试显示击穿电压随栅漏间距增大而提升，在LGD=28μm时达到6.6 kV，对应平均横向电场约2.4 MV/cm，功率品质因数达222 MW/cm²。
AI.conclusion: 该6.6 kV击穿电压是目前β-(AlxGa1-x)2O3/Ga2O3 MODFET的最高报告值，验证了Al2O3栅介质与SiNx钝化的有效性，凸显了调制掺杂β-Ga2O3异质结构在下一代多kV功率器件中的巨大潜力。

title: Thomas-Fermi screening of electrostatic fields in a type-I superconductor
comment: Main: 5 pages, 4 figures; Supplementary: 4 pages, 6 figures
summary: The empirical London equations make distinct predictions for a superconductor's longitudinal and transverse electrodynamic response. Conventionally, this framework attributes the Meissner effect to the transverse component, with the longitudinal response predicted to remain unchanged on entering the superconducting state, i.e. a static electric field is screened over the Thomas-Fermi length ($λ_{\mathrm{TF}} \sim 1$~Å), just as in the nonsupercondcuting metal. J.~E.~Hirsch~[\textit{Phys.~ Rev.~B}~\textbf{69},~214515~(2004)] has developed an alternative formalism, which predicts that the longitudinal screening length should instead be governed by the London penetration depth as the system is cooled below the superconducting transition temperature ($T_{\mathrm{c}}$). Here we use a combination of qPlus atomic force microscopy and scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy of single-crystal Pb(111) at $\sim$~340~mK~ \mbox{($T/T_{\mathrm{c}}\sim0.05$)} in an attempt to detect any modifications in electrostatic screening of the longitudinal tip field upon entering the superconducting phase. We quench superconductivity using a magnetic field of 200 mT normal to the Pb(111) surface. By measuring force-distance curves and local field-emission resonance spectra at the same sample position in the presence and absence of the magnetic field, we constrain the change in screening between the normal and superconducting state to less than $\sim 1 \%$. This is between two to three orders of magnitude smaller than that predicted by Hirsch's theory, and entirely consistent with unmodified Thomas-Fermi screening across the superconducting transition.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用qPlus原子力显微镜和扫描隧道显微镜/谱学技术，在约340 mK（T/Tc≈0.05）下对单晶Pb(111)表面进行测量，通过施加200 mT垂直磁场淬灭超导性，比较法向与超导态下的力-距离曲线和场发射共振谱，发现超导转变前后静电屏蔽变化小于约1%，远低于Hirsch理论预测的两个到三个数量级，证实纵向屏蔽仍由Thomas-Fermi长度主导。
AI.motivation: 验证超导体中纵向静电响应在进入超导态后是否发生改变。传统London方程框架认为纵向屏蔽长度（Thomas-Fermi长度）在超导转变时保持不变，而Hirsch提出的替代理论预测纵向屏蔽长度应由London穿透深度主导，二者存在根本分歧，需要实验裁决。
AI.method: 在约340 mK（T/Tc≈0.05）低温下，对单晶Pb(111)表面结合qPlus原子力显微镜与扫描隧道显微镜/谱学技术进行测量。通过施加200 mT垂直磁场淬灭超导性，在同一空间位置分别测量有无磁场条件下的力-距离曲线和局域场发射共振谱，比较法向态与超导态间的静电屏蔽差异。
AI.result: 实验测得超导态与法向态之间的屏蔽变化小于约1%，比Hirsch理论预测值小两到三个数量级，结果与超导转变过程中Thomas-Fermi屏蔽不变的预测完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，超导体进入超导态后纵向静电屏蔽长度并未由London穿透深度主导，Hirsch的替代理论预测不被实验支持，传统London方程框架下Thomas-Fermi屏蔽在超导转变中保持不变的描述得到了实验验证。

title: Leveraged Learning: entropy destroyed per bit received
comment: 87 pages, 22 figures, 11 tables, 44 worked examples. Expository in style; four appendices. Comments welcome
summary:
A learner holds a prior belief over boolean maps that answer a finite set of $Q$ questions, and receives answers one by one. Each answer costs surprisal and destroys uncertainty, not only about the question asked but every question still unasked. We call the ratio the leverage: table entropy destroyed per bit of surprisal received. It is unit for a uniform prior, but with an intelligent prior can be higher (not lower).
  Averaged over the truth prior and over the question order, the leverage is found exactly, and is generated by one sequence: the mean entropy $G_\ell$ of the answers to $\ell$ questions. Sending the number of input bits to infinity at fixed asked fraction $t = \ell/Q$, the increments of that sequence become a profile $γ(t)$, and initial question entropy $η_0$. The leverage closes to a thermodynamic limit. $L(t) = [η_0 - (1-t)γ(t)]/\int_0^t γ$.
  Exchangeable priors, by de Finetti, all give a flat $γ(t)$ and hence a hyperbolic $L(t)$, their deduction confined to a boundary layer at $t = 0$. We construct a simplicity prior that escapes this, grading Boolean maps by the degree of their polynomial over $\mathbb{F}_2$ and budgeting weight across degree shells by a CDF $F$. Reed-Muller capacity then gives $γ(t) = 1 - F(t)$ exactly, so any nonincreasing profile, and any leverage curve it generates, is realizable at macroscopic times.

AI.tldr: 本文研究学习者通过接收布尔答案来消除不确定性的过程，提出"杠杆率"（leverage）概念：单位惊异（surprisal）所摧毁的表熵。在智能先验下杠杆率可超过1。作者精确推导出杠杆率的平均值，并将其收敛到热力学极限。可交换先验（de Finetti）导致平坦熵曲线和双曲杠杆率，而作者构造了一种简单性先验（基于F₂上多项式度数与Reed-Muller容量），可实现在宏观时间尺度上任意的非增熵轮廓及其产生的杠杆曲线。
AI.motivation: 研究具有先验知识的智能体在问答过程中如何高效地利用信息——每一答案不仅消除所问问题的不确定性，还消除其他未问问题的不确定性。作者希望理解先验结构（尤其智能先验）如何提升信息利用效率，并探索能否构造出超越可交换先验局限的先验分布。
AI.method: 定义杠杆率L为表熵摧毁量与惊异接收量之比；对真实先验与问题顺序取平均，精确求出杠杆率并由答案熵序列G_ℓ生成。通过令输入比特数趋于无穷（固定提问比例t=ℓ/Q），将序列增量转化为轮廓γ(t)，推导出热力学极限下的杠杆率公式L(t)=[η₀-(1-t)γ(t)]/∫₀ᵗγ。分析de Finetti可交换先验的平坦γ(t)特性，并构造基于F₂上多项式度和Reed-Muller容量的简单性先验，得到γ(t)=1-F(t)的精确结果。
AI.result: 证明杠杆率对均匀先验为单位值，智能先验可使其更高。可交换先验产生的γ(t)平坦，导致双曲杠杆率，且有效推理仅存在于t=0的边界层。通过Reed-Muller容量分析，简单性先验可精确实现γ(t)=1-F(t)，从而在宏观时间尺度上实现任意非增轮廓及相应的杠杆曲线，突破了可交换先验的局限。
AI.conclusion: 杠杆率提供了一个量化先验信息利用效率的新框架。结论表明：不是所有智能先验都等价——可交换先验虽然看似合理，但其推论能力仅局限于初始阶段；而基于多项式复杂度分级的简单性先验，借助Reed-Muller结构可以在整个提问过程中持续高效地消除不确定性。这揭示了先验结构对信息提取效率的深刻影响。

title: Trion-mediated quantum operations on a double-dot charge qubit
summary: A scheme for controlling a charge qubit on a semiconductor asymmetric double quantum dot with suppressed tunnel coupling between individual quantum dots is proposed. Laser pulses convert the logical single-electron states of the qubit into auxiliary trion states, for which the resonant tunneling condition is restored due to the compensation of structural asymmetry by the Coulomb interaction of the particles. The conditions for performing orthogonal single-qubit rotations are formulated. For a two-dimensional structure, the parameters of the qubit are calculated, and the dependence of the fidelity of the inversion operation on the parameters of the laser field and the rates of dissipative processes is obtained. It is shown that the considered algorithm is characterized by high speed and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在半导体非对称双量子点中控制电荷量子比特的方案。该方案通过激光脉冲将量子比特的逻辑单电子态转换为辅助三重态（trion）态，利用粒子间的库仑相互作用补偿结构不对称性，从而恢复共振隧穿条件。研究制定了正交单比特旋转的操作条件，并在二维结构中计算了量子比特参数，得到了反转操作的保真度对激光场参数和耗散过程速率的依赖关系，证明了该算法具有高速度和高可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在半导体非对称双量子点中，单个量子点之间的隧穿耦合受到抑制，这阻碍了电荷量子比特的有效控制。需要一种方案来恢复共振隧穿条件，实现对电荷量子比特的可控操作。
AI.method: 利用激光脉冲将量子比特的逻辑单电子态激发为辅助三重态（trion态），借助粒子间的库仑相互作用补偿结构的不对称性，从而恢复量子点间的共振隧穿条件，实现可控的单比特量子操作。
AI.result: 对于二维结构计算了量子比特参数，获得了反转操作的保真度对激光场参数及耗散过程速率的依赖关系，证明该控制算法具有高速度和高可靠性的特点。
AI.conclusion: 该方案通过库仑相互作用补偿结构不对称性的巧妙机制，成功实现了高速、可靠的电荷量子比特控制，为半导体量子点量子计算提供了可行的实现路径。

title: Balanced and broadly-normed meta-generalized gradient approximation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables; supplementary material provided as an ancillary file
summary: Conventional semi-local density functional approximations for the exchange-correlation energy systematically underestimate fundamental band gaps. Advanced meta-generalized gradient approximations (meta-GGAs) can partially overcome this limitation through their orbital dependence via the kinetic energy density. In principle, the flexible meta-GGA form should allow for balanced performance across diverse properties. However, atomization energies, reaction barrier heights, and lattice constants, as well as band gaps, exhibit different sensitivities to the large parameter space of meta-GGA functionals. In this work, we explore the space of appropriate norms that guide the r$^2$SCAN-type functional construction through the interpolation function connecting two fundamental paradigms: the one-electron limit and the uniform electron gas limit. We introduce local modifications to a strongly-smoothed interpolation function and investigate their impact on functional performance. To further probe the limits of the meta-GGA framework, we include spin-unpolarized bonded systems among the set of norms. The resulting bonded-norm bn-r$^2$SCAN meta-GGA achieves balance: band-gap predictions approaching the accuracy of the ultra-nonlocal LAK meta-GGA and lattice constants of nearly r$^2$SCAN accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了r²SCAN型meta-GGA泛函的构造空间，通过引入自旋非极化成键系统的范数，开发出bn-r²SCAN泛函，在带隙预测和晶格常数等性能上取得了良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 传统的半局域密度泛函近似会系统性地低估基本带隙，而先进的meta-GGA可以通过轨道依赖性部分克服这一局限。然而，原子化能、反应势垒高度、晶格常数和带隙对meta-GGA泛函的大参数空间表现出不同的敏感性，需要寻找合适的范数（norms）来指导泛函构造。
AI.method: 本研究探索了指导r²SCAN型泛函构造的范数空间，这些范数通过连接单电子极限和均匀电子气极限两个基本范式的插值函数来定义。作者对强平滑的插值函数引入局部修改，并首次将自旋非极化的成键系统纳入范数集合，从而构建出bonded-norm bn-r²SCAN meta-GGA泛函。
AI.result: bn-r²SCAN泛函在性能上实现了良好平衡：带隙预测精度接近超非局域LAK meta-GGA的水平，而晶格常数几乎达到r²SCAN的精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将成键系统范数纳入meta-GGA的构造过程，可以在带隙和晶格常数等不同性质之间实现更好的性能平衡，进一步挖掘了meta-GGA框架的潜力。

title: Kane-Lubensky phonons in Maxwell lattice frustrated Mott insulators
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures; Supplemental Material included (11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables)
summary: We show that zero-energy gapless Weyl-line phonons of the Kane-Lubensky's type can arise in the three-dimensional Maxwell lattice frustrated Mott insulators through the magnetopological mechanics. In a pyrochlore antiferromagnet with the spin-lattice coupling, a magnetic field selects the spin state whose lattice distortion generates a $P4_3 32$ topological lattice. More crucially, the spin-lattice coupling and the spin configuration cause the bending of the neighbouring bonds, and converts the system into the topological Maxwell lattice. Remarkably, the resulting system is found to host the bulk zero-frequency Weyl-line phonons protected topologically, and these gapless phonons are not Goldstone modes. Unlike the conventional ${C_{\rm ph}\sim T^3}$ for the Goldstone phonons, these one-dimensional zero-mode manifolds yield a characteristic low-temperature phonon specific heat ${C_{\rm ph}\sim T^2}$. Our results could find applications in the Cr-based spinel systems, and moreover, we establish a low-energy platform where an extensive number of topological zero-frequency phonons can strongly couple to other degrees of freedom, opening a route to exotic phonon-mediated phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在三维麦克斯韦晶格阻挫莫特绝缘体中，通过磁拓扑力学可产生Kane-Lubensky型零能无隙Weyl线声子。在具有自旋-晶格耦合的烧绿石反铁磁体中，磁场选择自旋态，其晶格畸变生成P4₃32拓扑晶格，自旋-晶格耦合与自旋构型导致相邻键弯曲，将系统转化为拓扑麦克斯韦晶格，从而承载受拓扑保护的体零频Weyl线声子（非Goldstone模式），其低温声子比热呈C_ph~T²特征而非传统~T³。
AI.motivation: 探索三维系统中拓扑保护的零能无隙声子模式，特别是寻找超越传统Goldstone声子的新型量子激发，以及建立拓扑零频声子与其他自由度强耦合的低能平台，为奇异的声子媒介现象开辟道路。
AI.method: 通过磁拓扑力学机制，在三维麦克斯韦晶格阻挫莫特绝缘体（烧绿石反铁磁体）中利用自旋-晶格耦合，由磁场选择特定自旋态并诱导晶格畸变形成P4₃32拓扑晶格，自旋构型与自旋-晶格耦合引起键弯曲使系统转化为拓扑麦克斯韦晶格，从而产生受拓扑保护的零频Weyl线声子。
AI.result: 成功在系统中实现体零频率Weyl线声子，这些无隙声子受拓扑保护且不是Goldstone模式；一维零模流形产生特征低温声子比热C_ph~T²（区别于传统Goldstone声子的T³），并在Cr基尖晶石系统中具有潜在应用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了承载大量拓扑零频声子并能与其他自由度强耦合的低能平台，为探索奇异的声子媒介现象和拓扑声子物理开辟了新途径，潜在应用于Cr基尖晶石体系。

title: Machine learning for the design and prediction of soft-magnetic electromagnetic shielding FeCo-based alloys in laser cladding
summary: Electromagnetic shielding materials play a pivotal role in both aerospace applications and daily life. However, their design and manufacturing still face persistent challenges. Machine learning demonstrates significant potential in accelerating material development and compositions optimization. Furthermore, laser additive manufacturing provides powerful technical support for fabricating multi-component, multifunctional electromagnetic shielding materials with tailored properties. In this study, the multiple machine learning strategies have been proposed, based on experimental derivation and soft magnetic material databases, to accelerate the design of multifunctional FeCo-based alloys for electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding within an almost infinite compositional space. This work presents a novel approach for the rapid and automated discovery of multifunctional alloys with optimized EMI shielding effectiveness, as well as enhanced magnetic and electrical properties.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于实验数据和软磁材料数据库的多策略机器学习方法，结合激光增材制造技术，加速设计用于电磁干扰屏蔽的多功能FeCo基合金，在近乎无限的成分空间中快速自动发现兼具优异电磁屏蔽效能、磁性能和电性能的合金。
AI.motivation: 电磁屏蔽材料在航空航天和日常生活中的应用至关重要，但其设计和制造仍面临持续挑战。传统方法难以在庞大成分空间中高效探索多功能材料，需要加速材料开发和成分优化。
AI.method: 提出多种机器学习策略，基于实验推导和软磁材料数据库，结合激光增材制造技术，在近乎无限的成分空间中加速设计多功能FeCo基合金。
AI.result: 实现了对具有优化电磁屏蔽效能以及增强磁性能和电性能的多功能合金的快速和自动化发现。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为在广阔成分空间中快速自动发现多功能电磁屏蔽合金提供了新颖方法，展示了机器学习与先进制造技术相结合加速材料设计的潜力。

title: Fabrication And Characterization Of High-Quality Nb/Al-AlO$_x$/Nb Cross-Type Josephson Tunnel Junctions Utilising CMP-based Planarisation Techniques
comment: Submitted to the Journal "Superconductor Science and Technology"
summary: Josephson tunnel junctions (JJs) are the fundamental building blocks of today's most advanced superconducting electronic components, such as qubits and superconducting quantum interference devices (SQUIDs). Given the ongoing demand for scalability of these devices on the wafer-scale, it is crucial to control the fabrication process as precisely as possible to ensure uniform quality and reproducibility. Today, window-type JJs are often used in the production of DC SQUIDs and while they are reliable and reproducible, they suffer from alignment inaccuracies caused by photolithography and unavoidable parasitic capacitances, thus limiting the energy sensitivity of DC SQUIDs. These problems can be circumvented by producing JJs with cross-type geometry, which allows for smaller junction areas and eliminates parasitic capacitances. Here we discuss the fabrication of Nb/Al-AlOx/Nb-based cross-type JJs, where the trilayer is embedded in sputter-deposited SiO$_2$ to allow for planarisation of the structures and to ensure the reliable insulation of the sidewalls of the bottom electrode. Instead of lift-off processes that require a lot of time and potentially leave unwanted wings along the edges of microstructures behind that might compromise subsequent layers, we use chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP) for the removal of excess SiO$_2$. This is not only much faster, but produces smooth and uniform surfaces, which in turn effectively improves the reliability of our JJ production process resulting in a high yield of over $90\,\%$ on wafer-scale. In addition, we discuss the influence of fabrication details on the quality and electrical properties of our JJs with different junction areas down to $1\,\mathrm{μm} \times 1\,\mathrm{μm}$ distributed across the wafer and extract the junction specific quality parameters from their IV-characteristics and their Fraunhofer patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了基于Nb/Al-AlOx/Nb的交叉型Josephson隧道结（JJs）的制备工艺，采用化学机械抛光（CMP）替代传统剥离工艺，将三层膜嵌入溅射沉积的SiO₂中实现结构平坦化和侧壁可靠绝缘，在晶圆尺度上实现了超过90%的高成品率，并研究了不同结面积（小至1μm×1μm）的质量与电学特性。
AI.motivation: 窗口型JJs虽可靠且可重复性好，但存在光刻对准误差和不可避免的寄生电容，限制了DC SQUIDs的能量灵敏度。随着超导电子器件（如量子比特和SQUIDs）对晶圆级可扩展性的持续需求，需要更精确的制备工艺以确保均匀质量和可重复性。交叉型几何结构可以规避这些问题，允许更小的结面积并消除寄生电容。
AI.method: 制备Nb/Al-AlOx/Nb交叉型JJs，将三层膜嵌入溅射沉积的SiO₂中以实现平坦化和侧壁绝缘；采用化学机械抛光（CMP）替代耗时且易产生边缘翼片（wings）的剥离工艺来去除多余的SiO₂；通过IV特性曲线和Fraunhofer图案提取结特定的质量参数，评估不同结面积（小至1μm×1μm）的制备细节对质量和电学性能的影响。
AI.result: 采用CMP工艺不仅比剥离工艺快得多，而且产生光滑均匀的表面，有效提升了JJ生产过程的可靠性，在晶圆尺度上实现了超过90%的高成品率。研究了不同结面积（小至1μm×1μm）的JJs的质量和电学特性。
AI.conclusion: 交叉型JJs结合CMP平坦化工艺可以克服窗口型JJs的局限性（对准误差和寄生电容），实现晶圆级高成品率的超导器件制备。

title: Speed Limit for Information Acquisition in Stochastic Learning Dynamics
summary: Neural networks acquire internal representations through learning. In this work, we formulate stochastic gradient descent (SGD) as a Markovian stochastic process and derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit that bounds the rate at which trainable parameters can acquire information about latent variables in the data-generating process. The resulting inequality decomposes the information flow into drift and noise contributions, thereby quantifying the roles of deterministic learning forces and SGD-induced fluctuations from an information-theoretic perspective. We verify the bound in analytically tractable basis-function linear regression, where the information budget predicted by the bound reproduces the ordering and characteristic time scales with which different latent variables are encoded in the learned parameters. These results establish Fisher-information speed limits as a quantitative framework for diagnosing when and how different aspects of the data-generating mechanism are acquired during stochastic learning.

AI.tldr: 本文将随机梯度下降(SGD)建模为马尔可夫随机过程，推导出Fisher信息流速度极限，用以约束可训练参数获取数据生成过程中潜在变量信息的速度界限，并通过可解析求解的基函数线性回归验证了该界限。
AI.motivation: 神经网络通过学习获取内部表征，但我们对学习过程中参数如何以及何时获取关于数据生成机制的不同信息缺乏定量理解。需要建立一种信息论框架来刻画SGD学习过程中信息获取的速率与顺序。
AI.method: 将SGD形式化为马尔可夫随机过程，推导Fisher信息流速度极限。该不等式将信息流分解为漂移项（确定性学习力）和噪声项（SGD诱导波动）两部分贡献，从信息论角度量化二者作用。
AI.result: 在解析可解的基函数线性回归中验证了该界限，结果表明该界限预测的信息预算能够重现不同潜在变量被编码进学习参数时的排序顺序和特征时间尺度。
AI.conclusion: Fisher信息速度极限可作为定量框架，用于诊断随机学习过程中数据生成机制的不同方面何时以及如何被获取。

title: Static-Dynamic Correlations and Complex Spin-Wave Eigenmodes in Single- and Multilayer Diamond-Shaped Nanomagnets Without Bias Field
summary: Diamond-shaped nanomagnets provide a suitable platform for developing microwave devices with reconfigurable characteristics. In this study, the static and dynamic magnetic behaviour of single layer and multilayer diamond-shaped nanomagnets was systematically investigated using micromagnetic simulations. Two distinct remanent magnetic configurations were obtained through a simple magnetic field initialization process. These configurations exhibited different magnetization patterns and dynamic responses. Their resonance characteristics could be modified by applying a nanosecond-scale magnetic field pulse, enabling reconfigurable microwave operation. A clear resonance frequency shift in the sub-GHz (0.9 GHz) range was observed for the single-layer structure, while the multilayer structure exhibited a significantly larger frequency shift in the GHz range (3 GHz). The larger frequency tunability observed in the multilayer configuration arises primarily from the enhanced dipolar coupling between the vertically coupled magnetic layers, which modifies the local effective magnetic field and consequently influences the magnetization dynamics. These findings demonstrate that diamond-shaped nanomagnets can provide a simple and effective route toward reconfigurable microwave functionality, with potential applications in ultralow-power, ultrafast, and frequency tunable microwave devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过微磁学模拟系统研究了单层和多层菱形纳米磁体的静磁与动态磁行为，发现通过简单磁场初始化可获得两种不同的剩磁构型，多层结构因垂直层间偶极耦合增强而展现出更大的共振频率可调范围（3 GHz vs 0.9 GHz），为可重构微波器件的开发提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 菱形纳米磁体可作为开发具有可重构特性微波器件的理想平台，但对其静磁和动态行为缺乏系统性理解，尤其是单层与多层结构之间的差异及其机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用微磁学模拟方法，对单层和多层菱形纳米磁体进行系统研究；通过简单的磁场初始化过程获得两种不同的剩磁构型；施加纳秒级磁场脉冲来调控其共振特性并观察频率偏移。
AI.result: 单层结构观察到亚GHz（0.9 GHz）范围的清晰共振频率偏移，而多层结构表现出显著更大的GHz范围（3 GHz）频率偏移。多层结构更大的频率可调性主要源于垂直耦合磁层间增强的偶极耦合，该耦合改变了局部有效磁场并影响磁化动力学。
AI.conclusion: 菱形纳米磁体可为可重构微波功能提供简单有效的实现途径，在超低功耗、超快和频率可调的微波器件中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Theory of Kondo hybridization wave in Kondo lattice
summary: Recent scanning tunneling microscopy experiments have discovered emergent spatially modulated Kondo hybridization wave (KHW) order in the heavy fermion superconductor UTe$_2$ and the artificial Kondo lattice system 1T/1H-TaS$_2$, challenging the conventional paradigm of spatially uniform Kondo hybridization in heavy fermion physics. Here, we develop a microscopic theory for KHW order based on the canonical square-lattice Kondo lattice model within the large-$N$ fermionic mean-field approximation. We systematically identify stable modulated KHW phases and establish their ground-state phase diagram. The prominent $\boldsymbol{Q}=(0,π)$ KHW phase yields uniaxial stripe modulation of the Kondo hybridization gap, which faithfully reproduces the spatial modulation pattern observed in UTe$_2$. Moreover, its inherent unit-cell-doubling modulation precisely accounts for the spectroscopic features measured in 1T/1H-TaS$_2$. We further predict a characteristic in-plane conductivity anisotropy that serves as a definitive transport fingerprint to discriminate KHW states with distinct ordering wavevectors. Our work provides a microscopic foundation for the newly observed KHW order and establishes a unified theoretical framework for understanding emergent modulated hybridization phenomena in heavy fermion materials.

AI.tldr: 本文基于大N费米子平均场近似下的正方晶格Kondo晶格模型，建立了Kondo杂化波（KHW）有序的微观理论，系统识别了稳定的调制KHW相并构建了基态相图。Q=(0,π)的KHW相能忠实复现UTe₂中的空间调制图案，其晶胞加倍调制精确解释了1T/1H-TaS₂的光谱特征，并预言了一种可用于区分不同KHW态的面内电导各向异性输运指纹。
AI.motivation: 近期STM实验在重费米子超导体UTe₂和人工Kondo晶格体系1T/1H-TaS₂中发现了空间调制的Kondo杂化波（KHW）有序，这挑战了重费米子物理中Kondo杂化空间均匀的传统范式，急需建立相应的微观理论框架。
AI.method: 基于规范的正方晶格Kondo晶格模型，采用大N费米子平均场近似，系统识别稳定的调制KHW相并建立基态相图。
AI.result: 发现Q=(0,π)的KHW相具有Kondo杂化带的单轴条纹调制，能复现UTe₂的观测图案，其晶胞加倍调制精确解释1T/1H-TaS₂的光谱特征，并预言了面内电导各向异性作为区分不同KHW态的输运指纹。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为KHW有序提供了微观理论基础，建立了理解重费米子材料中涌现调制杂化现象的统一理论框架。

title: First-principles-based Prediction of Phase Fields: Part I. Binary and Ternary Refractory Alloys
summary: Multiple principal element alloys (MPEAs) exhibit complex phase equilibria involving multinary solid solutions and intermetallics, which makes it challenging to predict their temperature-composition phase diagrams. Their vast compositional space makes first principles methods prohibitively expensive, while CALPHAD is limited by scarce experimental data. Here, we present a computationally efficient framework to predict the solvus phase boundaries, and hence, phase fields, in refractory MPEAs composed of Cr, Hf, Mo, Nb, Ta, Ti, V, W, and Zr. The approach combines DFT calculated binary mixing enthalpies with sub regular solution models to construct phase diagrams without fitting higher order interactions, enabling efficient scaling across composition space. Validation against 36 binary and 15 ternary phase diagrams demonstrates good agreement, with both experimental results and CALPHAD calculations. We find that the prediction accuracy is enhanced by incorporating lattice dependent energetics through sub regular solution models and including temperature-dependent elemental phase transitions. The framework captures miscibility gaps, solid solution stability, and intermetallic formation, with predicted miscible temperatures typically within 300 K of experimental values. Overall, this work establishes a scalable, first principles based route for highthroughput prediction of phase diagrams in refractory MPEAs. A publicly accessible web interface has also been developed to allow interactive exploration of the predicted phase diagrams, available at https://raptor.engr.wustl.edu.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算效率高的框架，用于预测难熔多元主元合金（MPEAs）的固溶线相边界和相区。该方法将DFT计算的二元混合焓与亚正则溶液模型相结合，无需拟合高阶相互作用即可构建相图，并通过36个二元和15个三元相图验证了其准确性。
AI.motivation: 难熔MPEAs具有复杂的相平衡（多组元固溶体和金属间化合物），其温度-成分相图难以预测。巨大的成分空间使第一性原理方法计算成本过高，而CALPHAD方法又受限于实验数据匮乏。
AI.method: 将DFT计算的二元混合焓与亚正则溶液模型相结合来构建相图，无需拟合高阶相互作用；通过亚正则溶液模型纳入晶格依赖的能量学，并包含依赖温度的元索相变；可跨成分空间高效扩展。
