AI.result: 在36个二元和15个三元相图上与实验结果和CALPHAD计算均表现出良好一致性；亚正则溶液模型和温度依赖的元索相变能提高预测精度；框架能捕捉混溶间隙、固溶体稳定性和金属间化合物形成，预测的混溶温度通常在实验值的300 K以内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了基于第一性原理的可扩展路线，用于难熔MPEAs相图的高通量预测，并开发了公开可访问的网页界面（https://raptor.engr.wustl.edu）供交互式探索。

title: Junction-free polarity-tunable superconducting diode effect enables XNOR logic operation
summary: The realization of the superconducting diode effect (SDE), characterized by non-reciprocal supercurrent, is a major step towards dissipationless logic circuits. A polarity-tunable superconducting diode with high diode efficiency primarily consists of Josephson-junction architectures that couple two superconducting regions via a weak link. Realizing an SDE without a weak-link junction would reduce fabrication complexity, lower electrical noise, and minimize dependence on junction quality. Here, we report an all-vdW, highly efficient, junction-free SDE in NbSe2, enabled by proximity-induced symmetry breaking from a strong uniaxial ferromagnet Fe3GeTe2 (F3GT). Superconducting diode efficiency of up to 30% is achieved at a small magnetic field of 50 mT. A field-free diode rectification effect is realized with diode polarity that is tunable by the F3GT spin polarization. Furthermore, by employing the active-field dependence of the SDE, a two-input exclusive-NOR (XNOR) logic gate operation is demonstrated. The findings highlight the potential utilization of magnetic proximity effect towards realizing junction-free superconducting diodes for high-performance, energy-efficient logic circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种在NbSe2中实现的全范德华、无结、高效率超导二极管效应（SDE），通过强单轴铁磁体Fe3GeTe2（F3GT）的近距感应对称性破缺实现。二极管效率高达30%（50 mT小磁场下），并实现无场整流效应，极性可通过F3GT自旋极化调控，且演示了双输入XNOR逻辑门操作。
AI.motivation: 传统的超导二极管效应依赖约瑟夫森结架构（弱连接），但此架构增加了制造复杂性、带来更高电噪声并受制于结质量。因此，寻找无需弱连接结即可实现SDE的方案，对简化器件制造和提升性能具有重要意义。
AI.method: 利用NbSe2与强单轴铁磁体F3GT构成的异质结构，通过磁近距效应诱导对称性破缺，实现无结SDE；利用F3GT自旋极化的可调控性实现二极管极性切换；并利用SDE的有源场依赖性构建XNOR逻辑门。
AI.result: 在50 mT的小磁场下实现最高达30%的超导二极管效率；实现无场二极管整流效应，且极性可通过F3GT的自旋极化方向调控；成功演示了双输入XNOR逻辑门操作。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了磁近距效应在实现无结超导二极管方面的潜力，为构建高性能、节能的逻辑电路提供了新途径。

title: Nonequilibrium stochastic thermodynamics of boundary functionals: From Zubarev's ensemble to stochastic particle separation
summary: This paper develops a generalization of Zubarev's nonequilibrium statistical operator method for the case of simultaneous inclusion of additive and nonlocal boundary functionals of trajectories. Using a unified thermodynamic approach, a three-parameter model of nonequilibrium systems is constructed, including the first-passage time, the dwell time above a given level, and the absolute extremum of the process. A correspondence is demonstrated between the maximum information entropy method for trajectories and the Donsker-Varadan large deviation formalism. Using the Doob`s h-transform, it is demonstrated that fixing extremal functionals of history induces efficient non-Markovian transport in the system with dynamic adaptation to historical records. Criteria for the applicability of the developed apparatus in the "large time" domain and the possibilities of its use for optimizing stochastic particle separation in periodic potentials are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了Zubarev非平衡统计算符方法的广义形式，同时纳入加性和非局部边界轨迹泛函，构建了包含首达时间、给定电平以上驻留时间和过程绝对极值的三参数非平衡系统模型，并展示了与Donsker-Varadhan大偏差形式体系的对应关系。
AI.motivation: 现有Zubarev非平衡统计算符方法在处理非平衡系统时通常只考虑加性泛函或局部边界条件，难以全面刻画具有历史依赖性和极端事件特征的随机过程。需要一种统一的框架来同时处理加性和非局部边界泛函，以描述更为复杂的非平衡动力学现象。
AI.method: 1) 将Zubarev非平衡统计算符方法推广至同时包含加性和非局部边界轨迹泛函的情形；2) 基于统一热力学方法构造包含首达时间、居留时间和绝对极值的三参数非平衡系统模型；3) 建立最大信息熵方法与Donsker-Varadhan大偏差形式体系之间的对应关系；4) 利用Doob h-变换分析固定极值泛函如何诱导有效的非马尔可夫输运及动态适应行为。
AI.result: 证明了最大信息熵轨迹方法与Donsker-Varadhan大偏差形式主义之间的对应关系；通过Doob h-变换展示了固定极值泛函可诱导具有历史记录动态适应能力的非马尔可夫输运；给出了"大时间"域内方法的适用性判据，并探讨了其在周期势中随机粒子分离优化中的应用可能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为描述具有历史极值约束的非平衡系统提供了统一的理论框架，揭示了路径条件约束与非马尔可夫输运之间的深层联系，并为随机粒子分离等实际应用提供了新的优化工具。

title: Layer-Dependent Phonons, Excitons, and Magneto-Optical Phenomena in CrSBr: A Mini Review
summary: Two-dimensional layered magnetic materials offer a versatile platform for exploring low-dimensional magnetism and coupled many-body interactions in these materials. Chromium sulfur bromide (CrSBr) is a promising candidate for advanced spintronic and optoelectronic applications because of its intrinsic air stability, semiconducting nature, strong in-plane anisotropy, and A-type antiferromagnetic ordering. This review summarizes recent advances in the understanding of the layer-dependent vibrational and excitonic properties of CrSBr, as well as its magneto-optical response, from bulk crystals to the monolayer limit. We examined its crystal structure, magnetic anisotropy, and interlayer spin reorientation, followed by insights into vibrational dynamics and spin-phonon coupling. Particular emphasis is placed on the excitonic landscape, including magnetic-field-sensitive photoluminescence, localized excitonic states, and the coexistence of Frenkel- and Wannier-Mott excitons in the bandgap. Finally, we discuss the challenges and prospects of harnessing the unique layer-dependent properties of CrSBr in spintronic, magneto-optical, and quantum photonic technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于二维层状磁性材料CrSBr的综述，总结了从块体到单层极限下其层依赖的振动和激子性质、磁光响应，以及自旋-声子耦合和磁性激子态方面的最新研究进展。
AI.motivation: CrSBr作为一种具有本征空气稳定性、半导体特性、强面内各向异性和A型反铁磁有序的二维层状磁性材料，是先进自旋电子学和光电子学应用的理想候选平台，因此系统总结其物理性质对相关领域至关重要。
AI.method: 该综述系统梳理了CrSBr的晶体结构、磁各向异性、层间自旋重取向，分析了其振动动力学与自旋-声子耦合，并重点阐释了激子景观，包括磁场敏感的光致发光、局域激子态以及Frenkel和Wannier-Mott激子在带隙中的共存现象。
AI.result: 文章整合了CrSBr从块体到单层体系中层依赖振动和激子性质的研究成果，揭示了其独特的磁-光耦合特性和激子行为。
AI.conclusion: 作者讨论了CrSBr独特层依赖性质在自旋电子学、磁光技术和量子光子技术中的应用挑战与前景。

title: Collective Excitonic Structure Governs Anomalously Weak Thermal Optical Dephasing in Conjugated Polymers
summary: Conjugated polymer aggregates exhibit optical decoherence in the presence of strong vibronic coupling and substantial diversity in chemical structure, solid-state organization, and excitonic character. Here, we use coherence-detected and population-detected two-dimensional electronic spectroscopies to examine the temperature dependence of the homogeneous optical linewidth across a series of semiconducting polymers. Despite substantial differences in molecular architecture and solid-state organization, all polymers studied exhibit remarkably weak thermal linewidth scaling over the measured temperature range. Comparison between complementary detection modalities further shows that, while this weak temperature dependence is obust, the absolute homogeneous linewidth depends on the measured observable. This behavior reflects the different ways in which coherence- and population-detected measurements project population relaxation and pure dephasing onto the spectroscopic response. These results establish the weak thermal scaling of optical decoherence across a diverse series of conjugated polymers and show that its experimental manifestation must be interpreted in the context of the detection observable.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用相干检测和布居检测的二维电子光谱技术，研究了一系列半导体聚合物的均匀光学线宽随温度的变化。尽管聚合物在分子结构和固态组织上差异显著，所有材料均表现出极弱的温度依赖线宽扩展。但检测方式不同时绝对线宽不同，反映了两种检测方式对布居弛豫和纯退相过程的不同投影方式。
AI.motivation: 共轭聚合物聚集体在强振动耦合以及化学结构、固态组织和激子特性高度多样性的条件下表现出光学退相干。为了理解这些复杂体系中光学退相干的普遍规律及其温度依赖性，需要系统地考察不同聚合物体系的均匀线宽。
AI.method: 采用相干检测和布居检测两种互补的二维电子光谱技术，对一系列结构不同的半导体聚合物进行温度依赖的均匀光学线宽测量，并对比两种检测模态下的结果。
AI.result: 所有被测聚合物在测量温度范围内均表现出显著微弱的温度线宽标度。两种检测模态的对比显示，虽然弱的温度依赖性具有鲁棒性，但绝对均匀线宽依赖于所测观测量。
AI.conclusion: 多种共轭聚合物体系的光学退相干均表现出弱热标度特性；实验表现必须在检测观测量（相干检测 vs. 布居检测）的语境中加以解读，因为两种检测方式以不同方式将布居弛豫和纯退相过程投影到光谱响应上。

title: High-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with tunable magnetic field
summary: The control and perturbation of quantum phenomena with magnetic fields is an indispensable tool in materials research. Recently, in-situ field tuning was implemented into angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (magneto-ARPES), which provides direct momentum and energy-resolved information of the field-dependent electronic structure. However, aberrations of the electron trajectories were shown to be substantial, leading to significant spectral distortions and broadening even in small fields. Here we show that the electronic structure can be recovered from magneto-ARPES spectra with high accuracy while maintaining high momentum resolution even when strong trajectory aberrations are present. We studied Bi$_2$Se$_3$ in a dipole field of a coil using a laser-based ARPES system. The electronic structure was reconstructed in post-processing using detailed electron trajectory simulations. We identify two-dimensional (2D) momentum mapping, a micron beam spot size, and precise numerical field simulations as critical technical requirements for high-resolution magneto-ARPES. We show how circular dichroism can provide additional information about the coupling of the magnetic field to the spin. The experimental achievements and the scaling laws from our simulations provide a road map towards magneto-ARPES in larger fields.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何从磁光电子能谱（magneto-ARPES）中高精度恢复电子结构，即使在存在强烈轨迹像差的情况下也能保持高动量分辨率。作者使用激光ARPES系统在偶极场中研究Bi₂Se₃，通过后处理和详细的电子轨迹模拟重建电子结构，并确定了二维动量映射、微米级束斑和精确数值场模拟等关键技术要求。
AI.motivation: 磁场调控量子现象是材料研究的重要工具，磁光电子能谱（magneto-ARPES）虽然能提供磁场依赖电子结构的直接动量-能量分辨信息，但电子轨迹像差严重，导致即使是小磁场下也会出现显著的光谱畸变和展宽，限制了该技术的应用。
AI.method: 使用基于激光的ARPES系统在偶极线圈磁场中研究Bi₂Se₃，通过后处理过程中详细的电子轨迹模拟来重建电子结构，并利用圆二色谱提供磁场与自旋耦合的额外信息。
AI.result: 在存在强烈轨迹像差的情况下，成功以高精度和高动量分辨率恢复了电子结构。识别出二维动量映射、微米束斑尺寸和精确数值场模拟是实现高分辨率magneto-ARPES的关键技术要求，并通过模拟给出了放大磁场条件下的标度规律。
AI.conclusion: 该实验成果和模拟标度规律为在更大磁场下实现magneto-ARPES提供了路线图，推动了该技术向更广泛应用的进一步发展。

title: Revealing the origin of ionic conduction in silver-iodide-doped silver phosphate glass
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Supplemental Information available on request
summary: Fast ionic transport is a defining feature of many solid electrolytes, yet its microscopic origin is not fully understood. In the absence of microscopic insights, the development of next-generation solid-state batteries remains largely empirical. Most existing measurements access either the low-frequency transport response or the high-frequency bound polarization, yet the intermediate mesoscopic frequency regime is where ionic transport emerges. By varying the $\mathrm{AgI}$ concentration ($x$) and performing time-domain terahertz spectroscopy (TDTS) in a prototypical glassy electrolyte $\left(\mathrm{AgI}\right)_{x}\left(\mathrm{AgPO_3}\right)_{(1-x)}$, we reveal this intermediate frequency regime and identify a crossover from bound-current-dominated conduction to conductivity arising from short-range dispersive ionic transport. We find that bound polarization associated with the bond-bending motion of the $\mathrm{P{-}O^- -Ag^+}$ motif is present across compositions but is insufficient to produce ionic transport on its own. Transport emerges only when this polarization is embedded in a sufficiently soft $\mathrm{AgPO_3}$ glassy matrix and accompanied by a high carrier density. These ingredients together take the system from a vibrationally bound response to short-range dispersive motion.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过改变AgI浓度并用太赫兹时域光谱（TDTS）研究原型玻璃电解质(AgI)x(AgPO3)(1-x)，揭示了中观介电频率区间内从束缚电流主导的传导到短程弥散离子输运的交叉现象。发现与P-O⁻-Ag⁺键弯曲运动相关的束缚极化存在于所有组分中，但仅当这种极化嵌入足够柔软的AgPO3玻璃基质并伴随高载流子密度时，离子输运才得以涌现。
AI.motivation: 固态电解质中快速离子输运的微观起源尚未被完全理解，缺乏微观洞察导致下一代固态电池的开发仍主要是经验性的。现有测量只能触及低频输运响应或高频束缚极化，中间介观频率区（离子输运涌现之处）一直未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用时域太赫兹光谱（TDTS）技术，通过系统地改变AgI浓度（x值）来扫描介观中频区，从而揭示束缚电流主导传导与短程弥散离子输运传导之间的交叉行为。
AI.result: 发现与P-O⁻-Ag⁺结构基元的键弯曲运动相关的束缚极化在所有组分中均存在，但单独不足以产生离子输运。只有当这种极化嵌入足够柔软的AgPO3玻璃基质中并伴随高载流子密度时，输运才真正涌现，使系统从振动束缚响应转变为短程弥散运动。
AI.conclusion: 离子输运的出现需要多种因素的协同：束缚极化作为前提，加上柔软基质和高载流子密度作为必要条件，才能实现从束缚响应到弥散性离子运动的跨越。这一认识为固态电解质的设计提供了微观层面的指导原则。

title: Coupled structural and electronic evolution under pressure in CuIr2Se4, CuRh2S4, and CuRh2Se4
summary: Spinel chalcogenides provide a platform for investigating the interplay among metallic, superconducting, and pressure-induced insulating states. Here, we combine synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction and electrical-resistivity measurements to investigate the pressure evolution of CuIr2Se4, CuRh2S4, and CuRh2Se4 over pressure ranges extending beyond those previously explored. High-pressure diffraction reveals closely related monoclinic supercells in all three compounds. For CuIr2Se4 and CuRh2S4, constrained profile fits based on structural models relaxed using density functional theory are compatible with Phase-IV-type bond-disproportionated structures, whereas the data for CuRh2Se4 establish a compatible monoclinic unit cell without resolving its atomic-scale ordering pattern. Insulating-like transport develops abruptly over a narrow pressure range in CuIr2Se4 but more gradually over broader pressure ranges in the Rh-based compounds, in close correspondence with their respective structural transformations. We also establish previously unreported bulk superconductivity in CuIr2Se4 at ambient pressure: zero resistance is attained at 0.29 K, and the accompanying ac diamagnetic response is consistent with nearly complete superconducting shielding. These results establish a close relationship between the formation of the high-pressure monoclinic phases and the evolution toward insulating transport, and demonstrate that transition-metal and chalcogen substitutions tune the characteristic pressure scales and the competition with superconductivity within a closely related structural framework.

AI.tldr: 本文通过同步辐射粉末X射线衍射和电阻率测量，系统研究了三种尖晶石硫族化合物（CuIr2Se4、CuRh2S4、CuRh2Se4）在高压下的结构演化和输运性质变化，发现三者均形成单斜超结构，其中Ir基化合物出现IV相型键歧化结构，且CuIr2Se4在0.29 K表现出先前未报道的体积超导电性。研究揭示了高压单斜相形成与绝缘化输运之间的密切联系。
AI.motivation: 尖晶石硫族化合物为研究金属态、超导态和压力诱导绝缘态之间的相互作用提供了理想平台，但此前对这些材料在更高压力范围内的结构和电输运演化认识不足，需要扩展研究压力范围来理解结构与物性转变的内在关联。
AI.method: 结合同步辐射粉末X射线衍射和电电阻率测量，在超出此前探索范围的压力区间内研究三种尖晶石化合物的压力演化；利用基于密度泛函理论弛豫的结构模型进行约束剖面拟合来确定高压晶体结构；同时通过电阻测量和磁响应表征超导转变。
AI.result: 三种化合物在高压下均形成密切相关的单斜超胞。CuIr2Se4和CuRh2S4与Phase-IV型键歧化结构兼容，而CuRh2Se4仅确定了单斜晶胞。CuIr2Se4在窄压力范围内突变发展绝缘性输运，Rh基化合物则在更宽压力范围内逐渐演变。此外，CuIr2Se4在环境压力下0.29 K实现零电阻，显示接近完全超导屏蔽。
AI.conclusion: 高压单斜相的形成与向绝缘性输运的演化密切相关；过渡金属和硫族元素的替换可在类似的结构框架内调控特征压力尺度和与超导电性的竞争关系。

title: When does nonreciprocity matter? Scale-dependence and nonequilibrium signatures
summary: Nonreciprocity is increasingly recognized as a unifying concept linking diverse nonequilibrium phenomena found across physics, chemistry, and biology. It gives rise to distinctive behavior including run-and-chase dynamics and spatio-temporal patterns, often associated with a breaking of time-reversal symmetry. However, nonreciprocity and its nonequilibrium signatures are fundamentally scale-dependent, and may emerge or disappear under coarse-graining. A central challenge is therefore to understand when and how nonreciprocity manifests itself on different scales, for example via irreversible fluctuations or macroscopic currents. In this Perspective, we discuss the physical origin and fate of effective nonreciprocal interactions and the characteristic irreversible dynamics they give rise to across scales.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇Perspective（观点性综述），探讨了非互易性（nonreciprocity）作为连接物理学、化学和生物学中多种非平衡现象的统一定性概念，重点讨论了非互易性如何在不同尺度上显现或消失，以及其导致的不可逆动力学特征。
AI.motivation: 非互易性与非平衡现象紧密相关，但其本质上是尺度依赖的——在粗粒化过程中可能涌现也可能消失。核心挑战在于理解非互易性在不同尺度上如何表现，例如通过不可逆涨落或宏观电流体现，这需要系统性的跨尺度审视。
AI.method: 作为Perspective类论文，采用概念性分析与框架性讨论的方法，从物理起源出发，梳理有效非互易相互作用的产生机制，并分析其在不同尺度下所引发的特征性不可逆动力学行为（如run-and-chase动力学、时空斑图等）。
AI.result: 论文阐明非互易性及其非平衡特征本质上是尺度依赖的，在粗粒化过程中可能涌现也可能消失，并系统关联了非互易性、时间反演对称性破缺与不可逆动力学之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 非互易性是连接跨尺度非平衡现象的统一定性框架，理解其在各尺度上的物理起源与命运，对于统一描述不同领域的非平衡行为具有重要意义。

title: Charge-spin conversion in altermagnets: electronic anisotropy versus magnon-mediated spin drag
summary:
Altermagnets acquire a momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization or spin-orbit coupling.
  This raises the question of whether the transport anisotropy originates in the electrons or the magnons, and whether the magnon-mediated channel distinguishes an altermagnet from a conventional antiferromagnet.
  We compute the spin-resolved conductivity of a metallic ferromagnet, antiferromagnet, and altermagnet within a common model, treating the spin-diagonal channel with the magnon self-energy and the spin-flip channel to leading order in the electron-magnon coupling.
  The anisotropy of the charge-spin conversion is dominated by the electronic spin splitting, the magnon branches contributing only marginally.
  The magnon-mediated spin-flip channel is even under $C_{4}$, so it carries no signature at first order in the anisotropy and cannot on its own distinguish an altermagnet from a conventional antiferromagnet.
  It does, however, respond linearly to a sublattice-selective perturbation that lowers the bulk $B_{1g}$ symmetry.
  The resulting susceptibility vanishes identically in the antiferromagnet, is small in the ferromagnet, and is finite in the altermagnet, where the electronic anisotropy ties spin and sublattice together, so that among magnets with no net magnetization it is unique to altermagnetic order.
  Being even in the magnetic domain index, this response can be measured without preparing a single magnetic-domain sample.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了交变磁体（altermagnet）中自旋分辨电导率的输运各向异性来源，发现电荷-自旋转换的各向异性主要由电子自旋劈裂主导，而磁振子通道贡献甚微；磁振子介导的自旋翻转通道在C4对称性下为偶函数，无法单独区分交变磁体与常规反铁磁体，但它对降低B1g对称性的亚晶格选择性微扰呈线性响应，该响应在反铁磁体中为零、铁磁体中很小、交变磁体中有限，因此是区分无净磁化磁性有序的独特探针。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体具有无净磁化或无自旋轨道耦合的动量依赖自旋劈裂。这引发了一个关键问题：其输运各向异性究竟源于电子还是磁振子，以及磁振子介导的通道能否区分交变磁体与常规反铁磁体。回答这一问题对于理解交变磁体的独特物理性质至关重要。
AI.method: 作者在统一模型中计算了金属铁磁体、反铁磁体和交变磁体的自旋分辨电导率：自旋对角通道采用磁振子自能处理，自旋翻转通道则处理到电子-磁振子耦合的领头阶。
AI.result: 电荷-自旋转换的各向异性由电子自旋劈裂主导，磁振子分支贡献甚微；磁振子介导的自旋翻转通道在C4下为偶对称，一阶各向异性中没有特征信号。然而该通道对降低块体B1g对称性的亚晶格选择性微扰呈线性响应，该响应在反铁磁体中恒为零、铁磁体中很小、交变磁体中有限。
AI.conclusion: 在无净磁化的磁性体系中，交变磁体独有的电子各向异性将自旋与亚晶格耦合在一起，产生独特的线性响应。该响应在磁畴指标下为偶函数，因此无需制备单磁畴样品即可测量，可作为区分交变磁体与常规反铁磁体的可靠实验探针。

title: Schwinger boson perturbation theory for spin-$S$ Kitaev-Heisenberg magnets: phase diagram and dynamical response near Kitaev spin liquids
summary: We develop a Schwinger boson perturbative framework for the spin-$S$ Kitaev-Heisenberg model. The spin-liquid saddle point of the pure Kitaev model is used as the unperturbed state, and magnetic instabilities and dynamical spin correlations are evaluated around this saddle point. We decompose the Hamiltonian exactly into two parts by exploiting the Klein duality intrinsic to the Kitaev-Heisenberg model. We perform the random-phase approximation by taking the part invariant under the duality transformation as the unperturbed term and treating the remaining term, which changes sign under it, as the perturbation. We determine the phase boundaries separating the quantum spin-liquid regimes from the adjacent magnetically ordered phases for $S=1/2$, $1$, $3/2$, and $2$. The spin-liquid regions shrink rapidly with increasing $S$ and become very narrow at $S=2$. We also compute the spin dynamics of the spin-$S$ Kitaev-Heisenberg model, focusing on $S=1$, and find that the dressed dynamical spin structure factor retains a broad two-spinon continuum at finite energies, while the low-energy spectral weight softens at the ordering wave vectors of the adjacent magnetic phases. Our framework thus enables thermodynamic-limit calculations of spin dynamics near magnetic instabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个用于自旋-S Kitaev-Heisenberg模型的Schwinger玻色子微扰框架，以纯Kitaev模型的自旋液体鞍点作为未微扰态，通过Klein对偶性分解哈密顿量并进行随机相位近似（RPA），计算了不同自旋值下的磁不稳定性和动力学自旋关联，确定了量子自旋液体区域与磁有序相的相边界，并计算了自旋动力学特性。
AI.motivation: Kitaev-Heisenberg模型是研究量子自旋液体与磁有序竞争的重要模型，但现有方法难以在热力学极限下准确计算接近磁不稳定性的自旋动力学。作者旨在建立一个统一的微扰框架，能够同时处理不同自旋值（从1/2到2）的Kitaev-Heisenberg模型，并评估自旋液体区域的稳定性及其随自旋增大的演变。
AI.method: 作者利用Kitaev-Heisenberg模型固有的Klein对偶性将哈密顿量精确分解为两部分：对偶变换下不变的部分作为未微扰项，对偶变换下改变符号的部分作为微扰项。以纯Kitaev模型的自旋液体鞍点作为未扰动态，采用随机相位近似（RPA）框架，在该鞍点周围评估磁不稳定性和动力学自旋关联。
AI.result: 确定了S=1/2、1、3/2和2时量子自旋液体区域与相邻磁有序相之间的相边界，发现自旋液体区域随自旋S增大而迅速缩小，在S=2时变得非常狭窄。针对S=1计算了自旋动力学，发现带重整化的动力学自旋结构因子在有限能量处保留了宽的双自旋子连续谱，而低能谱权重在相邻磁相的排序波矢处软化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了磁不稳定性附近自旋动力学的热力学极限计算，为理解Kitaev-Heisenberg模型中自旋液体与磁有序之间的竞争提供了有力工具，并揭示了自旋值对自旋液体稳定性的重要影响。

title: Stochastic Processes as Non-Metric Geodesics in Information Geometry
summary: We establish a one-to-one correspondence between geodesics associated with the one-parameter family of $α$-connections on the Gaussian statistical manifold and a class of continuous stochastic processes characterized by a time-independent noise intensity. We demonstrate that geodesics in expectation parameters naturally classify into three distinct geometric categories, among which the Boundary-connecting class allows us to construct an explicit linear stochastic realization with constant diffusion, representing a generalized bridge process. This result demonstrates how continuous stochastic processes within this Gaussian class can be extended along geometric curves. Under appropriate operational limits, this generalized bridge process reduces to fundamental stochastic dynamics, either Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) relaxation or free Brownian diffusion. Crucially, the physical restoring force governing the resulting OU relaxation directly determines the underlying connection parameter $α$, providing a concrete physical observable to constrain the manifold geometry. Depending on the chosen affine connection representation, this restoring force can be attributed either to scalar curvature or purely to non-metricity, establishing a direct conceptual analogy with the Geometrical Trinity of Gravity. Furthermore, applying this framework to driven stochastic thermodynamics, we show that the work-minimizing optimal protocol in the slow-driving limit coincides precisely with an expectation geodesic of the statistical manifold with non-metricity equipped with $(g, {}^{(1/2)}Γ, {}^{(-1/2)}Γ)$, highlighting the active physical role of non-metricity in information geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了高斯统计流形上α-联络族对应的测地线与一类具有时间无关噪声强度的连续随机过程之间的一一对应关系，并展示了期望参数下的测地线如何分类为三种几何类别，其中边界连接类可构造广义桥过程。该框架在极限下可退化为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck弛豫或自由布朗扩散，且物理恢复力直接决定联络参数α。文中还建立了与引力几何三位一体（Geometrical Trinity of Gravity）的概念类比，并证明了慢驱动极限下的功最小化最优协议恰好对应具有非度量性的期望测地线。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于连接信息几何与随机过程理论，揭示高斯统计流形上抽象几何结构（α-联络）的物理对应物，并探索非度量性在信息几何中的主动物理角色，为理解几何联络的物理可观测性提供新途径。
AI.method: 通过建立高斯统计流形上一参数α-联络族测地线与连续随机过程之间的精确对应关系；将期望参数测地线分类为三种几何类别；利用边界连接类构造具有恒定扩散系数的线性随机实现（广义桥过程）；对驱动随机热力学中的功最小化问题进行分析，验证其最优协议与期望测地线的一致性。
AI.result: 建立了测地线-随机过程的一一对应；广义桥过程在适当极限下退化为OU弛豫或自由布朗扩散；OU弛豫的物理恢复力可直接约束并确定联络参数α；恢复力可归因于标量曲率或纯非度量性（依赖联络表示），类比引力几何三位一体；慢驱动极限下的功最小化最优协议精确匹配具有非度量性的( g, ^{(1/2)}Γ, ^{(-1/2)}Γ )期望测地线。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了高斯流形上的α-联络几何具有明确的物理实现与可观测效应，特别是非度量性在信息几何中扮演了主动的物理角色，为几何框架与随机热力学的交叉提供了统一视角。

title: Direct Realization of Near-Ideal Carbyne in Ultrathin Boron Nitride Nanotubes
summary: Carbyne, the sp-hybridized one-dimensional allotrope of carbon, is predicted to be the stiffest known material, with electronic and optical properties set by a single structural parameter, the bond length alternation. However, its intrinsic properties have never been measured: chains synthesized through molecular chemistry carry endgroup and finite-length perturbations that persist even in the longest molecules available, while chains grown inside carbon nanotubes strongly couple to the host, which renormalizes their vibrational frequency by up to 110 cm$^{-1}$ in a diameter-dependent manner. Here, we show that encapsulating and thermally converting hydrogen-capped polyynes inside ultrathin boron nitride nanotubes, structural analogues of carbon nanotubes but electrically insulating, yields carbyne chains in a near-ideal regime, where endgroup, finite length, and host-guest perturbations are reduced to secondary effects. Statistical Raman spectroscopy across 245 locations returns a vibrational frequency distribution an order of magnitude narrower than in carbon nanotubes, an anharmonicity consistent with the universal law for carbyne-like materials, and a bond length alternation matching correlated calculations for the free chain. No photoluminescence is detected, despite the transparent host, as expected for the dipole-forbidden emission of an unperturbed carbyne chain. Boron nitride nanotubes give experimental access to carbyne in its near-ideal form.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在超薄氮化硼纳米管中封装并热转化氢封端多炔，成功制备了近理想状态的卡宾（carbyne）链。这种氮化硼纳米管是碳纳米管的结构类似物但具有电绝缘性，能有效减少端基、有限长度和主客体扰动等次级效应。通过245个位置的统计拉曼光谱分析，发现振动频率分布比碳纳米管窄一个数量级，非谐性与卡宾类材料的普遍规律一致，键长交替度与自由链的相关计算吻合。由于偶极禁戒发射，未检测到光致发光，符合未扰动卡宾链的预期。
AI.motivation: 卡宾作为sp杂化的一维碳同素异形体，理论上是最坚硬的材料，其电子和光学性质由单一结构参数（键长交替度）决定。然而其固有性质从未被直接测量过：分子化学合成的链受端基和有限长度的扰动影响，而在碳纳米管中生长的链则与主体强耦合，导致振动频率被重正化高达110 cm^-1。因此需要一种能减少这些扰动的方法来测量卡宾的真实性质。
AI.method: 作者将氢封端多炔封装在超薄氮化硼纳米管中并通过热转化生成卡宾链。氮化硼纳米管与碳纳米管结构类似但为电绝缘体，可作为弱相互作用的理想宿主。研究采用统计拉曼光谱（245个位置）来表征振动频率分布、非谐性和键长交替度，并检测光致发光以验证偶极禁戒发射行为。
AI.result: 振动频率分布比在碳纳米管中窄一个数量级；非谐性与卡宾类材料的普遍规律一致；键长交替度与自由链的相关计算相匹配；未检测到光致发光（尽管宿主透明），符合偶极禁戒发射的预期。
AI.conclusion: 氮化硼纳米管为实验研究近理想状态的卡宾提供了可行途径，使得端基、有限长度和主客体扰动被降低为次级效应，从而首次实现了对卡宾固有性质的接近无扰动的实验测量。

title: Band Structure Modulation of ZrO2 Nanoparticles for Control of CO Adsorption Properties: A Combined Density Functional Theory - Density Functional Tight Binding Study
summary: We present a combined density functional theory (DFT) and density functional tight binding (DFTB) study of zirconia (ZrO2) nanoparticles of experimentally relevant sizes of several nanometers and their interactions with the CO molecule. A hybrid DFTB - Force Field (DFTB-FF) framework is developed, whereby band structure calculations rely on an existing Slater-Koster framework, while the accuracy of structural optimization and adsorption properties is controlled by the introduction of classical long-range interatomic potentials into DFTB instead of the traditional repulsive potentials. Additionally, coordination-dependent Zr-C potentials are introduced to account for the distinct local chemical environments of bulk-like facet sites and under-coordinated tip and edge sites, thereby improving the description of CO adsorption. This hybrid DFTB-FF approach substantially improves the robustness of geometry optimization and provides a practical strategy for extending the applicability of DFTB to complex oxide nanostructures. The calculations reveal that termination stoichiometry can be used to engineer intrinsic, p-type, or n-type electronic structures and thereby tune the adsorption activity of zirconia nanoparticles. While stoichiometric nanoparticles do not activate the C-O bond, low-coordinated sites in Zr-rich (n-type) nanoparticles exhibit chemisorption accompanied by charge donation into a CO antibonding LUMO-derived orbital, resulting in C-O bond activation. These results demonstrate that stoichiometry-controlled electronic structure and under-coordinated surface sites introduced by nanostructuring play a key role in governing the adsorption strength and reactivity of zirconia nanoparticles.

AI.tldr: 本文结合DFT和DFTB方法研究了几纳米尺寸二氧化锆纳米颗粒与CO分子的相互作用，开发了混合DFTB-FF框架，通过引入经典长程相互作用势和配位依赖的Zr-C势能改进DFTB对复杂氧化物纳米结构的描述，并发现通过调控纳米颗粒的化学计量比可以工程设计电子结构类型（本征、p型或n型），从而调控CO吸附活性，其中Zr-rich（n型）纳米颗粒的低配位位点能通过电荷注入激活C-O键。
AI.motivation: DFTB方法在复杂氧化物纳米结构中的适用性受限，传统排斥势在几何优化和吸附性质描述上不够准确，需要开发更稳健的方法来研究实验相关尺寸（数纳米）的ZrO2纳米颗粒的催化性质。
AI.method: 开发了混合DFTB-FF框架：能带结构计算沿用Slater-Koster框架，但用经典长程原子间势取代传统排斥势来控制结构优化和吸附性质精度；引入配位依赖的Zr-C势能区分体相面位点与欠配位的尖端和边缘位点。
AI.result: 该DFTB-FF方法显著提高了几何优化的鲁棒性；化学计量比可调控电子结构类型（本征/p型/n型）；化学计量比纳米颗粒不激活C-O键，而Zr-rich（n型）纳米颗粒的低配位位点表现出化学吸附并通过电荷注入CO反键LUMO轨道实现C-O键激活。
AI.conclusion: 化学计量比控制的电子结构和纳米结构化引入的欠配位表面位点共同决定了ZrO2纳米颗粒的吸附强度与反应活性，为扩展DFTB到复杂氧化物纳米结构提供了实用策略。

title: Magnetic phases of Kondo lattice materials Ce$_5$RhGe$_2$ and Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$
summary: Single crystals of Ce$_5$RhGe$_2$ and Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$ have been systematically investigated by electrical resistivity, specific heat, and magnetization measurements. Together with Ce$_5$CoGe$_2$, all three compounds crystallize in the orthorhombic \emph{Pnma} structure, with the lattice parameters increasing monotonically from Co to Rh to Ir, consistent with the effect of negative chemical pressure. Magnetization measurements along the three principal crystallographic axes identify the \emph{a} axis as the easy magnetization direction throughout the series. Ce$_5$RhGe$_2$ exhibits ferromagnetic ordering with a Curie temperature of approximately 11.5 K and shows magnetic behavior closely resembling that of Ce$_5$CoGe$_2$. In contrast, Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$ undergoes two successive magnetic transitions at $T_{\rm M1}=12.7$ K and $T_{\rm M2}=11.8$ K, and there are multiple metamagnetic transitions under magnetic fields, giving rise to magnetization plateaus at fractions of the saturation magnetization $M_{\rm s}$ of approximately $M_{\rm s}/5$ and $M_{\rm s}/3$. The low-field metamagnetic transition along the easy axis shifts to lower field with decreasing temperature, and eventually a pronounced hysteresis loop is observed about zero-field, establishing that Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$ exhibits a ferrimagnetic ground state at the lowest measured temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Ce5RhGe2和Ce5IrGe2单晶的电输运、比热和磁化性质，并与Ce5CoGe2对比。三者均属正交Pnma结构，晶格参数随Co→Rh→Ir单调增大（负化学压力效应）。Ce5RhGe2呈现铁磁有序（TC≈11.5 K），行为与Ce5CoGe2相似；而Ce5IrGe2则经历两次连续磁相变（12.7 K和11.8 K），在磁场下出现多种变磁转变及Ms/5和Ms/3的磁化平台，最低温下呈现亚铁磁基态。
AI.motivation: 通过系统研究Ce5RhGe2和Ce5IrGe2的物理性质，并与已报道的Ce5CoGe2对比，探讨化学压力效应对该家族化合物磁性质的影响，理解Ce基化合物中复杂的磁有序与竞争相互作用机制。
AI.method: 采用电输运、比热和磁化率测量手段，对Ce5RhGe2和Ce5IrGe2单晶沿三个主晶轴方向进行系统表征，分析其磁有序温度、变磁转变行为及磁化平台特征。
AI.result: Ce5RhGe2呈现铁磁有序（TC≈11.5 K），与Ce5CoGe2行为类似；Ce5IrGe2表现出两次磁相变（12.7 K、11.8 K）及多个变磁转变，出现Ms/5和Ms/3磁化平台，低温下显示出亚铁磁基态与显著磁滞回线。
AI.conclusion: 从Co到Rh到Ir的负化学压力效应导致晶格膨胀，Ce5IrGe2独特的亚铁磁基态和磁化平台表明该体系中磁性交换相互作用对化学压力极其敏感，为深入研究Ce基磁性材料的相图演化提供了新的材料平台。

title: A Novel Nb-Based Eutectic Superalloy with Exceptional Ultrahigh-Temperature Mechanical Properties
summary: Refractory alloys operating above 1300 °C, beyond the limit of Ni-based superalloys, must balance high-temperature strength, thermal stability, low density, low cost, and room-temperature tensile ductility, a combination that existing refractory alloys have yet to achieve. Here we report a castable Nb-based eutectic superalloy, Nb-10Mo-9.5C (at. %, NMC-1), comprising a uniform lamellar structure of Nb-Mo solid solution and Nb2C carbide phases. NMC-1 achieves 0.2% yield strengths of ~300 MPa and ~200 MPa at 1300 °C and 1500 °C, respectively, among the highest reported for Nb-based alloys, with pronounced strain hardening, non-zero room-temperature tensile ductility, and no observed microstructural coarsening after 100 h at 1400 °C. Its low density (8.65 g/cc) and cost (~$85/kg) yield a specific-strength-per-cost merit index that far surpasses commercial Nb, Mo, Ta, and W alloys, establishing a new design paradigm for ultrahigh-temperature structural materials.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种可铸造的铌基共晶高温合金Nb-10Mo-9.5C（NMC-1），由Nb-Mo固溶体和Nb2C碳化物组成的均匀层状结构，在1300°C和1500°C下分别具有约300 MPa和约200 MPa的屈服强度，同时保持室温拉伸延展性、优异的热稳定性和低成本，实现了超高温结构材料的多性能平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有难熔合金难以同时满足1300°C以上服役所需的高温强度、热稳定性、低密度、低成本和室温拉伸延展性这五项关键指标，尤其是Ni基高温合金无法在该温度范围使用，因此亟需新材料范式。
AI.method: 通过铸造方法制备Nb-10Mo-9.5C共晶合金（NMC-1），利用共晶反应形成Nb-Mo固溶体与Nb2C碳化物交替分布的均匀层状微观结构，实现强化相与韧化相的协同作用。
AI.result: NMC-1在1300°C和1500°C下分别达到~300 MPa和~200 MPa的屈服强度（Nb基合金中最高之一），具有显著的应变硬化、非零室温拉伸延展性，1400°C时效100小时无显微组织粗化；密度仅8.65 g/cc，成本约$85/kg，比强度-成本综合指标远超商用Nb、Mo、Ta、W合金。
AI.conclusion: NMC-1共晶合金成功打破了难熔合金在高温强度、热稳定性、密度、成本和延展性之间的性能权衡困境，为超高温结构材料建立了新的设计范式。

title: Effects of Interaction Range on Fluid Multicriticality: A Computational Study of an Interconverting Lattice Model
comment: Submitted to Journal of Chemical Physics
summary: The range of intermolecular interactions plays a central role in determining the nature of phase behavior and critical phenomena. It is well established through studies of the Ising model that as interaction range increases, Monte Carlo simulations progressively approach meanfield predictions as the effects of critical fluctuations are suppressed. In this work, we investigate how varying interaction range influences fluid multicriticality using an interconverting lattice model that exhibits both Ising-like liquid-gas criticality and symmetric fluid tricriticality (similar to that in the superfluid $^4$He-$^3$He mixture). This minimal model serves as a representative system for exploring the evolution of competing critical points within a generic framework. We analyze the model using both meanfield theory and three-dimensional Monte Carlo simulations while systematically varying the number of interacting neighbors, $Z_n$, from 6 to 388. We find that the system with nearest-neighbor interactions ($Z_n=6$) reveals only two types of multicritical behavior, while for larger interaction ranges, four distinct archetypes emerge. We demonstrate the convergence of the simulation results to those of the meanfield theory as the number of interacting neighbors tends to infinity, and we discuss the results within the framework of crossover critical phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文研究相互作用范围如何影响流体多重临界现象。利用一个同时展现Ising型液气临界性和对称流体三临界性的互变晶格模型，通过平均场理论和三维蒙特卡洛模拟，系统地改变相互作用邻居数Zn（从6到388），发现最近邻相互作用只揭示两种多重临界行为，而大相互作用范围则出现四种不同原型，并证明模拟结果在邻居数趋于无穷时收敛于平均场理论。
AI.motivation: 相互作用范围在决定相行为和临界现象本质中起核心作用。已有的Ising模型研究表明，随着相互作用范围增加，蒙特卡洛模拟逐渐趋近平均场预言。然而，相互作用范围如何影响流体的多重临界性（如竞争性临界点共存的情况）尚未被充分探索，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用一个互变晶格模型（该模型兼具Ising型液气临界性和与超流4He-3He混合物类似的对称流体三临界性），分别采用平均场理论和三维蒙特卡洛模拟进行分析，系统性地将相互作用邻居数Zn从6变化到388（即从最近邻到大范围相互作用），并对比两种方法的结果以研究临界涨落抑制效应。
AI.result: 发现最近邻相互作用系统（Zn=6）仅表现出两种多重临界行为，而更大相互作用范围则涌现出四种不同的多重临界原型。同时证明了当邻居数趋于无穷时，蒙特卡洛模拟结果收敛于平均场理论预测，显示临界涨落效应随相互作用范围增大而被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 相互作用范围的扩大显著改变了流体多重临界现象的类型和数量，模拟结果与平均场理论在长程相互作用极限下趋于一致。这些发现在交叉临界现象的框架下得到讨论，为理解临界涨落随相互作用范围变化的跨接行为提供了通用框架。

title: Encapsulated macroscopic WS$_2$ monolayers enable room-temperature exciton-polariton lattices
summary: Large-area, optically homogeneous monolayer semiconductors are a critical prerequisite for scalable room-temperature polaritonics and for realizing polariton lattices extending across many unit cells. Yet, the small size, optical inhomogeneity, and device-to-device variability of conventional exfoliated flakes have remained major obstacles. Here, we overcome these limitations using 1-dodecanol-encapsulated WS$_2$ monolayers that combine millimeter-scale coverage with remarkably uniform optical properties over lateral distances approaching $300\,$$μ\mathrm{m}$. Integrated into a tunable open microcavity, these monolayers exhibit robust room-temperature exciton-photon strong coupling, evidenced by a pronounced anti-crossing and a Rabi splitting of $\hbar Ω_{\mathrm{R}} \approx 31\,\mathrm{meV}$. Leveraging the exceptional uniformity of this platform, we realize a two-dimensional polaritonic kagome lattice and directly resolve its characteristic band structure. Angle-resolved spectroscopy reveals Dirac dispersive bands together with a weakly dispersive flat-band-like branch within the $s$-band, in good agreement with a linear non-interacting model. Complementary momentum- and real-space imaging further identifies the associated bond-centered and site-centered mode profiles. These results establish large-area WS$_2$ monolayers in open microcavities as a scalable platform for engineering polariton band structures and exploring synthetic quantum materials under ambient conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1-十二醇封装的WS₂单层材料，实现了毫米级覆盖且光学性质高度均匀的平台，并将其集成到可调谐开放微腔中，在室温下展现出激子-光子强耦合（Rabi劈裂约31 meV）。利用该平台的均匀性，进一步实现了二维极化激元kagome晶格并解析其能带结构，观测到Dirac色散带和弱色散的平带分支，为室温下研究极化激元能带工程和合成量子材料提供了可扩展平台。
AI.motivation: 传统机械剥离的WS₂薄片尺寸小、光学性质不均匀且器件间差异大，严重阻碍了其在毫米尺度面积上构建极化激元晶格及可扩展室温极化激元学的应用。需要一种具备大面积、光学均匀性的单层半导体平台。
AI.method: 采用1-十二醇封装WS₂单层材料，获得毫米级覆盖面积并在约300 μm横向距离上保持均匀光学特性；将其集成到可调谐开放微腔中实现室温强耦合；基于该均匀平台构建二维极化激元kagome晶格，通过角度分辨光谱、动量空间和实空间成像研究其能带结构及模式分布。
AI.result: 实现了室温激子-光子强耦合，观察到明显的反交叉现象，Rabi劈裂约为31 meV；在kagome晶格中分辨出Dirac色散带和弱色散的平带分支（位于s带内），与线性无相互作用模型吻合良好；动量与实空间成像确认了键中心和位点中心的模式分布。
AI.conclusion: 大面积WS₂单层与开放微腔的结合，为在环境条件下工程化极化激元能带结构、探索合成量子材料提供了可扩展的可靠平台，克服了传统剥离材料在尺寸与均匀性上的长期瓶颈。

title: From London to Morse via Binnig, Quate, and Gerber
summary: In their landmark paper introducing the atomic force microscope [Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{56}, 930 (1986)], Binnig, Quate, and Gerber presciently anticipated that the technique would ultimately be capable of probing interactions running the gamut from weak van der Waals interactions to strong covalent bonding. They also highlighted that the tip-sample forces central to AFM are present, and often highly influential, in scanning tunnelling microscopy; indeed, this realisation directly inspired the invention of the force microscope. In this perspective for the \textit{Forty Years of AFM} special issue, we review selected aspects of two decades of work from our group at the University of Nottingham that span the force range highlighted by BQG and are united by a common, central theme: the probe as active participant rather than passive observer. Our selection of results also covers length- and correlation-scales from the microscopic right down to the single chemical bond limit, tracking a spectrum of interactions from van der Waals/Hamaker forces, through hydrogen bonding, to covalent bonds and, finally, atom-by-atom assembly of metal clusters via vertical tip-sample transfer. Echoing BQG's own observations on the prevalence of probe-sample forces in STM, we also discuss recent evidence that tip-induced heterogeneity underpins first-passage dynamics in molecular diffusion and highlight the challenges in acquiring non-invasive measurements of diffusion barriers for adsorbed molecules that are readily perturbed by the probe. We close with a perspective on machine learning's growing role in automating tip-driven atomic and molecular manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文是《AFM四十年》特刊中的一篇展望性论文，回顾了诺丁汉大学课题组二十年来在原子力显微镜（AFM）领域的研究成果，核心主题是"探针作为主动参与者而非被动观察者"。研究覆盖从微观到单一化学键的尺度范围，追踪了范德华力、氢键、共价键等系列相互作用，并探讨了尖端诱导异质性对分子扩散的影响以及机器学习在尖端驱动原子/分子操纵中的日益重要作用。
AI.motivation: 致敬Binnig、Quate和Gerber在1986年发明AFM时的远见——他们预言该技术能够探测从弱范德华力到强共价键的全谱系相互作用。作者希望回顾并展示自己课题组二十年的工作如何验证了这些早期预言，同时强调AFM中探针-样品作用力在STM中也普遍存在的关键洞察。
AI.method: 作为一篇perspective（展望）文章，作者没有提出全新的实验方法，而是系统回顾和综述课题组在过去二十年中的代表性研究成果，涵盖多个实验体系与相互作用类型，从宏观尺度的范德华力/Hamaker力，经过氢键，到单化学键极限的共价键，乃至通过垂直尖端-样品转移实现金属团簇的原子级组装。
AI.result: 论文展示了从微观到单化学键尺度的全面实验结果，包括各类探针-样品相互作用力测量、原子级操纵（如金属团簇的逐原子组装）、以及探针诱导异质性对吸附分子扩散动力学（首过动力学）影响的新证据，并指出非侵入性测量扩散势垒的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼应了BQG四十年前的预言，证实了AFM确实能够跨越多层次的力谱进行探测。展望未来，机器学习将在自动化尖端驱动的原子/分子操纵方面发挥日益关键的作用，这将成为该领域发展的新方向。

title: $g$-wave altermagnetic order parameter in hematite
summary: Altermagnets combine the vanishing net magnetization of antiferromagnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting. Magnon band splitting provides a direct probe of altermagnetic order and may enable chirality-selective magnon transport, yet the momentum-space symmetry of this splitting has not been determined quantitatively. Here we use inelastic neutron scattering to map the momentum dependence of altermagnetic magnon splitting in hematite ($α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$). The splitting vanishes along nodal directions and reaches maxima off the nodes, revealing the $g$-wave symmetry of the altermagnetic order parameter. These results agree with linear spin-wave theory calculations based on the altermagnetic model, which further identify the nondegenerate branches as magnons of opposite chirality and trace the splitting to symmetry-inequivalent long-range exchange interactions. Our results provide the first quantitative determination of the momentum-space symmetry of altermagnetic chiral magnons. These findings, together with hematite's high magnetic ordering temperature and low magnon damping, establish it as a promising platform for low-dissipation, symmetry-selective magnonic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非弹性中子散射实验，定量绘制了赤铁矿（α-Fe₂O₃）中交变磁（altermagnetic）磁振子劈裂的动量依赖关系，首次定量确定了交变磁序参量的g波对称性，并将其与相反手性的磁振子分支和对称性不等价的长程交换相互作用联系起来。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体结合了反铁磁体的零净磁化强度与动量依赖的自旋劈裂特性，磁振子带劈裂可作为交变磁序的直接探针，并可能实现手性选择性的磁振子输运。然而，这种劈裂在动量空间中的对称性此前尚未被定量确定，这是理解交变磁体关键物理性质的重要缺口。
AI.method: 研究团队利用非弹性中子散射技术，系统绘制了α-Fe₂O₃中交变磁磁振子劈裂随动量的变化关系。通过观察劈裂沿节线方向消失、在偏离节线处达到最大值的行为，揭示了交变磁序参量的g波对称性。同时结合基于交变磁模型的线性自旋波理论计算进行对照验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明磁振子劈裂具有g波对称性：沿节线方向劈裂消失，偏离节线处达到最大。线性自旋波理论计算与实验结果吻合，进一步识别出非简并分支为相反手性的磁振子，并将劈裂归因于对称性不等价的远程交换相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次定量确定了交变磁手性磁振子的动量空间对称性。结合赤铁矿的高磁有序温度和低磁振子阻尼特性，该材料被确立为低耗散、对称选择性磁振子应用的有前景平台。

title: Magneto-spin-orbit graphene: Chern topology and photoinduced Hall response
summary: Magneto-spin-orbit graphene can host Chern phases due to proximity interactions, but in realistic heterostructures these depend on substrate chemistry, local stacking registry and may be altered by buried-interface reconstruction. Investigation of these effects requires special efforts to take into account the long-range moire patterns that often arise for these heterostructures. We address this question using first-principles calculations and effective four-band models for four out-of-plane magnetized Gr/(Au, Pt)/(Co, Mn) heterostructures in commensurate (2 x 2) and moire (9 x 9) supercells where the latter include misfit dislocations for the Co-based interfaces. The commensurate cells overestimate charge transfer and exaggerate valley asymmetry, whereas moire averaging strongly reduces both effects while preserving sizable spin splittings. The Pt spacer mediates stronger proximity interactions than Au, while replacing Co by Mn substantially changes the balance of the effective exchange interactions in a spacer-dependent manner. Introduction of misfit dislocations into the Co-based structures is selective and tunes the Dirac gap in Gr/Au/Co or spin splittings in Gr/Pt/Co. Graphene in Gr/Pt/Co exhibits effective ferromagnetic Chern phase with C = 2 in all studied supercells. By contrast, the moire models of the other three compositions are ferrimagnetic and topologically trivial, with C = 0. Nevertheless, they exhibit helicity-dependent photoinduced Hall responses, which are strongly enhanced by misfit-dislocation reconstruction in Gr/Au/Co. This work demonstrates that moire-scale stacking controls the effective Chern phase and Hall conductivity, whereas buried-interface defects tune the photoinduced Hall response without changing the topology.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和有效四带模型，研究了四种Gr/(Au, Pt)/(Co, Mn)异质结在共度(2×2)和莫尔(9×9)超胞中的拓扑性质，发现莫尔尺度堆叠控制有效Chern相与霍尔电导，而埋藏界面缺陷可调控光致霍尔响应但不改变拓扑。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯异质结中的磁自旋轨道耦合Chern相依赖于衬底化学、局域堆叠配准以及埋藏界面的重构等实际因素，而这些效应常伴随长程莫尔图案，需要专门处理才能准确理解其拓扑性质。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算和有效四带模型，对四种面外磁化的Gr/(Au, Pt)/(Co, Mn)异质结在共度(2×2)和包含失配位错的莫尔(9×9)超胞中进行系统研究，比较共度与莫尔模型的差异。
AI.result: 共度超胞高估电荷转移并夸大谷不对称性；莫尔平均显著降低这两者但保留较大自旋劈裂。Pt间隔层比Au产生更强近邻相互作用；Gr/Pt/Co在所有超胞中表现为C=2的铁磁Chern相，而其余三种组合的莫尔模型为亚铁磁且拓扑平庸(C=0)，但表现出螺旋依赖的光致霍尔响应，且Gr/Au/Co中失配位错重构可增强该响应。
AI.conclusion: 莫尔尺度的堆叠排列决定了有效的Chern相和霍尔电导，而埋藏界面缺陷可调节光致霍尔响应而不改变体系的拓扑性质，表明实际异质结的拓扑行为需在莫尔尺度上准确建模。

title: Large-scale dynamics of integrable quenches
summary: The Ballistic Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (BMFT) is a path-integral based approach to treat large-scale correlations in interacting integrable systems which, so far, has only been applied to quasi-equilibrium settings. In this paper we extend this approach to integrable quench problems and, to illustrate it, we compute the time evolution of the full-counting-statistics (FCS) of a conserved charge. We identify the relevant path integral, solve it via saddle-point, and obtain a set of partial differential equations describing the dynamics of the FCS. We solve these equations explicitly for free fermionic systems and for the interacting cellular automaton Rule 54. In both cases, we recover the known exact results. For Rule 54, our construction moreover completes the solution across the entire ballistic window.

AI.tldr: 本文将弹道宏观涨落理论（BMFT）从准平衡设置扩展到可积淬火问题，通过路径积分和鞍点方法推导出描述全计数统计（FCS）动力学的一组偏微分方程，并在自由费米子系统和Rule 54相互作用元胞自动机中验证了与已知精确结果的一致性。
AI.motivation: BMFT此前仅应用于准平衡情形，尚未推广到可积淬火问题。作者希望扩展这一路径积分框架，使其能够处理远离平衡的动力学过程（如淬火后守恒荷的涨落统计），从而更完整地理解可积系统中大规模关联与涨落的普适行为。
AI.method: 作者将BMFT推广到淬火问题：首先构造描述守恒荷FCS的路径积分；然后通过鞍点方法求解，得到描述FCS动力学的偏微分方程组；最后分别对自由费米子系统（可解析求解）和可积元胞自动机Rule 54进行显式求解与验证。
AI.result: 在自由费米子系统中恢复已知精确结果；在Rule 54中同样重现已知精确结果，并且该构造还补全了整个弹道窗口内的完整解。
AI.conclusion: BMFT框架能够成功推广到可积淬火问题，为计算远离平衡系统中守恒荷的全计数统计提供了一种通用而有效的解析途径，并在多个模型中得到了验证。

title: Metal-Insulator Coexistence and Gap-Crossing Domain-Wall Modes in an Aubry-André Model with Nonlocal Hopping
summary: Nonequilibrium transport remains a central theme in modern physics, spanning from condensed matter to synthetic systems. Here, we investigate particle transport in an extended Aubry-André model with system-scale hopping, namely nonlocal hopping with a range proportional to the system size, and uncover a metal-insulator coexistence regime in real space, where metallic and insulating spatial domains coexist within the same system and are separated by sharp spatial boundaries. In the insulating region, particles exhibit flat-band-like localization in the absence of quasiperiodic potentials, while a quasiperiodic potential induces distinct multi-point localization, different from conventional exponential localization. Meanwhile, particles can freely propagate and tunnel across spatially disconnected metallic domains separated by the insulating region. Beyond this coexistence phase, we identify unconventional gap-crossing domain-wall modes with comb-like spatial profiles that mediate nonlocal, multi-point transport across separated metallic domains. Our findings reveal a rich interplay between localization, nonlocality, and transport in systems with nonlocal hopping.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了具有系统尺度非局域跳跃的扩展Aubry-André模型中粒子输运现象，发现了实空间中的金属-绝缘体共存区域，其中金属与绝缘空间域共存并以尖锐边界分离。绝缘区域表现出平带式局域化或多点局域化（在准周期势下），而粒子仍可在被绝缘区隔开的空间分离金属域间自由传播和隧穿。
AI.motivation: 非平衡输运是现代物理的核心主题，涵盖凝聚态到合成系统。作者旨在探索具有非局域（系统尺度）跳跃的扩展Aubry-André模型中的粒子输运行为，揭示局域化、非局域性和输运之间的丰富相互作用。
AI.method: 采用系统尺度范围的非局域跳跃（hopping range与系统尺寸成正比）的扩展Aubry-André模型，在实空间中研究粒子输运，分析金属-绝缘共存相、平带式局域化、多点局域化以及畴壁模等物理现象。
AI.result: 发现：1) 实空间中存在金属-绝缘体共存区域，由尖锐空间边界分隔；2) 绝缘区在无准周期势时表现出平带式局域化，有准周期势时呈现不同于常规指数局域的分布多点局域化；3) 粒子可在被绝缘区隔开的金属域之间自由传播和隧穿；4) 在共存相之外发现具有梳状空间轮廓的非常规跨界畴壁模，能够中介跨越分离金属域的非局域多点输运。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了具有非局域跳跃系统中局域化、非局域性与输运间丰富的相互作用，为理解非平衡输运提供了新的理论框架。

title: Examining Convergence of Cluster Perturbation Theory and Cluster Coupled Cluster for J1-J2 Heisenberg Spin Lattices
summary: In previous work, it was shown that using the cluster mean field(cMF) wavefunction as the zeroth order wavefunction for perturbation theory and coupled cluster produces a reasonable approximation for the J 1-J 2 Heisenberg model in the thermodynamic limit(TDL). However, this work was limited to cPT4 and cCCSD. The central claim of cMF is that it takes strongly correlated systems and makes them weakly correlated so that PT weakly correlated methods can be used. To confirm that this claim is true, it is important to show that the PT and CC series converge. In this paper, we extend the previous calculations to cPT7 and cCCSDTQ5 where we show that the energy is converging. We also discuss how to perform cluster based calculations efficiently in the thermodynamic limit, which is crucial for these more expensive calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了基于簇平均场（cMF）波函数的微扰论（PT）和耦合簇（CC）计算方法至cPT7和cCCSDTQ5，验证了cMF核心主张——将强关联体系转化为弱关联体系从而使微扰方法收敛，并讨论了在热力学极限下高效执行簇基计算的方法。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明以cMF波函数为零阶波函数的微扰论和耦合簇方法能对热力学极限下的J1-J2 Heisenberg模型给出合理近似，但此前仅局限于cPT4和cCCSD。cMF的核心主张是它能把强关联体系转化为弱关联体系，使微扰和弱关联方法可用。为证实这一主张，关键在于证明PT和CC级数确实收敛。
AI.method: 将先前的计算拓展至更高阶：微扰论到cPT7，耦合簇到cCCSDTQ5（包含三激发、四激发和五激发），用以检验能量的收敛性。同时讨论了如何在热力学极限下高效执行基于簇的计算，这对于更昂贵的计算至关重要。
AI.result: 在高阶计算中展示了能量正在收敛，从而为cMF将强关联转化为弱关联的核心主张提供了数值验证支持。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩展至cPT7和cCCSDTQ5，证明了基于cMF的微扰和耦合簇级数能够收敛，并提出了热力学极限下的高效簇计算方法，进一步巩固了cMF作为强关联体系处理框架的有效性。

title: Human-agent discovery of reconfigurable in-plane ferroelectric superdomain control
summary: Automated experimentation is most effective when the observables, available actions, and objective are defined before the experiment starts, as is the case for Bayesian optimization. However, in many exploratory experiments, the variables that describe the sample must be extracted from the data, new operations emerge during the experiments, and the instrument budget is too small to learn the problem by trials. Here we introduce the Scanning Probe Agentic Research Cycle (SPARC) framework, in which a coding agent and a human operator share one microscope, one notebook, and two persistent memory files. FINDINGS.md stores graded conclusions about the experiment, whereas PITFALLS.md records learned failure modes of analysis and instrument. We apply SPARC to reconfigure the in-plane superdomain direction of a (111)-oriented PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 film. In an operator-supervised campaign, the agent reanalyzed earlier manual measurements and developed an oriented lattice of stationary bias pulses with alternating polarity to reconfigure the superdomain direction. In a subsequent agent-controlled campaign, PITFALLS.md entries were compiled into checks that validate a design before any write. The experiments showed that spatial polarity alternation, instead of the exact matching between the lattice and lamellar periods, determines directional selection. Combining a raster scan with a masked pulse lattice printed the letters UTK into the superdomain orientation. The campaign also identified practical requirements for agentic experimentation where physical verification of instrument execution, the conditions under which stored findings remain valid, validation of new observables on instrument data, and robust control protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPARC（扫描探针智能体研究循环）框架，让编码智能体与人类操作员共享一台显微镜、一个笔记本和两个持久记忆文件（FINDINGS.md存储分级结论，PITFALLS.md记录失败模式），应用于(111)取向PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3薄膜的畴方向重构实验，实现自主实验循环。
AI.motivation: 传统自动化实验（如贝叶斯优化）要求预先定义可观测量、动作和目标，但在探索性实验中，描述样品的变量需从数据中提取、新操作会动态涌现、且仪器预算过小无法通过试错学习问题，需要新的框架来应对这种不确定性。
AI.method: SPARC框架包含编码智能体与人类操作员协作系统，配备两个持久记忆文件：FINDINGS.md保存有分级的实验结论，PITFALLS.md记录已学习的分析和仪器失效模式。该框架应用于通过交替极性静态偏压脉冲的有序晶格来重构薄膜超畴方向。
AI.result: 在操作员监督战役中，智能体重新分析了早期人工测量并开发出交替极性脉冲晶格来重构超畴方向；在智能体控制战役中，PITFALLS.md条目被编译为写入前验证检查。实验表明空间极性交替（而非晶格与层状周期精确匹配）决定方向选择，并通过光栅扫描与掩蔽脉冲晶格组合在超畴取向中打印出"UTK"字母。
AI.conclusion: SPARC验证了智能体化实验的可行性，同时识别出实践要求：仪器执行的物理验证、存储结论有效性条件、新可观测量的仪器数据验证，以及稳健的控制协议。

title: Simple invariants for band topology
summary: Despite the exhaustive understanding gathered around non-interacting topological states of matter, there is no single method capable of systematically delivering simple, numerically efficient topological invariants that is applicable to all crystalline and non-crystalline systems alike. Here we revisit the spectral localizer operator, constructed from the Hamiltonian and position operators, and show how it can be treated it as an auxiliary zero-dimensional Hamiltonian whose topology encodes the higher dimensional phases of the parent Hamiltonian. Its classification reduces every topological invariant to a matrix signature or the sign of a Pfaffian for an appropriate localizer, both of which are simple to interpret and efficient to compute in real space. We validate this approach by deriving simple real-space invariants for weak and rotationally invariant crystalline phases that were previously beyond the grasp of the spectral localizer formalism, atomic limits that escape scattering invariants, phases that evade symmetry-based indicator methods, as well as phases that had no previously known invariant. Our work provides a systematic way to construct any non-interacting topological invariant for a crystalline or non-crystalline systems, opening avenues to classify and predict the topology of previously unexplored classes of materials.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了由哈密顿算符和位置算符构建的谱局域化算符，证明其可被视为辅助的零维哈密顿量，其拓扑性质编码了母哈密顿量的更高维相。该方法将任意拓扑不变量简化为矩阵签名或Pfaffian符号的计算，并在实空间中高效求值，适用于晶体和非晶系统。
AI.motivation: 尽管对无相互作用拓扑态已有详尽理解，但目前缺乏一种单一方法能系统性地为所有晶体及非晶系统提供简单、数值高效的拓扑不变量。
AI.method: 将谱局域化算符（由哈密顿算符和位置算符构成）视为辅助零维哈密顿量，其拓扑分类归结为计算矩阵签名或适当局域化算符的Pfaffian符号，两者均易解释且在实空间中高效计算。
AI.result: 为弱拓扑相、旋转对称晶体相、逃逸散射不变量的原子极限、规避对称性指标方法的相以及此前无已知不变量的相导出了简单实空间不变量，均验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为构建晶体或非晶系统的任意无相互作用拓扑不变量提供了系统途径，为分类和预测此前未探索的材料类别拓扑打开了大门。

title: Positive Temperature Coefficient of Anisotropy due to $d^6L$ Groundstate in $ε$-Fe$_2$O$_3$
summary: Positive anisotropy temperature coefficients ($dK/dT>0$) usually arise from hybridization between magnetic 3d states and strongly spin-orbit-coupled (SOC) subsystems. Yet $ε$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ shows $dK/dT>0$ (125-200~K) without an obvious SOC partner. We study pure and Cr-doped (with weakened Fe-O hybridization) $ε$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ across the transition from low temperature incommensurate to high-anisotropy magnetic phases. We identify a $d^6L$ groundstate in $ε$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ while reduced hybridization yields $d^6 + d^6L^2$ in the Cr-doped system, highlighting metal-ligand hybridization as a route to tune magnetic, electronic and orbitronic properties.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了ε-Fe₂O₃及其Cr掺杂体系中正各向异性温度系数（dK/dT>0）的起源。研究发现ε-Fe₂O₃中存在d⁶L基态（L为配体空穴），而Cr掺杂削弱Fe-O杂化后形成d⁶+d⁶L²混合态，表明金属-配体杂化是调控磁性、电子和轨道特性的关键途径。
AI.motivation: 通常正各向异性温度系数源于磁性3d态与强自旋轨道耦合（SOC）子系统的杂化，但ε-Fe₂O₃在没有明显SOC伙伴的情况下仍表现出dK/dT>0（125-200 K），其微观机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 对比研究纯ε-Fe₂O₃和Cr掺杂（削弱Fe-O杂化）的ε-Fe₂O₃，观察从低温非公度相到高各向异性磁性相的转变，分析金属-配体杂化状态的变化。
AI.result: 纯ε-Fe₂O₃中鉴定出d⁶L基态（配体空穴参与电荷转移）；Cr掺杂削弱杂化后出现d⁶+d⁶L²混合态，证实了配体轨道在磁性调控中的核心作用。
AI.conclusion: 金属-配体杂化（而非传统SOC伙伴）是ε-Fe₂O₃中正各向异性温度系数的根源，通过调节杂化强度可有效调控磁性、电子与轨道特性（orbitronic）。

title: Scalable machine learning framework for multiphase identification from powder X-ray diffraction
summary: X-ray diffraction (XRD) is the primary tool for identifying crystalline phases following synthesis, but automated phase identification remains challenging, particularly for multiphase samples with overlapping peaks and experimental artifacts. While deep-learning methods have been proposed to improve upon classical search-match algorithms, most formulate phase identification as a single closed-set classification problem, requiring one shared model to discriminate among all candidate phases. Here we introduce GALAXI, which instead decouples the identification task into independent one-versus-all binary classifiers that each specialize in recognizing a single phase. These pre-trained classifiers first narrow the search space to a small set of plausible phases, which are then evaluated through Rietveld refinement to identify the combination of phases that best explains the full diffraction pattern. On a curated set of experimental patterns, GALAXI identifies the correct phases with a micro-F1 score of 0.935, outperforming classical search-match and prior deep-learning models. The method remains robust to common experimental artifacts, including low impurity phase fractions, small crystallite size, peak shifts, sample displacement, and texture, and performs well when applied to time-resolved in-situ XRD data from solid-state reactions. Moreover, because the phase-specific models are independent, GALAXI can expand to large reference libraries without retraining existing models. This modular architecture enables us to train classifiers for 64,594 structures from the Crystallography Open Database and deploy them through a public web interface at https://galaxi-xrd.com.

AI.tldr: GALAXI提出了一种将XRD物相鉴定从单一闭集分类问题解耦为多个独立的"一对所有"二元分类器的方法，每个分类器专门识别单一物相，先通过预训练分类器缩小搜索空间，再用Rietveld精修评估物相组合，在实验图谱上取得0.935的micro-F1分数，优于传统搜索匹配和此前深度学习方法。
AI.motivation: XRD是结晶相鉴定的主要工具，但自动化物相鉴定仍具挑战性，尤其是多相样品存在峰重叠和实验伪影时。现有深度学习方法大多将物相鉴定视为单一闭集分类问题，需要一个共享模型来区分所有候选物相，这限制了其扩展性和处理复杂多相样品的能力。
AI.method: GALAXI将鉴定任务解耦为独立的"一对所有"二元分类器，每个分类器专精识别单一物相。流程分为两步：首先用预训练分类器将搜索空间缩小到少数可能的物相，然后通过Rietveld精修评估这些候选物相的组合，找出最能解释完整衍射图谱的组合。由于物相模型相互独立，可扩展至大规模参考库而无需重新训练现有模型。
AI.result: 在精选实验图谱上，GALAXI以0.935的micro-F1分数识别正确物相，优于经典搜索匹配和先前深度学习方法。该方法对常见实验伪影（低杂质相分数、小晶粒尺寸、峰偏移、样品位移和织构）具有鲁棒性，并在固态反应的时间分辨原位XRD数据上表现良好。成功训练了64,594种COD结构的分类器，并通过公开网页界面部署。
AI.conclusion: GALAXI通过模块化的"一对所有"分类架构有效解决了XRD多相物相鉴定的挑战，在保持鲁棒性的同时实现了比现有方法更优的性能，且具备扩展到大规模物相库的能力，已通过公共网络界面向用户提供服务。

title: Divergent Orbital Diamagnetism from Chiral Edge States in Chern Insulators
summary: Two-dimensional massless Dirac systems, exemplified by graphene, are known to exhibit a divergent orbital diamagnetic susceptibility that scales linearly with system size. Motivated by viewing a chiral edge state as one half of an enlarged analogue of a benzene ring, we study Chern insulators under open boundary conditions and find the same divergent scaling. This giant diamagnetism is robust against disorder, revealing its topological nature. Our results further suggest a profound connection to the divergent diamagnetism of massless Dirac systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Chern绝缘体在开放边界条件下的轨道抗磁性，发现其抗磁化率随体系尺寸线性发散（与石墨烯等无质量Dirac系统的发散抗磁性类似），且该巨大抗磁性对无序具有鲁棒性，揭示其拓扑本质。
AI.motivation: 已知石墨烯等二维无质量Dirac系统表现出随体系尺寸线性发散的轨道抗磁化率。作者受到"手性边缘态可视为苯环放大类似物的一半"这一图景的启发，想探究Chern绝缘体在开放边界条件下是否也具有类似的发散抗磁性，从而建立拓扑态与Dirac系统抗磁性之间的联系。
AI.method: 作者在开放边界条件下研究Chern绝缘体（拓扑非平庸的带隙体系），计算其轨道磁化率，并分析该磁化率随体系尺寸的标度行为。同时考察无序对该效应的影响以检验其拓扑鲁棒性。
AI.result: 发现Chern绝缘体在开放边界条件下同样表现出随体系尺寸线性发散的巨大抗磁性。该效应对无序具有鲁棒性，表明其源于拓扑性质（与边缘态相关），而非单纯的微观细节。
AI.conclusion: Chern绝缘体的发散抗磁性具有拓扑起源，并与无质量Dirac系统（如石墨烯）的发散抗磁性存在深刻联系，为拓扑体系与Dirac材料的磁学性质提供了统一视角。

title: Creation and characterization of leviton excitations in tight-binding chains
summary: Levitons are minimal-excitation electronic wave packets generated by Lorentzian voltage pulses and constitute a central resource for electron quantum optics. Their creation and defining properties are usually formulated in continuum scattering descriptions, whereas many candidate platforms for integrated electronic quantum circuits are finite, discrete, and strongly shaped by lattice dispersion. We study leviton generation in finite one-dimensional tight-binding chains of non-interacting fermions driven by time-dependent voltage pulses. Using the single-particle density matrix, we resolve the excitation above the initial Fermi sea and quantify its quality through the average excitation number and its fluctuations. We find that clean leviton-like states emerge only in an intermediate regime where the pulse is slow enough to be resolved by the dynamics on the lattice, but not so slow that truncation and finite-size effects distort the Lorentzian profile in the time domain. Lorentzian pulses (even if truncated) systematically outperform non-Lorentzian pulse shapes in approaching the low-noise limit with increasing system size. We further identify finite-lattice signatures associated with band filling, pulse amplitude, linear voltage-drop geometry, and residual deviations from the continuum integer-charge condition. These results establish a microscopic framework for understanding leviton formation beyond the ideal continuum limit and for evaluating lattice-based platforms for coherent few-electron transport.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限一维紧束缚链中非相互作用费米子受时变电压脉冲驱动产生的leviton态。通过单粒子密度矩阵解析激发特性，发现干净leviton态仅存在于中间参数区间，且洛伦兹脉冲在接近低噪声极限方面系统性优于非洛伦兹脉冲。
AI.motivation: Leviton通常用连续散射描述，但实际集成量子电路的平台是有限、离散且受晶格色散影响的。因此需要建立微观框架理解超出理想连续极限的leviton形成，以评估基于晶格平台的相干少电子输运。
AI.method: 研究者使用单粒子密度矩阵方法，在有限一维紧束缚链上由时变电压脉冲驱动的非相互作用费米子体系中，解析初始费米海之上的激发，并利用平均激发数及其涨落量化leviton质量。系统考察了脉冲速度、截断效应、有限尺寸、能带填充、脉冲幅度和电压降几何等因素的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现仅在中间参数区间才出现干净的leviton态——脉冲需足够慢以被晶格动力学分辨，但又不能太慢以免截断和有限尺寸效应扭曲时域的洛伦兹轮廓。洛伦兹脉冲（即使截断）在增大系统尺寸时系统性优于非洛伦兹脉冲形状。同时还识别了与能带填充、脉冲幅度、线性电压降几何以及与连续整数电荷条件的残余偏差相关的有限晶格特征。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了理解连续理想极限之外的leviton形成的微观框架，为评估基于晶格的少电子相干输运平台提供了理论基础，展示了有限离散系统中leviton形成的中间区间特性及洛伦兹脉冲的优势。

title: Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory with Coulomb Interactions
summary: We provide the first fully rigorous justification of time-dependent density functional theory in the continuum: Given a time-dependent density, we prove that there exists an external potential, unique up to a time-dependent constant, such that the corresponding Schrödinger equation reproduces the given density. This potential can be obtained with an iteration scheme. Our argument covers Coulomb interactions and does not need any Taylor expansion in time. It instead requires analyticity in space for the density and potential, which is compatible with extended nuclei.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在连续介质中严格证明了含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）的合理性：给定一个含时密度，存在一个外部势（唯一到含时常数），使得相应的薛定谔方程能够重现该密度，且该势可通过迭代方案获得。
AI.motivation: 含时密度泛函理论在物理和化学中被广泛使用，但其数学基础（即Runge-Gross定理的严格性）在连续介质中此前缺乏完全严谨的证明。已有论证通常依赖时间的泰勒展开，这在一般情形下不成立。因此需要更严格的数学证明来为TDDFT提供坚实的理论基础。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个不依赖时间泰勒展开的证明框架，核心条件是密度和势在空间上具有解析性（可解析延拓），这比假定时间解析性更为宽松，且与扩展原子核模型兼容。证明通过迭代方案构造外部势，并证明其存在性与唯一性（差一个纯时间函数）。该论证覆盖了库仑相互作用情形。
AI.result: 证明了在连续介质中，给定满足空间解析性条件的含时密度，必然存在一个外部势（唯一到含时常数）使薛定谔方程精确重现该密度，且该势可通过迭代收敛得到。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为含时密度泛函理论提供了首个完全严格的数学基础，比以往仅依赖时间解析性和泰勒展开的启发式论证更一般化，并覆盖了有物理意义的库仑相互作用和扩展原子核情形。

title: Real-time Dyson expansion for the nonequilibrium $GW$ approximation: Correlated spectra and dependence on the reference propagator
summary: Electronic spectra provide direct insight into the excitations and correlations of condensed matter systems. Their description requires electron correlations beyond mean field. In equilibrium, the $GW$ approximation has become the method of choice for many materials. Extending this approximation to nonequilibrium, however, is challenging. Full two-time $GW$ simulations within the nonequilibrium Green's functions approach scale at least cubically with propagation time, whereas improved scaling schemes such as time-local (adiabatic) approximations or the generalized Kadanoff--Baym ansatz usually retain only mean-field character in the spectra. The recently introduced real-time Dyson expansion recovers dynamical correlations in the spectrum at time-linear cost, but has so far been restricted to the second-order Born approximation with mean-field reference propagators. Here we formulate and implement the RT-DE for the nonequilibrium $GW$ self-energy with reference propagators of general form whose off-diagonal evolution is time local. In particular, we assess Hartree--Fock propagators, propagators with statically screened exchange with nonequilibrium screening, and a correlated propagator based on the Hartree--Fock GKBA. Benchmarks against exact diagonalization for a driven two-band lattice model with long-range interactions show that the mean-field and statically screened references yield the most accurate spectra, including satellite structures absent at mean-field level, whereas the GKBA-based approach best captures scattering-induced occupation dynamics, but artificially broadens and splits spectral peaks. When applied to large systems that are beyond the reach of exact methods, the scheme resolves the excitonic replica of the valence band and satellites identified as exciton shake-up, as well as their reshaping with increasing excitation density.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于实时Dyson展开（RT-DE）的非平衡GW方法，使用一般形式的参考传播子（包括Hartree-Fock、静态屏蔽交换和基于Hartree-Fock GKBA的相关传播子），实现了时间线性成本下的动态关联光谱计算。通过与精确对角化基准对比，发现平均场和静态屏蔽参考传播子能给出最准确的光谱（包括卫星结构），而GKBA方法虽能捕获散射诱导的占据动力学但会人为展宽和分裂光谱峰。
AI.motivation: 非平衡电子光谱需要超越平均场的电子关联描述。全双时GW模拟随传播时间立方增长，而时间局域近似或GKBA类方法通常在光谱中仅保留平均场特征。需要一种既能在光谱中恢复动态关联，又具有时间线性计算成本的方法。
AI.method: 将实时Dyson展开（RT-DE）推广到非平衡GW自能，采用一般形式的参考传播子（其非对角演化是时间局域的），具体评估三种参考：Hartree-Fock传播子、带非平衡屏蔽的静态屏蔽交换传播子，以及基于Hartree-Fock GKBA的相关传播子。
AI.result: 对于具有长程相互作用的驱动双带晶格模型，与精确对角化的基准表明：平均场和静态屏蔽参考给出了最准确的光谱（包括平均场水平所缺失的卫星结构）；GKBA方法最能捕获散射诱导的占据动力学，但会人为展宽和分裂光谱峰。在大系统应用中，该方案能解析价带的激子复制和激子shake-up卫星及其随激发密度增加的重塑。
AI.conclusion: RT-DE与GW自能结合不同参考传播子为非平衡光谱提供了高效且具有不同优势的方案。平均场和静态屏蔽参考适合光谱计算，GKBA参考适合占据动力学。该方法可扩展到精确方法无法触及的大系统，揭示激子相关的光谱特征。

title: Restoring the Surface Magnetic Gap in MnBi$_2$Te$_4$
summary: A widespread experimental realization of quantized anomalous transport in the intrinsic magnetic topological insulator MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ is hindered by its elusive surface magnetic gap. Uncovering the origin of the gapless states is essential for accessing its topological properties. Here we show that surface defects lower the electrostatic potential, drive topological surface states into subsurface layers, suppress exchange interactions, thereby closing the gap. Tuning the surface electrostatic potential via external electric fields or interfacial fields in van der Waals heterostructures restores the expected gap and enables control of its topology. This is confirmed by model calculations and validated in defective MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ films interfaced with polar insulators, explaining the enhanced quantum anomalous Hall effect under AlO$_x$ capping observed in recent experiments. Our theory identifies electrostatically driven surface-state delocalization as a competitive origin of gap suppression and proposes displacement-field engineering for robust quantized transport.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了MnBi₂Te₄中表面缺陷会降低静电势，将拓扑表面态驱入次表面层并抑制交换相互作用，从而关闭表面磁隙，阻碍量子反常霍尔效应的实现。通过外部电场或范德华异质结构中的界面场调控表面静电势可恢复能隙并控制拓扑性质，该理论解释了AlOₓ覆盖增强量子反常霍尔效应的实验现象，并提出位移场工程作为一种实现鲁棒量子化输运的手段。
AI.motivation: MnBi₂Te₄作为本征磁性拓扑绝缘体，其量子化反常输运的实验实现一直受到表面磁隙 elusive 的阻碍。理解无隙态（gapless states）的起源对于获取其拓扑性质至关重要。
AI.method: 通过理论计算与模型分析，研究表面缺陷对静电势的影响机制，结合外部电场和范德华异质结构中的界面场调控手段，并与极性绝缘体界面实验进行对照验证。
AI.result: 证明表面缺陷导致的静电势降低会使拓扑表面态向次表面层离域化，抑制交换相互作用从而闭合能隙；通过静电势调谐可恢复期望的能隙并实现对拓扑性质的控制；该机制在AlOₓ覆盖层实验中得到了验证，可解释观察到的量子反常霍尔效应增强现象。
AI.conclusion: 提出静电力驱动的表面态离域化是能隙抑制的一个竞争性起源，并建议采用位移场工程来实现鲁棒的量子化输运。

title: Steady reservoir-mediated self-trapping of polariton condensates
summary: Nonequilibrium bosonic condensates of exciton-polaritons generated by tightly focused incoherent optical beams are typically expected to form a stationary ballistically expanding state with the notable exception of experimentally observed compact self-trapped states [Phys. Rev. Lett. 123, 047401 (2019)]. We show that the back-action of the condensate on the optically pumped excitonic reservoir via bosonic stimulated scattering can cause local reservoir depletion, producing a steady condensate confined in a self-induced potential trap. Notably, this self-trapped state is formed by persistent converging rather than radially expanding polariton currents and exists even below the conventionally defined condensation threshold. This state remains steady over nanosecond-scale times and is eventually ejected from the self-induced trap due to a bullet-type instability, enabling spiking neuromorphic dynamics in networks of polariton condensates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非平衡激子-极化激元玻色凝聚体在紧密聚焦非相干光泵浦下的行为，发现凝聚体对光学泵浦激子库的反作用可通过玻色受激散射导致局部库耗尽，从而在自感应势阱中形成稳定凝聚体。这种自陷态由持续汇聚而非径向膨胀的极化激元流形成，甚至在传统定义的凝聚阈值以下也存在。
AI.motivation: 激子-极化激元凝聚体在紧密聚焦非相干光束泵浦下通常预期形成稳态弹道膨胀态，但实验上观察到例外——紧凑的自陷态（PRL 123, 047401）。本文旨在解释这一异常现象背后的物理机制。
AI.method: 通过考虑凝聚体对光泵浦激子库的反作用（back-action），利用玻色受激散射引起局部激子库耗尽，从而产生自感应势阱束缚凝聚体。研究该自陷态的形成条件、电流流动模式及其在纳秒时间尺度上的动力学演化。
AI.result: 发现自陷态由持续汇聚的极化激元电流形成，而非径向膨胀流；该状态在传统凝聚阈值以下也能存在；状态在纳秒尺度上保持稳定，随后因子弹型不稳定性从自感应势阱中被弹出，可实现极化激元凝聚体网络中的脉冲神经形态动力学。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了极化激元凝聚体与激子库之间反作用机制的重要性，为理解实验观察到的自陷态提供了理论解释，并为基于极化激元网络的类脑神经形态计算提供了新的物理基础。

title: On spectral properties of Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz
summary: The Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz with mean-field propagators is increasingly used to simulate non-equilibrium quantum fermionic and bosonic systems. Compared with the full Kadanoff--Baym equations, its mean-field propagators substantially reduce computational cost, enabling simulations with computational effort that scales linearly with propagation time. However, the time-diagonal structure of the Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz obscures spectral properties within the collision integral of the transport equation. Here, we recover and investigate these hidden spectral properties using the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz. For a Hubbard cluster, we compare ground-state spectral functions obtained with the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz against those from standard Kadanoff--Baym equations. At moderate interaction strengths, the spectral functions show good agreement. At large interaction strengths, however, significant deviations emerge, and the spectral function obtained with the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz becomes negative. These results demonstrate that, despite its computational advantages, the Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz has important limitations in strongly interacting regimes and may produce unphysical spectral properties when interactions become sufficiently large.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了广义Kadanoff-Baym Ansatz (GKBA)在非平衡量子费米子和玻色子系统模拟中的局限性。利用扩展GKBA恢复并研究了标准GKBA中被时间对角结构掩盖的谱性质，发现其在中等相互作用强度下与全Kadanoff-Baym方程结果吻合良好，但在强相互作用下出现显著偏差，甚至产生负的谱函数，揭示了该方法在强关联区域的重要限制。
AI.motivation: GKBA结合平均场传播子因其计算效率高（计算成本随传播时间线性增长）而被广泛用于模拟非平衡量子系统，但其时间对角结构使得输运方程碰撞积分中的谱性质变得不清晰。研究者希望揭示并检验GKBA隐藏的谱性质，评估其在强相互作用区域的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用扩展Generalized Kadanoff-Baym Ansatz来恢复标准GKBA中隐藏的谱信息。以Hubbard团簇为测试体系，将扩展GKBA计算的基态谱函数与标准Kadanoff-Baym方程的结果进行系统对比，覆盖中等和强相互作用强度两个参数区间。
AI.result: 在中等相互作用强度下，扩展GKBA得到的谱函数与标准Kadanoff-Baym方程结果吻合良好；但在强相互作用强度下出现显著偏差，且扩展GKBA得到的谱函数变为负值，产生非物理的谱性质。
AI.conclusion: 尽管GKBA具有计算效率优势，但在强相互作用区域存在重要局限性，当相互作用足够强时可能产生非物理的谱性质。这一发现对该方法在强关联体系中的应用提出了警示。

title: Metastable polar order and phase competition in Carpy-Galy LaTaO4
summary: Carpy-Galy LaTaO4 undergoes a structural sequence linking the antipolar monoclinic P21/c ground state and the polar orthorhombic Cmc21 phase through an incommensurately modulated regime. First-principles calculations identify a metastable polar monoclinic P21 phase as a commensurate intermediate in the phase-transition landscape. As a common subgroup of P21/c and Cmc21, P21 provides a symmetry-connected route between the established polymorphs. Mode-resolved energy surfaces for these symmetry-breaking pathways show that coupling between the respective primary order parameters and an isosymmetric Gamma_1+ relaxation stabilizes the P21 minimum along both pathways. Consequently, the P21/c -> P21 transformation has a finite energy barrier, while a restricted soft-mode model retains competing P21 and Cmc21 basins over an illustrative range of harmonic stiffness. Lattice-metric and neutron-diffraction comparisons indicate a shared S_2+-dominated displacement character between the calculated commensurate state and the experimental IC-o modulation, supporting the use of P21 as a commensurate structural reference for IC-o. Finally, composition-dependent energetics suggest chemical routes for tuning polar-antipolar competition.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了LaTaO4在反极单斜P21/c基态与极性正交Cmc21相之间的结构转变序列，识别出亚稳极性单斜P21相作为公度中间态，并揭示其对称性连接作用、能量面特征及与实验非公度调制（IC-o）结构的对应关系。
AI.motivation: 理解LaTaO4中反极性-极性相变的结构演化机制，明确公度中间相的稳定性来源及其与实验观察到的非公度调制结构的关系，为调控极性-反极性竞争提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，结合模式分辨能量面分析（mode-resolved energy surfaces）、对称性子群分析（P21作为P21/c和Cmc21的共同子群）、晶格度量与中子衍射对比，以及成分依赖的受力热力学计算。
AI.result: 识别出亚稳极性单斜P21相为公度中间态；发现序参量与同对称Gamma_1+弛豫的耦合稳定了P21能量最小点；P21/c到P21转变存在有限能垒；软化模型保留P21与Cmc21竞争性势阱；计算公度态与实验IC-o调制共享S2+主导的位移特征；成分调控可调节极性-反极性竞争。
AI.conclusion: P21相可作为IC-o非公度调制的公度结构参考模型，对称性连接路线有助于理解LaTaO4的多相转变机制，并可通过化学掺杂调控极性/反极性竞争行为。

title: Nonlinear Topological Orbital Responses of Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions
summary: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions evade the skyrmion Hall effect, but compensation suppresses their conventional topological charge Hall signal. We predict a semiclassical nonlinear topological orbital response of an isolated skyrmion in a $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric hexagonal antiferromagnet without spin-orbit coupling. In the diffusive, weak-emergent-field regime, the spin-dependent emergent Lorentz force reshapes the carrier distribution, generating a local orbital Hall-current correction and a local orbital accumulation, both quadratic in the applied electric field. The current correction requires spin-asymmetric longitudinal scattering, whereas the accumulation survives spin-symmetric scattering. When the spin-diffusion length greatly exceeds the strip width, the current correction persists while the accumulation approaches zero. Both signals are even under electric-field reversal, odd under reversal of the skyrmion topological charge $Q$, and helicity independent within this model. These symmetries enable rectified detection and distinguish this mechanism from the $Q$-even quantum-regime topological orbital Hall effect.

AI.tldr: 该论文预测了在PT对称六方反铁磁体中，无自旋轨道耦合的孤立斯格明子会产生半经典非线性拓扑轨道响应。在扩散弱涌现场区，自旋相关的涌现洛伦兹力会重塑载流子分布，产生与电场二次方成正比的局域轨道霍尔电流修正和局域轨道累积。电流修正需要自旋不对称的纵向散射，而累积在自旋对称散射下依然存在。两种信号对电场反转都是偶性的，对斯格明子拓扑电荷Q反转是奇性的，且与螺旋度无关。这些对称性可实现整流检测，并区别于Q偶性的量子区拓扑轨道霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁斯格明子虽避免了斯格明子霍尔效应，但其补偿效应抑制了传统拓扑电荷霍尔信号。作者旨在寻找一种新的、可在补偿条件下仍然存在的拓扑轨道响应机制，从而为反铁磁斯格明子的检测提供可行方案。
AI.method: 采用半经典理论框架，在PT对称六方反铁磁体中（无自旋轨道耦合）分析孤立斯格明子。研究扩散区弱涌现场极限下，自旋相关的涌现洛伦兹力对载流子分布的重塑效应，推导出局部轨道霍尔电流修正和局部轨道累积，均为电场的二次方函数。
AI.result: 发现两种非线性轨道信号：局域轨道霍尔电流修正（需自旋不对称纵向散射）和局域轨道累积（自旋对称散射下仍存在）。当自旋扩散长度远大于条带宽度时，电流修正持续存在而累积趋近于零。两种信号对电场反转偶性、对Q反转奇性、与螺旋度无关，可实现整流探测。
AI.conclusion: 该机制提供了一种在反铁磁斯格明子中绕过补偿效应、可直接探测拓扑电荷的非线性轨道响应方案，其对称性特征使其与量子区的Q偶性拓扑轨道霍尔效应可明确区分，为反铁磁斯格明子的实验检测和器件应用开辟了新路径。

title: Green's Functions from Sample-based Krylov Quantum Diagonalization: An Impurity Solver for Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
summary: We generalize the sample-based Krylov quantum diagonalization (SKQD) method from ground-state calculations to the evaluation of single-particle Green's functions. By constructing and sampling unitary Krylov subspaces in the N +/- 1 particle-number sectors and evaluating all sector-connecting overlaps classically, the approach reconstructs the Green's function via a Lanczos continued fraction while retaining the shallow-circuit, ancilla-free character of SKQD. The quantum device is required only to prepare and sample short-time evolutions. Applied to the particle-hole-symmetric single-impurity Anderson model in chain geometry, with the discrete bath representation used in dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), the method recovers the spectral function using a relatively small fraction of the full Hilbert space. Across a range of interaction strengths that spans the metal-insulator transition, the main spectral features are reproduced. These results suggest that SKQD-based Green's-function calculations may allow DMFT impurity solvers with a larger number of bath sites on near-term quantum hardware than is currently practical.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于采样的Krylov量子对角化（SKQD）方法从基态计算推广到单粒子格林函数计算。通过在N±1粒子数扇区构造和采样酉Krylov子空间，并经典地评估所有连接扇区的重叠，该方法通过Lanczos连分数重构格林函数，同时保持SKQD的浅电路和无辅助比特特性。量子设备仅需制备和采样短时演化。应用于粒子-空穴对称的单杂质安德森模型（链几何，采用DMFT中的离散浴表示），该方法用相对较小的希尔伯特空间子集恢复了谱函数。在跨越金属-绝缘体转变的相互作用强度范围内，主要谱特征均被再现。结果表明，基于SKQD的格林函数计算可能使近端量子硬件上的DMFT杂质求解器支持比当前实际更多数量的浴格点。
AI.motivation: 现有的SKQD方法只能处理基态计算，而量子多体物理中许多核心问题（如DMFT中的杂质求解器）需要计算格林函数。将SKQD扩展到格林函数计算，有望在近端量子硬件上支持更多浴格点的DMFT杂质求解，突破当前经典方法的瓶颈。
AI.method: 将SKQD推广到N±1粒子数扇区，构造和采样适用于格林函数计算的酉Krylov子空间；所有扇区连接的重叠均在经典侧评估；通过Lanczos连分数重构单粒子格林函数；量子设备仅负责短时演化的制备和采样，保持浅电路与无辅助比特的结构。
AI.result: 在粒子-空穴对称的单杂质安德森模型（DMFT链几何离散浴表示）中，该方法以相对较小的希尔伯特空间子集恢复谱函数；在跨越金属-绝缘体转变的多个相互作用强度下，主要光谱特征均被准确再现。
AI.conclusion: SKQD的格林函数推广是可行的，且展现出在近端量子硬件上实现更大浴格点数的DMFT杂质求解器的潜力，可作为当前实际可行方案的重要替代或补充路径。

title: Quantum hot carrier spectra in plasmonic catalysis
summary: Vibrational activation of admolecules on metal nanoparticles is an elementary step in plasmonic catalysis, yet the underlying dynamics driven by hot carriers is not fully understood in the quantum regime. Using an atomistic description of plasmonic hot carrier generation, we investigate vibrational excitation and dissociation of oxygen on silver nanoparticles as a function of diameter D. As D reduces from the classical to quantum-sized regime, quantized distribution of hot carriers emerges with increasing population in the high-energy regions. These highly energetic hot carriers deliver more efficient vibrational coupling and dissociation. The rate of vibrational excitation shows a linear 1/D scaling, which results from Landau damping. It turns nonlinear at elevated light intensities due to vibrational heating generated by multiple electron scattering. The finding of quantized distribution of hot carrier in plasmonic catalysis opens new avenues for selective control and nonthermal energy conversion.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用原子级别的等离激元热载流子描述，研究了金属纳米颗粒上吸附分子的振动激发与解离动力学，发现当颗粒尺寸从经典区间缩小到量子区间时，热载流子出现量子化分布且高能区域布居增加，从而更有效地驱动振动耦合和解离，振动激发速率呈现1/D的线性标度关系。
AI.motivation: 等离激元催化中吸附分子在金属纳米颗粒上的振动激活是关键基元步骤，但量子区间内由热载流子驱动的底层动力学尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 采用原子层面的等离激元热载流子产生描述，系统研究氧分子在银纳米颗粒上的振动激发与解离作为颗粒直径D的函数。
AI.result: 当D从经典区间减小到量子尺寸区间时，热载流子出现量子化分布且高能区域布居增加；这些高能热载流子实现更有效的振动耦合与解离；振动激发速率呈现线性1/D标度关系（源自朗道阻尼），并在高光强下因多重电子散射产生的振动加热而转为非线性。
AI.conclusion: 等离激元催化中热载流子的量子化分布发现了新调控途径，为选择性控制和非热能量转换开辟了新方向。

title: Edge energy fluctuation: A unified theory of friction scaling laws in twisted layered material interfaces
summary: Interlayer twisting in van der Waals (vdW) layered materials generates moire superlattices, unlocking unique opportunities for engineering their electronic and mechanical functionalities. Here, building on two key insights - the invariance of the potential energy of complete moire tiles during sliding, and the symmetry-breaking effect induced by the slider edge - we propose the concept of edge energy fluctuation (EEF) and demonstrate that the EEF governs the sliding energy barrier of finite-sized sliders. Interestingly, we found that even at a fixed twist angle and sliding direction, significant frictional anisotropy emerges when the slider edge is cut along different directions, resulting in distinct friction scaling laws. Furthermore, we present a friction engineering paradigm for twisted layered material interfaces through the deliberate introduction of hierarchical edges, offering a promising route for friction control in superlubric devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"边缘能量波动"（EEF）概念，指出有限尺寸滑块的滑动能垒由EEF主导，并展示了在固定扭转角和滑动方向下，滑块边缘切割方向不同会产生显著的摩擦各向异性和不同摩擦尺度律，最后提出通过引入层级边缘实现摩擦工程的新范式。
AI.motivation: 层间扭转的范德华材料产生莫尔超晶格，为调控电子和机械功能提供机会，但有限尺寸滑块在扭转界面上的摩擦滑动能垒的物理机制尚不清晰，需要深入理解边缘效应与莫尔尺度的耦合关系。
AI.method: 基于两个关键洞察：完整莫尔瓦片在滑动过程中势能不变性，以及滑块边缘引入的对称破缺效应。由此提出EEF概念并证明其主导有限尺寸滑块的滑动能垒，并通过构造不同形状边缘的滑块及层级边缘进行研究。
AI.result: 发现即使在固定扭转角和滑动方向下，滑块边缘沿不同方向切割会产生显著摩擦各向异性，并导致不同的摩擦尺度律。
AI.conclusion: 提出通过刻意引入层级边缘来对扭转层状材料界面进行摩擦工程设计的范式，为超润滑器件的摩擦控制提供了新途径。

title: Excitons probe intrinsic flat band Mottness in a van der Waals heterostructure
summary: Excitons provide a sensitive optical probe of electronic correlations in nearby two-dimensional materials, yet their coupling to intrinsic flat-band Mott systems remains largely unexplored. Here we combine gate-tunable optical spectroscopy with first-principles calculations to study monolayer WSe$_2$ in direct contact with the van der Waals Mott insulator Nb$_3$Cl$_8$. The gate evolution of WSe$_2$ excitonic resonances reveals signatures of a correlation-reconstructed Mott gap in Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ that is absent from the single-particle band picture. In the electron-doped regime, the WSe$_2$ 2s Rydberg exciton undergoes a multistage evolution and develops into interlayer attractive and repulsive polaron branches, showing that a Rydberg exciton can be dressed by strongly correlated flat-band electrons in an adjacent Mott layer. Under an out-of-plane magnetic field, spin-polarized Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ states further induce valley-selective exciton coupling, producing a strongly enhanced circular polarization of the WSe$_2$ exciton emission. These results extend exciton-based sensing and exciton-polaron physics to intrinsic flat-band Mott materials, providing an optical route to probe and engineer correlation-driven interfacial quasiparticles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了单层WSe2与范德华Mott绝缘体Nb3Cl8直接接触时的激子光学行为，发现WSe2激子可作为敏感探针揭示Nb3Cl8中关联重构的Mott能隙，并在电子掺杂下观察到Rydberg激子被强关联平带电子修饰形成层间极化子分支，磁场下还展现出谷选择性耦合和增强的圆偏振发射。
AI.motivation: 激子是对邻近二维材料中电子关联敏感的光学探针，但激子与本征平带Mott体系之间的耦合此前尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 将门可调光学光谱与第一性原理计算相结合，研究单层WSe2直接接触Mott绝缘体Nb3Cl8的异质结构。
AI.result: (1) 栅压演化揭示出Nb3Cl8中相关重构的Mott能隙特征；(2) 电子掺杂区观察到WSe2 2s Rydberg激子的多级演化并形成层间吸引与排斥极化子分支；(3) 垂直磁场下自旋极化的Nb3Cl8态诱导谷选择性激子耦合，显著增强WSe2激子发射的圆偏振度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将激子传感和激子-极化子物理扩展到本征平带Mott材料，为探测和工程化关联驱动的界面准粒子提供了光学途径。

title: Electronic Orbital Angular Momentum Driven by Finite-Momentum Phonons: Beyond Chiral and Axial Phonons
summary: We show that finite-momentum phonons generate electronic orbital angular momentum (OAM) even without phonon axiality or chirality, with the response controlled by the phonon wave vector $q$ and frequency $ω$. We develop a general gauge-field theory in which a unitary transformation absorbs the phonon displacement into emergent vector and scalar potentials acting on the electrons, providing a perturbative classification of the OAM response in $q$ and $ω$. We derive $q$- and $ω$-scaling laws for AC and DC responses. Notably, AC OAM arises even for linearly polarized phonons, with its magnitude and sign tunable by $q$. Its generation is governed by the matching between the phonon geometry and the electronic orbital texture rather than solely by the phonon angular momentum. The connection of the DC response to the electronic Berry curvature further supports that phonon angular momentum is not the only degree of freedom governing electronic OAM generation.
